title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of Operation
descriptionHtml:
About nu glass

nu glass improves wireless connectivity in enclosed spaces by making glass permeable to radio frequencies using laser ablation technology. By engraving an ultra-thin pattern that remains invisible, the company preserves the insulating properties of glazing while shaping connected environments.

Main mission

The Head of Operations leads all operations of nu glass Group and ensures that every project is delivered on time, to the expected quality, with a solid organisation across all sites.

They take over the operational responsibility currently held by management, structure and coordinate several teams, oversee the project managers and deal directly with clients in crisis situations. A hands-on leader, they combine a big-picture view with the willingness to roll up their sleeves, while embodying the company's culture and values.

Key responsibilities

Operations management

· Lead the Group's day-to-day operations across all sites.

· Plan activities, set priorities and allocate resources across teams and projects.

· Structure operational processes and build a decentralised service organisation, close to sites and clients.

· Maintain a solid command of the company's systems and tools, and ensure they are used effectively.

Team leadership

· Manage several teams and oversee the project managers (PMs): objectives, follow-up, coaching.

· Coordinate interactions between teams, sites and support functions.

· Bring nu glass's culture and values to life within the teams.

Project management and coordination

· Oversee the project portfolio, from kick-off to delivery.

· Ensure deadlines, costs and quality are met.

· Get hands-on when needed, providing direct support to the PMs.

Crisis management and client relations

· Take the lead in operational crises and coordinate the response.

· Act as the client's point of contact in critical situations and restore trust.

Contribution to management

· Propose and evolve the Group's operational roadmap.

· Report on operational performance to management.

Candidate profile

· Proven experience leading operations, ideally in a multi-site environment.

· Proven experience managing several teams and project managers.

· Strong skills in planning, prioritisation and project management.

· Experience in crisis management, including direct client contact.

· Ability to structure and coordinate decentralised organisations.

· Good understanding of information systems and management tools.

· Fluent English (required).

Nice to have

· German and/or French.

· Experience setting up a decentralised service model.

· A background rooted in hands-on, "pure and hard" operations, close to the field.

Soft skills

· Hands-on leader, ready to roll up their sleeves.

· Structured mindset, strong sense of priorities and calm under pressure.

· Ambitious vision, always aiming higher, with a positive attitude.

· Highly motivated and results-driven: makes things work.

· Commitment to nu glass's culture and values, and the ability to pass them on.

Your first months at nu glass

You will take ownership of existing operational workflows, align manufacturing schedules with technical requirements, and establish close collaboration with the team on-site in Nyon. Within your first months, you will have streamlined daily processes and gained a complete overview of laser ablation production.

Benefits

Flexible working hours support your schedule. Travel expenses compensation covers your commutes. Home office and remote work options provide flexibility between the Nyon HeadQuarter, home and customer sites. Free beverages are available on-site. A company cellphone and a company laptop are provided for your work.

Compensation

CHF 90,000–120,000 per year

title: Head of Professional Services, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Head of Professional Services, EMEA is responsible for the growth and excellence of the professional services team in Europe. This individual will oversee an organization responsible for driving successful Benchling deployments, ensuring customer satisfaction, and maximizing the value clients derive from the company’s products. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution to align services with business objectives and client needs.

This role is instrumental in partnering across the entire Customer Experience organization as well as the broader Sales teams to further Benchling’s growth. This role needs to draw on an innovative vision based on best-in-class enterprise software implementation practices, with a focus on results and high standards. This is a demanding yet rewarding role that will allow the right individual to make a significant impact within our growing company and in the life sciences industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Delivery Leadership

    • Own end-to-end delivery quality, timeline, and performance across EMEA Professional Services engagements

    • Partner globally to set and enforce delivery standards for complex, validated, and regulated environments

    • Serve as an escalation point for at-risk engagements, partnering with Customer Success and Support to resolve cross-functional customer issues

  • Team & Org Building

    • Lead, grow, and retain a distributed team across Europe, with a focus in Zurich and London/Cambridge

    • Ensure that the team structure and incentive models hit utilization targets but also long-term relationship investments

    • Build a strong bench through hiring, onboarding, and career pathing for implementation consultants and specialists

    • Lead and develop managers to excellence

  • Partner & Ecosystem Management

    • Manage relationships with systems integrator and delivery partners supporting EMEA capacity, including performance oversight and quality accountability

    • Determine where partner delivery capacity should be used vs. built in-house, and manage the transition points between the two

  • Commercial Ownership

    • Own SOW scoping, staffing forecasts, and financial performance for the EMEA PS book of business

    • Partner with Sales on deal structuring for new implementations, expansions, and renewals with a services component

    • Provide accurate capacity and revenue forecasting to leadership

  • Customer & Executive Engagement

    • Represent Professional Services in executive business reviews with enterprise pharma and biotech clients

    • Build trusted relationships with technical and scientific stakeholders at customer organizations

    • Champion the adoption of AI delivery practices within the PS team and with customers

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in professional services, implementation, or delivery leadership roles within enterprise software; life sciences, pharma, biotech, or scientific software strongly preferred.

  • Ability to develop fluency with Biotech R&D processes and scientific concepts. Must be able to confidently interface and build trust with VP and C-Level Scientific & Research IT leaders in top Biotech and Pharma companies.

  • Background developing a team that has proven technical, business or scientific, and consulting skills for delivery success.

  • Proven experience leading distributed teams across multiple European countries, including navigating differing labor environments and travel/delivery cadences.

  • Experience leading and developing a strong set of managers that own delivery quality and execution, as a second line leader.

  • Direct experience managing delivery through third-party systems integrator partners, including holding partners accountable for quality.

  • Strong commercial acumen: comfort owning SOW economics, margin, and forecasting

  • Executive presence with technical and scientific buyers; ability to run high-stakes EBRs and escalations.

  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages (German, French) a strong plus given the DACH and French-speaking customer base.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-enabled delivery models.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

title: HR consultant
descriptionHtml:
Heb jij HR-ervaring en wil je graag jouw kennis en expertise inzetten, maar óók jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Zoek je afwisseling en uitdaging in jouw werkzaamheden?

De consultants van Buro Payroll ondersteunen klanten uit diverse branches tijdelijk op het gebied van HR en/of salarisadministratie. Als HR-consultant van Buro Payroll ga je aan de slag bij onze klanten en ondersteun je de HR-afdeling tijdelijk bij uiteenlopende opdrachten. Van het verwerken van mutaties, opstellen van contracten en het meedenken aan procesoptimalisaties in AFAS tot aan het adviseren over HR-specifieke vraagstukken en deelnemen aan HR-projecten.

Taken

In deze rol ben jij hét HR-gezicht voor één of meerdere klanten. Je voert niet alleen de dagelijkse HR-werkzaamheden uit, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar bestaande processen. Waar kan het slimmer, efficiënter of consistenter? Jij ziet verbeteringen, signaleert deze en vertaalt dit naar concreet HR-advies waar de opdrachtgever direct mee verder kan.

Onze klanten zijn divers: van gevestigde namen tot kleinere organisaties met grote ambities. Dat betekent dat geen opdracht hetzelfde is: elke werkomgeving, iedere casus en elk HR-vraagstuk biedt jou weer nieuwe inzichten. Zo blijft je werk dynamisch én ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel.

Veel van onze klanten werken met AFAS. Heb je daar nog geen ervaring mee? Geen probleem! Wij zorgen dat jij precies de kennis krijgt die nodig is om vol vertrouwen aan de slag te gaan. Vanuit ons label Peopletrack zijn wij namelijk AFAS-partner, waardoor wij beschikken over voldoende opleidingsmateriaal om deze software eigen te maken!

En verder…

  • Onze accountmanagers zoeken opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw kwaliteiten, interesses én groeipad.

  • Bij elke klant werk je samen met het lokale HR-team, zodat je nooit alleen staat in je opdracht.

  • Daarnaast heb je een hechte groep HR-collega’s bij Buro Payroll achter je staan: sparren, vragen stellen, samen oplossen; we helpen elkaar vooruit.

  • Minimaal één keer per maand komen we samen op kantoor voor gezelligheid, een gezamenlijke lunch en kennisdeling. Zo blijf je verbonden, geïnspireerd en onderdeel van het team.

title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider HR: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: HR Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:

Power our growing crew from day one. Keep our people operations running sharp – so every colleague feels supported, valued, and ready to aim high.

As our HR Operations Specialist, you keep the operational heartbeat of Robin Radar steady and reliable. title: Implementation Manager - Bilingual
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together.

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers

  • Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge.

  • Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments.

  • Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs.

  • Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users.

  • Act as a trusted advisor for customers, guiding them through the implementation ensuring they leverage and apply Benchling Best Practices.

  • Understand and document customer pain points, advocate for them internally to influence product changes.

  • Identify and work with sales on opportunities for account expansion post go-live.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MS or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Biological Engineering or a related field.

  • At least 2 years of experience in a lab or R&D setting, ideally in antibody discovery or strain engineering or process development. You must be able to empathize with scientists and quickly understand complicated scientific concepts.

  • Software Implementation experience, preferably with a SaaS software company.

  • Strong communication skills. You must be able to quickly and effectively connect with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, IT project leads, and executives.

  • Self-starter with the ability to be successful in a startup environment.

  • Curious, creative, and tenacious. You should be excited to collaborate with customers and other Benchling teammates as a thought partner.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% based on customer and project needs.

  • Fluent or native proficiency in French or German

  • Experience using Benchling, especially if you’ve been a Benchling administrator, is preferred but not required.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#BI-Hybrid

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Ingénieur projets IRVE (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
• Description de l’entreprise

Entreprise en pleine croissance dont la mission est d’accélérer la transition vers un modèle énergétique durable, ancré dans l’infrastructure de recharge pour véhicules électriques et l’autoconsommation d’énergie renouvelable. Fondée en 2019 et déjà présente dans plusieurs pays européens, cette société propose des solutions clés en main à ses partenaires immobiliers, combinant infrastructures de recharge et installations d’autoconsommation solaire. Elle produit 100 % d’énergie renouvelable via des centrales solaires et s’appuie sur des systèmes de stockage innovants pour garantir une alimentation propre et fiable à ses partenaires et aux utilisateurs de véhicules électriques.

  • Le contexte

Afin de continuer son expansion en France, l’entreprise recrute un nouvel Ingénieur projets IRVE en charge de l’ingénierie et construction des stations de recharge notamment suite à leur partenariat avec un acteur majeur en France.

Vos missions

  • Description du poste

L’Ingénieur Projet IRVE sera responsable de l’ensemble des phases d’ingénierie et de construction du déploiement des bornes de recharge en France, de la signature du contrat jusqu’à la mise en service sous la responsabilité du Responsable Projets France. Il ou elle aura en charge :

  • Le soutien à l’équipe française dans le déploiement des projets en matière d’autorisations, d’ingénierie, d’achats, de construction et de mise en service

  • L’évaluation des Capex et Opex des stations de recharge rapide

  • La réalisation de visites techniques sur site selon les besoins

title: Ingénieur.e de recherche pour le pilotage de l'activité hospitalière (H/F) - CDD 14 mois
descriptionHtml:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Ce poste, ouvert au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, est rattaché au Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) qui compte à ce jour environ 70 personnes. Le centre s’intéresse à la cinétique des organisations et au développement de solutions d’aide à la décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs et incertains. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon quatre axes de recherche appliquée :

  • Axe FLOWS : Systèmes logistiques flexibles pour un monde durable ;

  • Axe DISCS : Systèmes numériques pour la gestion des crises et la sécurité ;

  • Axe WHOPS : Systèmes organisationnels pour la santé et le bien-être ;

  • Axe TRACE : Résilience territoriale, agilité et économie circulaire.

Huit expertises scientifiques et techniques sont au cœur de ces axes de recherche : Ingénierie systèmes, Ingénierie des modèles, Théorie de la décision, Recherche opérationnelle, Technologies immersives, IA générative, IA symbolique, et IA connexionniste. Les chercheurs et ingénieurs du CGI exploitent et contribuent particulièrement aux paradigmes scientifiques suivants pour réaliser les projets de recherche ou formation : l’Internet Physique, la Physique des Décisions, les Jumeaux Numériques Organisationnels.

Le poste à pourvoir concerne l'un des projets de recherche de l'axe WHOPS. Le but de ce projet est de répondre à un besoin exprimé par l'Agence Régionale de Santé (ARS) et un hôpital de la région parisienne. La personne recrutée sera intégrée à une équipe de chercheurs en ingénierie organisationnelle pour la santé, ce qui garantira un accompagnement visant une montée en régime rapide et un suivi régulier des activités de l'ingénieur(e) recruté(e).

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Le contexte général du projet concerne le pilotage des capacités hospitalières et l'anticipation des tensions sur l'offre de soins. Il s'agit d'un enjeu majeur pour les établissements de santé, les institutions en charge de la planification de l'offre de soins, et plus largement, pour l'ensemble des professionnels impliqués dans l'orientation des patients.

L'objectif général du projet est de développer et expérimenter, en s'appuyant sur des données réelles provenant du système d'information d'un hôpital, des outils innovants d'analyse et de prévision-prédiction de l'activité hospitalière, essentiels pour améliorer l'anticipation et le pilotage des capacités (ressources humaines et lits).

Parmi les outils et solutions envisagés, un intérêt particulier porte sur les principes du jumeau numérique asynchrone permettant l'analyse rétrospective des parcours patients et la simulation "in silico" de scénarios prospectifs. D'autres outils et techniques, concurrents ou complémentaires, notamment à base de projections statistiques et d'intelligence artificielle, devront aussi être explorés.

De manière générale, l'ingénieur(e) de recherche recruté(e) interviendra sur les développements et les travaux de recherche visant l'objectif général du projet. Plus précisément, la mission consiste à :

  • Analyser les données associées aux flux de patients et les déterminants organisationnels et médicaux influençant les durées de séjour et l'occupation des lits ;

  • Développer des modèles permettant d'estimer et d'anticiper l'évolution des taux d'occupation des capacités hospitalières ;

  • Développer des outils d'aide à la décision destinés aux professionnels hospitaliers et aux acteurs de la régulation ;

  • Produire une méthodologie reproductible et transférable à d'autres établissements ou territoires de soins ;

  • Documenter tous les travaux de développement dans des dossiers techniques à destination d'autres développeurs.

  • Rédiger des notices d'utilisation pour les utilisateurs finaux des modules ou application.

  • Rédiger ou participer à la rédaction de publications scientifiques pour valoriser les travaux réalisés.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

  • Méthodologies de recherche et développement, incluant notamment les étapes de spécification des besoins, d’analyse de la littérature, de conception de solutions logicielles et organisationnelles, d’expérimentation, de validation, et de dissémination des résultats.

  • Connaissances fondamentales des langages, outils et méthodes de traitement et d'analyse de données ainsi que des notions en interfaçage utilisateur.

  • Compétences en simulation à événements discrets à l'aide d'outils du commerce (Witness, FlexSim, AnyLogic, …) ou à l'aide de bibliothèques de développement (SimPy, SimJulia, Salabim, …).

  • Connaissances générales du système de santé français et si possible expérience (stage, emploi) en milieu hospitalier.

Capacités et aptitudes :

  • Communication, écoute, pédagogie, et interaction avec des chercheurs du CGI comme avec des professionnels de santé à l'hôpital.

  • Esprit d'équipe, collaboration, force de proposition, synthèse, rigueur technique et scientifique, autonomie.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Le(la) candidat(e) devra être titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un Master M2. Son domaine d’activité se situe en génie industriel, en informatique ou en sciences de données et en intelligence artificielle.

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

  • 49 jours de congés par an

  • restauration administrative sur place

  • aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

  • action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

  • Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 14 mois

  • À usage interne :

    Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche

Métier(s) de référence des agents pouvant postuler : Toutes catégories

  • Localisation du poste :

  • Date limite de candidature : 15/12/2026

  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/02/2027

  • La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d'emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l'Institut Mines Télécom

  • Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap

  • Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de catégorie A de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuelles

Your Team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:

1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project isworking to it eff ectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially.
2. Own the outcome: You may not be the project manager ultimately responsible for the resultsbut you are sure as heck responsible for putting in your best eff ort to ensure the project’sunderstanding and focus on the plan no matter how stubborn they are!
3. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that helpthem deliver their part of the project more effi ciently and eff ectively.
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools incollaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved.
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionallyand educate our clients to improve as well. Must-Have (The fundamentals)
- Mastery: Solid construction project planning capability in all aspects that take into accountstrategic objectives and the broad context you are operating in
- Communication: The charisma, infl uence and presence to get construction people to do newthings and take the best approach
- Leadership: A proven leader/coach/developer of teams
- Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects that hada signifi cant positive impact Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. ____________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. title: Integration Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Integration Manager to drive the successful rollout of innovative digital products across a growing range of markets and partners at GLS/NXT.

Your main responsibility as Integration Manager will be to lead and coordinate technical integrations between the GLS/NXT and the broader GLS corporate organization (and beyond), ensuring smooth adoption and strong stakeholder alignment.

You will work at the intersection of product, tech, and operations, ultimately aligning corporate requirements with the agile work environment at GLS/NXT. Your focus will be on reducing complexity in implementations, driving structured communication, and ensuring long-term product adoption both internally and externally.

This role is perfect for someone who is well-organized, process-driven and interested in breaking down complex technical tasks into digestible pieces.

Tasks

  • Manage integration projects: Drive international integration projects end-to-end by coordinating between GLS/NXT and internal or external stakeholders to ensure a smooth and well-structured onboarding process.
  • Ensure successful product adoption: Support customers beyond integration by helping them understand and realize the value of GLS/NXT products through user behavior analysis, feedback loops, and personal sparring
  • Bridge tech and business: Translate technical requirements into clear deliverables and timelines, ensuring efficient coordination between tech teams, ensuring that the right information reaches the right people at the right time
  • Improve integration processes: Identify gaps and pain points in the current setup and proactively drive improvements through documentation, tooling, and automation
  • Manage stakeholder relationships: Build strong, empathetic relationships with internal and external stakeholders and ensure GLS/NXT is well-represented within the corporate environment
  • Create visibility and impact: Report on integration progress and outcomes, highlighting key successes and learnings team-internal or to the leadership team

Requirements

  • ≥2 years of experience in integration, implementation, (technical) project management or customer success management in B2B
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with a structured approach to problem-solving
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and cultures
  • Fundamental understanding of technical concepts (API, system architecture or digital platform products
  • Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  • Ability to travel within the EU (10%)
  • Permission to work in Germany

Benefits

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow
  • Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy
  • Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives
  • Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment
  • Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.
  • Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance
  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites
  • Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well-suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.

About GLS/NXT

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

descriptionHtml:
Doctolib is looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join the Tech & Product Talent Acquisition team in our Berlin office. 

As a Coordinator, you'll focus on three essential areas: delivering exceptional candidate experience, mastering complex tech & product interview scheduling, and continuously improving our interview processes. What you’ll do

Working with us, you will learn:

  • How the full Talent Acquisition process works, from application to onboarding.

  • How to work with an Applicant Tracking System and recruitment-related data.

  • How to collaborate with candidates, Hiring Managers and internal stakeholders.

  • How to contribute to a positive and inclusive candidate experience.

Who you are 

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, sense of urgency, and agility that enable you to stay on top of priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Strong empathy that allows you to put yourself in other people's shoes and a genuine passion for finding solutions that work best for everyone.

  • A curious, problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn and dig deeper to understand how operations and processes work.

  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools to streamline daily tasks, draft communications, and improve efficiency, with curiosity to keep learning new AI-powered ways of working.

  • Fluency in English with strong verbal and written communication skills, allowing you to adapt your expression to different audiences and situations.

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Speak German at B2 level or above.

  • Have previous experience with an Applicant Tracking System, HR administration or coordination.

  • Have experience in an international, technology or fast-paced environment.

What we offer 

  • A structured and personalised onboarding programme through our Doctolib Academy, as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities.

  • A flexible working model that allows for hybrid and office-based work.

  • A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket, subject to the applicable eligibility rules.

  • 28 vacation days per year, calculated pro rata according to your working schedule and internship duration.

  • Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping.

  • A subsidised sports programme with our partner Urban Sports Club.

The Interview Process

  • Salary: €2,425 gross/month for a voluntary internship; €2,545 gross/month from 1 January 2027

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Opportunity to work in a hybrid setup (3 office days/week).

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: International Expansion - Germany
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: International Policy Intern
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Proxima Fusion is looking for an International Policy Intern to join the Partnerships and Public Affairs Team in Munich. You will work closely with the International Policy Team and contribute to Proxima's engagement with EU institutions, national governments and international organisations. Fusion is one of the fastest-moving industries in the world and European and international policy will shape how quickly it reaches the market. This internship offers direct exposure to that process and the opportunity to take on substantive responsibility from the start and be involved across a broad range of policy files, from EU funding and industrial policy to the regulatory frameworks for fusion.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Monitor EU policy, regulatory and financial developments, and analyse their impact on Proxima's business to anticipate opportunities and risks.

  • Research and analyse policy issues relevant to fusion energy at EU and international level.

  • Prepare briefings and background documents for meetings with EU policymakers, regulators, government representatives and other stakeholders.

  • Support the development of policy proposals, position papers and consultation responses for European institutions.

  • Support the coordination of government engagement across jurisdictions in Europe and globally, including bilateral meetings, delegation visits and international forums.

  • Support Proxima's participation in industry associations and policy events.

  • Work with Proxima's business and technical teams to keep policy and business priorities aligned, and share policy insights across the company.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Enrolled in or a recent graduate of a degree program in European Studies, Political Science, International Relations, Law, Public Policy, Economics, or a related discipline.

  • Solid understanding of European Union decision-making structures and legislative procedures.

  • Exceptional analytical, drafting, and synthesis capabilities, with a track record of distilling policy subjects into business-language.

  • Full professional proficiency in English. Additional languages preferred.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: iOS Developer
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: IT Helpdesk Specialist
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

  • Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

  • Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

  • Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

  • Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

  • Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

  • Keep our role-based access model clean, and connect new apps to Okta (SAML or OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning) together with system owners and Security.

  • Check every access request for legitimacy and least privilege, and make sure access is right for every joiner, mover, and leaver, including contractors and partners.

  • Act as the European backup for this domain, covering access work during European hours, and grow into co-owning it.

Knowledge and automation

  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

  • Spot repeated requests and fix the cause with a better intake form, an article, or a small automation (Freshservice workflows, n8n, scripts). Use AI tools to research, draft, and script, and check the result before it reaches users.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

  • By day 60: you add or fix knowledge base articles every week, own meeting rooms and event AV in Amsterdam, and handle routine Okta changes on your own.

  • By day 90: you can cover Access & Identity when its owner is away, and you've shipped at least one improvement that removes a recurring type of ticket.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

  • Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

  • Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

  • Meeting room and event AV experience with Zoom Rooms or similar systems, cameras, microphones, and displays, including setting up an event space or a new office together with integrators and vendors.

  • Networking basics: Wi-Fi diagnostics, switching, DHCP, and DNS, enough to find the problem and talk to the vendor.

  • Google Workspace admin basics and experience with a service desk tool (Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar).

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

  • Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

  • You notice when a request looks wrong (say, an urgent password reset for an executive), know when to stop and escalate, and stay friendly and focused on busy days.

  • You fix the cause, not only the ticket: if something happens twice, you find out why and make it stop. You pick up new tools without waiting for training.

  • Availability to work from our Amsterdam office 4–5 days a week, with occasional after-hours support for events or planned changes.

It would be great if you have:

  • An Okta certification (Certified Professional or Administrator) or experience with Okta Workflows.

  • Freshservice administration experience: workflows, catalog items, SLA policies, and reporting.

  • Light scripting or automation skills (Python, bash, n8n, or similar), or a real automation you built yourself, with or without AI help.

  • Git and GitHub basics: branches, pull requests, Markdown.

  • Experience with Q-SYS or similar audio processing, Logitech room systems, and Zoom Rooms administration.

  • Live streaming experience for meetups: multi-camera switching (ATEM, OBS, or similar), audio mixing, and streaming to YouTube.

  • UniFi networking and UniFi Access.

  • A bit of Microsoft Intune for Windows devices.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

title: IT Support Spezialist –  Telematikinfrastruktur & Praxissicherheit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission:

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre IT-Systeme und die Telematikinfrastruktur im Praxisalltag zuverlässig nutzen können. Im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support analysierst du Störungen, findest Lösungen und bist kompetente Ansprechperson rund um TI, Praxissicherheit und IT-Infrastruktur.

Dabei arbeitest du von unserem Standort in Magdeburg aus: Support und technische Unterstützung erfolgen telefonisch und per Fernwartung – Einsätze direkt bei unseren Kund vor Ort gehören nicht zu deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • 1st- & 2nd-Level-Support: Du bearbeitest technische Anfragen telefonisch, per E-Mail und über unser Ticketsystem.

  • IT-Infrastruktur: Du betreust Windows-basierte Clients, Peripheriegeräte, Netzwerke und medizinische Fachsoftware.
  • Systemchecks: Du prüfst Systeme und Infrastruktur regelmäßig und erkennst mögliche Störungen frühzeitig.
  • Installation & Rollouts: Du unterstützt bei der Einrichtung von Arbeitsplatzsystemen sowie bei Software-Rollouts und Migrationen.
  • Dokumentation: Du hältst Supportfälle und Lösungen nachvollziehbar im Ticketsystem fest.
  • IT-Sicherheit: Du achtest auf die Einhaltung unserer Datenschutz- und IT-Sicherheitsstandards und arbeitest bei Bedarf mit externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, IT-Systemelektroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support
  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Windows-Client- und Serverumgebungen
  • Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnologien und -protokollen wie LAN/WLAN, TCP/IP, DNS und DHCP
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Routern, Switches und Firewalls
  • Kenntnisse in Active Directory und Microsoft 365
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Ticketsystemen und Fernwartungstools
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-/C2-Niveau
  • Besonders freuen wir uns, wenn du bereits Erfahrung mit der Telematikinfrastruktur oder dem Thema Praxissicherheit mitbringst.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Du gehst technischen Problemen gern auf den Grund und gibst dich nicht mit der erstbesten Antwort zufrieden. Gleichzeitig weißt du, dass guter IT-Support auch gute Kommunikation bedeutet.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert, bleibst auch bei anspruchsvollen Supportfällen ruhig und erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich. Teamarbeit und ein professioneller Umgang mit unseren Kund sind für dich selbstverständlich.

Wichtig zu wissen:

  • Die Rolle ist bewusst für erfahrene IT-Fachkräfte mit Bezug zum Gesundheitswesen vorgesehen und nicht als Quereinstieg konzipiert.
  • Da du mit unserer technischen Infrastruktur arbeitest und unsere Kund:innen direkt unterstützt, findet die Tätigkeit vor Ort in Magdeburg statt.

Warum die HASOMED-Unternehmensgruppe?

  • Weil funktionierende IT im Gesundheitswesen entscheidend dafür ist, dass Praxen sich auf das konzentrieren können, worauf es wirklich ankommt: ihre Patient.
  • Bei uns verbindest du dein IT-Know-how mit einem Umfeld, in dem zuverlässige Technik und sichere digitale Versorgung unmittelbar zusammengehören.

Wir bieten dir:

  • Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das inspiriert: Unser modernes Gebäude bietet Freiflächen für kreatives Arbeiten, mobile Arbeitsplätze, einen Fitnessraum und ein „Little Office“ für Kids.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Lerne stetig dazu! Wir unterstützen dich mit maßgeschneiderten Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Work-Life-Balance garantiert: 27 Urlaubstage sind dir sicher – auf Wunsch kannst du auf bis zu 32 Tage erweitern.
  • Gesund und gestärkt durch den Tag: Für dein Wohlbefinden sorgen Getränke, frisches Obst, eine Müslibar und leckere Speisen aus unserer firmeneigenen Kantine.
  • Für dich und deine Liebsten: Kinder in liebevollen Händen in unserer betriebseigenen Kita (#Hasokids) und Hunde sind auch willkommen -----
  • Weitere Benefits: Corporate Benefits, Job Bikes und ein nachhaltiges betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement mit spannenden Screenings, Kursen und Trainings.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?

Dann bring dein IT-Know-how dort ein, wo zuverlässige Systeme jeden Tag einen Unterschied machen. Werde Teil von TI4HEALTH und sorge gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen technisch sicher durch ihren Praxisalltag kommen.
