title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Infrastruktur, Netzwerk & Cloud (in Teil- oder Vollzeit)
descriptionHtml:
Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.



IT aus dem Saterland. Wirkung im ganzen Unternehmen.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Doch moderne Technologie braucht eine IT, auf die man sich verlassen kann. Von unserer internen Infrastruktur über Cloud-Dienste und Netzwerke bis zu IoT- und Kundensystemen: Wenn unsere digitalen Systeme sicher und zuverlässig funktionieren, können auch unsere Teams ihre Arbeit machen.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als IT-Systemadministrator betreust und entwickelst du unsere IT-Landschaft weiter. Dabei bist du nicht nur dafür da, dass bestehende Systeme funktionieren. Du bekommst den Freiraum, neue Lösungen einzuführen, Strukturen zu verbessern und Themen wie Cloud, IT-Sicherheit und KI aktiv mitzugestalten.

Du möchtest nicht einfach Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung für eine IT-Umgebung übernehmen und selbst etwas bewegen? Dann werde Emission Partner.

Was du bei uns bewirkst



Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitale Infrastruktur genauso zuverlässig funktioniert wie unsere Technik.

Bei uns erwartet dich eine vielseitige IT-Aufgabe mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Du kümmerst dich um klassische Systemadministration und Netzwerke, beschäftigst dich aber gleichzeitig mit Cloud-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, IoT und neuen technologischen Möglichkeiten.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den unterschiedlichen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens zusammen und entwickelst unsere IT-Landschaft kontinuierlich weiter.

Und weil Digitalisierung bei uns nicht an der Unternehmensgrenze endet, beschäftigst du dich teilweise auch mit den IT- und Netzwerkanforderungen unserer technischen Kundensysteme.

Kurz gesagt: Du hältst nicht nur unsere IT am Laufen. Du entwickelst sie mit uns weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du administrierst, betreibst und entwickelst unsere IT-Infrastruktur, Systeme, Netzwerke und Cloud-Lösungen weiter.
  • Du betreust unsere Netzwerkumgebung und kümmerst dich um Switches, Router, Firewalls, VPN, VLANs und Netzwerksegmentierung.
  • Du planst und implementierst neue IT-Systeme und Anwendungen und integrierst sie in unsere bestehende Infrastruktur.
  • Du überwachst unsere Systeme und sorgst durch Monitoring, Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung für eine stabile und performante Umgebung.
  • Du entwickelst unsere IT-Sicherheit weiter und beschäftigst dich unter anderem mit Zugriffskontrollen, Berechtigungen, Netzwerksicherheit und grundlegenden Anforderungen im Umfeld der ISO 27001.
  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, KI-gestützte Anwendungen und Prozesse sinnvoll und sicher in unseren Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.
  • Du betreust unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei IT-Fragen und findest pragmatische Lösungen für technische Probleme.
  • Du beschäftigst dich auch mit IoT-, Netzwerk- und IT-Komponenten unserer Kundensysteme und unterstützt bei Bedarf remote oder vor Ort bei Inbetriebnahmen und Fehleranalysen.
  • Du arbeitest mit unseren technischen und kaufmännischen Bereichen zusammen und übersetzt Anforderungen in funktionierende IT-Lösungen.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und erhältst den Gestaltungsspielraum, unsere IT technisch und organisatorisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bringst du mit



Uns ist wichtiger, was du kannst und lernen möchtest, als ein perfekter Lebenslauf oder dass du hinter jeder Technologie einen Haken setzen kannst.

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-Bereich abgeschlossen, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, IT-Systemelektroniker oder Informatiker (m/w/d), oder bringst vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung mit.
  • Du kennst dich mit Systemadministration aus und fühlst dich in Windows- und/oder Linux-Umgebungen zu Hause.
  • Netzwerke sind für dich mehr als WLAN: Begriffe wie TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Routing, Switching und Firewall sind dir vertraut.
  • Du hast idealerweise bereits mit Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Entra ID oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Technologien gearbeitet.
  • Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Sicherheit und möchtest diesen Bereich gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln.
  • Du interessierst dich für KI und neue Technologien und möchtest herausfinden, wo sie im Unternehmen echten Mehrwert schaffen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und kannst technische Probleme selbstständig analysieren und lösen.
  • Gleichzeitig kannst du IT so erklären, dass auch Kolleginnen und Kollegen außerhalb der IT dich verstehen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Für gelegentliche Kundentermine besitzt du einen Führerschein der Klasse B.


Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Wir suchen bewusst keinen Menschen, der jedes System und jede Technologie bereits perfekt beherrscht. Wenn du eine gute technische Basis mitbringst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Das bieten wir dir



Natürlich soll nicht nur deine Arbeit zu uns passen, sondern Emission Partner auch zu deinem Leben.

descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The engineering challenge Our Software Engineers don't just write code, they solve real financial problems for millions of customers. You'll work on distributed systems processing thousands of transactions daily, build resilient services that handle people's money, and create experiences that make traditionally complex financial products feel simple.
Your impact:
  • You will focus on shipping great products, not just writing superb code
  • Design and build modern, reliable, scalable microservices
  • Own your services end-to-end, from conception to production monitoring
  • Collaborate directly with product, design and data experts to shape solutions

    • Your toolkit:
  • You'll work with Kotlin, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Aurora Postgres, and other modern technologies. If you haven't worked with all of these, we value skilled engineers with a willingness to learn.
  • A product-focused engineering mindset
  • Experience building distributed systems at scale
  • Test-driven development practices
  • Comfort operating in uncertainty and rapid change
  • Collaborative problem-solving skills

    • Our engineering culture:
  • Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
  • Team success over individual heroics
  • Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
  • Continuous improvement through honest feedback

    • Added bonus:
  • Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds
    • #CG-LI1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Junior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance.

As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You also maintain and improve our agents in production, and build the Claude Code skills that automate operational work and save time for the business team. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering.

Understand what drives performance

  • Explore our conversational and behavioural data, alongside campaign performance

  • Track our key metrics, spot what moves, and find out why

  • Surface the hidden patterns that make recommendations more relevant

Ship your findings to production

  • Turn your findings into improvements to our recommendation algorithms and agents, implemented in production

  • Measure the impact directly with A/B tests, and feed the results into the next iteration

  • Industrialise the analyses you run often into automated pipelines and monitoring, reviewed by the engineering team

Improve our agents in production

  • Maintain and improve our agents: prompts, tools, evaluation, and the code around them

  • Turn client feedback into agent improvements: qualify what they ask for, and ship directly what can be handled at the agent level

Automate operations at scale

  • Build and maintain Claude Code skills that automate operational work at scale and free up time for the business team

Profile

Must-have

  • 0 to 3 years of experience, internships and work-study included. Fresh graduates are welcome.

  • Personal projects where you built LLM agents end to end (prompts, tools, evaluation), or ran a serious data analysis on your own

  • Hands-on prompt engineering: you write, test and iterate on prompts, and you measure whether a change actually made things better

  • Solid SQL and Python for analysis

  • The basics of statistics: you know how to read an A/B test and when not to trust a number

  • You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) every day

  • Rigorous and precise: you check your numbers before you share them

  • Fluent French and professional English

A plus

  • A top engineering, business or data school, in France or abroad

  • AI courses or certifications

  • You have founded something, even small, and got real users or paying customers

  • Hackathons, open source, or side projects that went further than a weekend

  • TypeScript

  • Recommender systems, ranking or applied ML experience

  • E-commerce, advertising, growth or conversion experience

  • BigQuery, dbt, PostHog

What we offer

  • Competitive salary plus equity (BSPCE)

  • You learn next to our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, two of them repeat YC founders

  • A dataset very few people will ever see: 100M+ conversations a month between shoppers and AI agents

  • An AI-first team: Claude Code and agents are part of everyone's daily work

  • Ownership that grows fast: you start by taking real work off our plates, and take on more as you prove yourself

descriptionHtml:

Damit unser Wachstum auch intern erfolgreich weitergeht, möchten wir unser Team verstärken. Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte kaufmännische Persönlichkeit, die bereits Erfahrung im E-Commerce mitbringt, gerne organisiert und Lust hat, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Bei uns erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit kaufmännischen, organisatorischen und koordinierenden Aufgaben. Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle innerhalb unseres Unternehmens und unterstützt sowohl unsere E-Commerce-Abläufe als auch die Organisation unseres Teams.

Deine Entwicklungsperspektive:

Mit zunehmender Einarbeitung und entsprechender Entwicklung übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Langfristig möchten wir dir die Möglichkeit bieten, eine verantwortungsvolle Position im Personalbereich zu übernehmen und die organisatorische sowie personelle Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Dein Profil

Du hast bereits Erfahrung im E-Commerce oder Onlinehandel gesammelt, arbeitest gerne strukturiert und möchtest beruflich den nächsten Schritt machen. Du bist organisiert, kommunikativ und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist, Associate Director (Germany)
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ327R341

Databricks is seeking multiple Lakebase Sales Specialists (Central) to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

This role is based in Munich, Germany (flexible within Germany for the right candidate), and will cover customers in the Central region (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe).

The impact you will have

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

  1. Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
  2. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
  3. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.
  4. Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.
  • Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).
  • Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.
  • Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.
  • Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.
  • Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.
  • Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.
  • Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Lead Engineer - AI-Native Email App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Principal Accountabilities

Platform Architecture and Engineering

  • Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

  • Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

    Infrastructure as Code and Automation 

  • Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero. 

  • Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

    Security, Governance, and Compliance 

  • Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards. 

  • Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence. 

  • Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Integrations (TypeScript)
descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • Opening the US market

The problem

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own

  • The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

  • The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

  • The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

  • The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

  • You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

  • You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

  • Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

  • You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English.

Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move.

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production.

  • First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve.

  • First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

  • 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 2h in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

  • BSPCE.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Lead Software Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Introduction:

No barriers, no paper tickets, just seamless parking powered by software. Our platform keeps thousands of parking lots running every day, from the services in the cloud to the apps our customers and drivers use. As a Lead Software Engineer, you’ll turn ambitious product goals into software that moves our business forward. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to tackle our team’s hardest challenges, raise the bar for quality and delivery, and enable engineers to achieve more together than they could individually.
If you're a passionate engineer with a hunger for continuous improvement and a track record of delivering across the stack, this is your chance to revolutionize the industry and make a direct impact on our dynamic, tech-driven team.


Our Objectives and your Role:

  • Align Engineering with Strategy: Act as a technical counterpart to product and business stakeholders, translating company objectives into engineering initiatives with measurable impact.
  • Shape the Product: Work closely with Product and Design to improve what we build, and ship features end to end, from API to UI, that create real value for our customers.
  • Own Delivery End to End: Take accountability for projects from concept to production and beyond, defining clear scope and milestones, and communicating delivery risks early while maintaining reliability and quality.
  • Champion Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for clean, performant and maintainable code; foster a culture of high standards and technical curiosity.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentoring: Guide engineers through mentorship, coaching and clear technical direction to grow the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Elevate Operational Maturity: Monitor and continuously improve the performance of your systems; lead improvements to observability, CI/CD and developer workflows, ensuring systems are resilient and teams can ship confidently.
  • Embed Security by Design: Take responsibility for the security posture of your systems, ensuring they meet best practices and compliance from the ground up.
  • Be a Force for Innovation: Stay ahead of trends and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development & push those into the department; drive continuous improvement in how we build, scale and operate our systems.

Your Expertise, Skills & Mindset:
  • Real Seniority: Not defined by years of experience but by a drive for continuous improvement, direct business impact, and ownership. You've worked at a senior or lead level and owned production systems end to end.
  • Technical Leadership: Proven experience guiding engineers through mentoring, code reviews and clear technical direction.
  • Strong Engineering Foundation: Strong proficiency in at least one of TypeScript/Node.js, Python or C++, and hands-on experience with the corresponding frameworks, such as NestJS, Fastify, FastAPI or Flask, or Vue.js on the frontend.
  • End-to-End Mindset: Experience shipping product features across the stack, with a solid understanding of both backend concerns (APIs, data models, services, performance) and frontend concerns (UI, usability).
  • Cloud Expertise: Solid understanding of AWS (or a comparable provider) and cloud architecture.
  • CI/CD: Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and containers; experience with Kubernetes or Terraform is a plus.
  • High-Throughput Systems: Experience building and running high-traffic systems in production.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog.
  • Security & Networking: Security Awareness: Good understanding of security best practices in software and the cloud.
  • Agile & Fast-Paced Environments: Experience in agile teams in dynamic, fast-growing tech environments.
  • Excellent Communication: Strong English communication skills (C1+) and the ability to collaborate across teams. German proficiency is not required.

Technologies We Work With:

We embrace modern, cutting-edge technologies to build robust and scalable solutions.

  • Backend: Event-driven microservices  Typescript (NestJS).
  • Frontend: Monorepo powered by Turbo, pnpm, changesets, and Storybook, primarily using Vue.js.
  • IoT: Linux-Based software running in C++, Python, Typescript or Go.
  • Frameworks/Libraries: Adoption of TypeScript, NestJS, BullMQ, and Prisma for backends in an opinionated monorepo approach.
  • Databases: Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, S3.
  • Orchestration & CI/CD: We manage our container orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS), using Keda and Karpenter for dynamic autoscaling. Our CI/CD is powered by GitLab.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for AWS provisioning.
  • Serverless: Leveraging AWS Lambda and the Serverless framework for high-throughput endpoints.

Work Setup:
  • Hours: 40 hours per week (based on trust).
  • Home Office Policy: Enjoy a hybrid model with 3 days in the office / 2 days remote.
  • Contract: A permanent contract for long-term stability.
  • Location: Our modern office in Munich, a vibrant city in the heart of Bavaria.

What We Offer:

We believe in supporting our team with an environment that fosters growth, well-being, and a great work-life balance.

  • Your perks: company pension plan, corporate benefits, and JobRad bike leasing, plus, you can choose between a subsidized Deutschlandticket or an EGYM Wellpass membership.
  • Your flexibility: flexible working hours and the option to temporarily work remotely from within the EU.
  • Your setup: an onboarding experience that gets you up to speed right away, height-adjustable desks, and modern Apple equipment (MacBook (M5 Pro, 48GB Ram) and a 37-inch curved screen) for the perfect start from day one. Plus access to all major frontier AI models, MCP servers, and the agentic tooling you need to do your best work.
  • Your well-being: a healthy energy boost with free snacks (fruit, nuts, muesli), subsidized office catering, and a weekly team lunch.
  • Your fit: a lived start-up mentality in a financially secure and stable environment.

Our Recruiting Process:
  1. Initial Contact: We’ll get back to you within 48 hours.
  2. HR Interview: Discuss your experience and expectations with our HR team.
  3. Live Assessment: Complete a technical exercise designed to challenge you with scenarios beyond your usual experience.
  4. Tech Challenge: Tackle a problem in a familiar context to demonstrate your technical skills and approach.
  5. Leadership Conversation: Dive deeper into the role and expectations with a member of our technical leadership.
  6. On-Site Meeting: Visit our Munich office, meet more of the team, and experience our culture firsthand.
Interested in joining our team? Apply now and be part of something great!

title: Leitung Content & Personal Branding (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

  • Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team.

  • Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen.

  • Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil.

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content.

  • Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €.

  • Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge.

  • Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf.

Was wir bieten

  • 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt.

  • Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events.

  • Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen.

  • Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen.

  • Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events.

So bewirbst du dich

Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil.

descriptionHtml:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. title: Machine Learning Researcher
descriptionHtml:
About Augur

Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

We are looking for an ML Researcher to join our Machine Learning team in London.

This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge research and mission-critical deployment. You will own research directions end-to-end, developing novel algorithms at the intersection of computer vision, deep learning, metric learning, 3D geometry, and vision-language modelling.

You will formulate problems, design experiments, and drive your work from prototype through to production-grade systems that power real-time spatial intelligence across complex environments. We aim to publish at top venues and deploy at scale, and we're looking for researchers who want to do both.

The role includes opportunities to shape Augur's research roadmap, mentor junior researchers and interns, and strengthen our presence in the research community. Work on-site at least two days weekly, specifically one day being a Thursday.

Key Skills

  • Academic Track Record: PhD (or Master's with equivalent research experience) in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related discipline. Published work at leading journals or conferences is considered a strong plus.

  • Core CV & Spatial AI: Deep expertise in areas such as metric learning, multi-view geometry, depth estimation, 3D scene understanding, rendering techniques, feature-based tracking, self-supervised learning, or learning-based mapping and localisation.

  • Engineering Rigor: Strong Python and PyTorch skills; ability to write testable, production-quality code and participate actively in code reviews.

  • Autonomy: Capable of independently formulating research problems, defining technical direction, and communicating findings clearly in both writing and discussion.

Accessibility and inclusivity

At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently.

Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you.

We are committed to fostering a diverse workplace and ensuring an accessible hiring experience - please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process to help you do your best work.

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team partners with our customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of field delivery and internal development, working closely with Product, Research, and Go-To-Market (GTM).

As a foundational FDE manager, you’ll lead FDE through high-stakes, ambiguous customer deployments and own technical and business value outcomes end to end. You’ll grow a team that can operate under pressure and help OpenAI learn from the field.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Research, Sales, and GTM to ensure fieldwork informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale. Your decisions will influence how OpenAI is trusted by the customers closest to our deployment work. Your success will be measured by how consistently your team ships, how clearly you deliver signal to Research and Product, and how durable your team and delivery model prove to be.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. This role also will require travel up to 25%.

title: Manager - Transaction Services
descriptionHtml:
About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

Unity Advisory is a new kind of partner for the office of the CFO. Founded by senior leaders from the world's top advisory firms and backed by Warburg Pincus, we provide integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support: expert advice, sharper execution, and delivery models built around how organisations operate today. CFOs need trusted advisers without legacy complexity, so we pair expert human judgement with proprietary AI workflows and smart automation, free from audit conflicts.

The Role

We built our deals practice around the client's decision: whether to buy, whether to sell, at what price, on what terms. We work alongside our clients rather than at arm's length, in the room while the deal decision is being made, and our support carries on beyond signing: into the 100-day plan, the hold period and the eventual exit. And that support draws on the whole firm: our tax, finance and commercial specialists work as one team with the deals practice, so the advice a client gets after signing is as integrated as the diligence that came before it.

We're looking for a Manager to join our Financial Due Diligence team. You'll run buy-side and sell-side engagements day to day: getting into the numbers, managing the team on the ground, and making sure clients get clear, well-supported findings on time.

You'll bring solid FDD or transaction services experience from a Big 4 or top-tier advisory firm, and own an engagement from scoping through to final findings. You'll work alongside our Partners and Directors and directly with clients and target company management from day one. This is a hybrid role based in our Mayfair office.

What You'll Do

• Manage buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements from scoping through to completion.

• Analyse quality of earnings, net working capital, cash flow and other issues that decide a deal, and turn the findings into a clear, well-supported story for the client.

• Run the engagement team day to day: reviewing work, coaching junior staff, and keeping everyone (including the client) up to speed on progress.

• Interview target company management and build working relationships with clients, private equity investors, and other advisors on the deal.

• Draft and quality-check diligence deliverables so they're accurate, clear, and ready for Director or Partner sign-off.

• Work alongside Unity's data and AI specialists to make our analytics standard practice on every engagement.

• Take part in business development: proposals, pitches, and staying close to opportunities as they arise.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years' experience in Financial Due Diligence or Transaction Services from a Big 4 or top-tier advisory firm.

• Hands-on experience managing buy-side and sell-side FDD assignments from start to finish.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting and the deal issues that matter most: quality of earnings, working capital, and cash flow.

• A track record of being an excellent team player in multidisciplinary engagements.

• Clear and confident communication (both written and verbal) with clients and senior stakeholders.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in how technology and AI evolve financial due diligence practice and playing a key role in shaping it.

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

Nice to Have

• Experience with Private Equity clients or PE-backed portfolio companies.

• Exposure to cross-border or international transactions.

• Experience with data and analytics tools such as Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks.

• Sector experience in areas like TMT, Consumer, Healthcare, Business Services and Industrials.

Additional Information

 

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

 

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

title: Market Access (Senior) Manager, EU Center
descriptionHtml:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Senior Director, Market Access, EU Center and work closely with Medical Affairs, HEOR, Regulatory, Commercial and our global Market Access team to secure and sustain patient access to BridgeBio’s medicines across the DACH region. Your remit is to own the German AMNOG process end to end – from the value dossier under § 35a SGB V through the reimbursement price negotiation with the National Association of Statutory Health Insurance Funds (GKV-Spitzenverband) under § 130b SGB V – and regional market access, which turns that outcome into real-world access through direct engagement with sickness funds, the Medical Service, regional physicians’ associations, hospitals and treating centres. You will also lead reimbursement submissions in Austria and Switzerland. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep AMNOG and HTA expertise with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead AMNOG value dossiers end to end: plan, resource, quality-assure and submit complete dossiers under § 35a SGB V to the Federal Joint Committee (G-BA), including derivation of the appropriate comparator therapy (zVT), early identification of evidence gaps and defensible argumentation on indirect comparisons, surrogate and subgroup analyses
  • Own G-BA and IQWiG interactions: prepare scientific advice requests under § 8 AM-NutzenV, run written commenting procedures and oral hearings, and manage all procedural communication and timelines
  • Prepare and support price negotiations: develop pricing strategy, negotiation mandate, scenarios and European reference price analyses for the negotiation with the GKV-Spitzenverband under § 130b SGB V, and plan realistically for arbitration board risk
  • Drive regional payer engagement: engage sickness funds at federal and regional level, the Medical Service (MD) and regional physicians’ associations (KVen) on reimbursement, cost-efficiency reviews and prior-authorisation practice, and translate those insights into regional access concepts
  • Secure hospital and clinic reimbursement: advise treating centres on NUB applications, DRG and additional-payment (ZE) mapping, budget and price negotiations, drug committees and formulary listing, including outpatient care via ASV under § 116b SGB V
  • Resolve access barriers in the field: handle individual reimbursement requests, denials and claw-backs together with Medical Affairs and the field teams, and turn recurring issues into argumentation aids and training material
  • Extend access beyond Germany: lead reimbursement submissions in Austria (EKO) and Switzerland (FOPH Specialities List), and bring market access requirements into study design, evidence planning and launch planning across the cross-functional team

Where You’ll Work 

  • This is a Germany-based remote role
  • Approximately 20% travel is anticipated – for G-BA and GKV-Spitzenverband meetings in Berlin, regional payer and hospital meetings across Germany, selected meetings in Austria and Switzerland, and as-needed visits to our International HQ in Zug

Who You Are

  • Degree in health economics, pharmacy, medicine, life sciences or a comparable field
  • 5–8 years of experience in market access or HTA – in the pharmaceutical industry, a consultancy or a specialised HTA service provider
  • Demonstrated experience preparing AMNOG value dossiers under § 35a SGB V, ideally as project lead on at least one complete procedure, plus hands-on involvement in a reimbursement price negotiation under § 130b SGB V
  • Solid command of G-BA and IQWiG methodology, procedural rules and statutory timelines, with the ability to appraise clinical evidence critically and translate it into payer-ready argumentation
  • Experience engaging payers and/or hospitals directly on reimbursement matters, and the confidence to lead those conversations yourself; knowledge of German hospital financing (NUB, DRG, additional payments) and of reimbursement in Austria and Switzerland is a strong plus
  • Strong written argumentation and the ability to work autonomously in an environment where some processes are still being built; experience with orphan drugs or a limited evidence base is an advantage
  • Business-fluent German and English
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% of working time

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems.

  • Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements.

  • Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator.

  • Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha.

  • Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes.

  • Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential).

  • Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with and manage external suppliers, with multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced, dynamic settings.

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-45 min)

  • Portfolio Presentation & Review (45-60 min)

  • Technical Panel Interviews (2x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation.

This role sits at L2/L3/L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Mobile Application Developer - AI Neobank App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
