title: Mobile Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

Your impact:

We’re hiring Mobile Product Engineers across different levels of experience, from junior to staff level engineers. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your career or already have experience leading complex technical projects, we’d love to hear from you. Your scope and level will reflect your experience and the impact you can bring.

As a Mobile Product Engineer, you’ll help shape what we build and own work from understanding the problem through to release and improvement. You’ll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete mobile experience.

What you will do:

  • Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building.
  • Own complete features: Turn problems into practical solutions across clients, services and data. Take work through testing, release and improvement, paying attention to usability, performance and behaviour in production.
  • Build effectively with agents: Define clear tasks, provide context and evaluate generated code. Investigate failures, challenge suggestions and make changes yourself when needed.
  • Improve how software gets built: Turn recurring problems into better agent instructions, tests, tools and automated safeguards. Share improvements that help the whole team.
  • Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness.

What you will bring:

  • Experience delivering production software: You can explain the problems you solved, the decisions you made and what you learned from maintaining your work after release.
  • Technical depth and adaptability: You have strong expertise in Mobile Development (Android, iOS or both) and can contribute beyond it. You don’t need equal expertise in every layer, but you understand how your work interacts with the wider system.
  • Practical capability with coding agents: You’ve used agents to deliver working software and can explain how you guide them, improve unsuccessful approaches and verify their output.
  • Code fluency and engineering judgement: You can navigate unfamiliar code, trace behaviour, diagnose problems and make precise changes. You can assess an implementation regardless of who — or what — wrote it.
  • Product judgement: You connect technical choices to user needs, care about the quality of the experience and distinguish a useful reduction in scope from a shortcut that puts users at risk.
  • Ownership and collaboration: You move work forward through uncertainty, explain trade-offs clearly, seek out expertise and take responsibility for the outcome.
  • Technical leadership: You’ve led complex projects through ambiguous requirements, made decisions with lasting consequences and helped other engineers develop their judgement while remaining hands-on.

Our mobile teams work with Swift and SwiftUI on iOS, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android, and Rust for cross-platform mobile development. You may bring depth in iOS or Android, or experience across both—there’s no expectation that you know every technology we use. The mix of platform focus and cross-platform work varies by team, and we value strong fundamentals and your ability to learn.

What we offer:

  • Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.
  • A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.
  • Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work.
  • Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one.
  • Employee Benefits: Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support.
  • Stock Options: From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
  • In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office.
  • Transport: We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — whichever works for you.
  • Flexible Working: You own your schedule. Outcomes matter more than clock-in times.

Compensation range:

  • Compensation will be discussed during the interview process.
  • We're hiring across multiple experience levels for this position. Your level and compensation will be determined based on your skills, experience and performance throughout the interview process.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion:

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate privacy notice:

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton AG ("Proton," "we," "us," or "our"), we store and process your information using Greenhouse, our recruitment platform. Two privacy policies apply to this information, together:

  • Greenhouse's Service Privacy Policy, which governs how Greenhouse, as our data processor, handles and secures the information within their platform.
  • Proton's Recruitment & Hiring Privacy Notice, which governs how we, as the data controller, use, retain, and manage your information.

We use your information to evaluate your suitability for the role you've applied for. We also retain it to consider you for future roles that may align with your background and skills, unless you ask us not to.

Once we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will delete or anonymize it. If you have questions about how we use or manage your data, or if you'd like to access, correct, or delete it, contact our privacy team at Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates, and we will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited submission, even if the candidate is later hired by Proton.

Benefits:

title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
descriptionHtml:
Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit.

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Monday 2 November 2026, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

  • Working effectively with others

  • Organisation and the ability to follow processes

  • Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

  • Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

  • Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

  • Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

  • Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

  • Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

  • Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

  • Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.

Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

We offer:

  • Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience

  • Opportunities for training and professional development

  • Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment

  • The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare

  • The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Join Us?

Assessment Centre: Monday 2 November 2026

Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire

If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now to be considered for a place at our Pharmacy Assessment Centre.

Following an initial review of applications, shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the assessment centre, including timings, location details and what to expect on the day.

title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen.

Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir.

Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise.

Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit.

Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst.

Das bringst du mit

Background

Skills und Qualifikationen:

  • Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl.

  • Du bist stark in Organisation und Koordination und kannst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig souverän steuern.

  • Erfahrung aus Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Projektmanagement ist ein Plus.

Mindset

Hospitality & Service: Du hast Freude daran, dass sich andere willkommen und gut aufgehoben fühlen, und hast ein Auge für die Details, die den Unterschied machen.

Ownership & Hands-on: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest pragmatische Lösungen – selbst oder mit den richtigen Leuten.

Organisation & Ruhe: Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt.

Gut zu wissen:
Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) und wird vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office ausgeübt, so bist du mittendrin im Team und im täglichen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Deinen Starttermin stimmen wir flexibel mit dir ab.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir

 

Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit im Office Management

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Operational Excellence & Procedures Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

As a member of Allica’s Operational Excellence and Procedures team, you’ll help Operations make better decisions and deliver better outcomes through data. You’ll turn operational information into clear insight that helps teams understand performance, answer business questions and identify where to improve. You’ll also help good improvement ideas become well evidenced opportunities for change, giving Product teams the information they need to assess and prioritise them.

You’ll make a lasting difference by building trusted reporting and helping colleagues become more confident and self-sufficient with data. This role would suit a business analyst or junior project manager who enjoys connecting business needs with data and technology, and thrives in a fast-moving environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Build and develop reports in Looker that give Operations reliable, relevant insight not just access to pre-built dashboards.

  • Investigate operational questions, uncover trends and explain what the data means, so teams can make informed decisions and take action.

  • Work with colleagues to understand business needs and translate them into clear reporting, business and technical requirements.

  • Manage the assessment process for BAU operational excellence ideas, helping quantify their potential value and impact.

  • Share clear, consistent assessments with Product teams to support informed prioritisation.

  • Help Operations colleagues interpret data, build their data literacy and answer more questions independently.

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, processes and the way operational information is used.

  • Stay focused and deliver useful outcomes as priorities shift and the business changes.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Highly data literate, with the curiosity to explore the detail, challenge assumptions and find meaningful answers in data.

  • Experienced in building reports with Looker.

  • A clear communicator who can make data understandable and useful for a range of audiences.

  • Able to gather requirements and bridge the needs of business stakeholders and technical teams.

  • A practical problem solver who can structure ambiguous questions and turn findings into recommendations.

  • Self-motivated and organised, with the judgement to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Collaborative and keen to help others become more confident and self-sufficient with data.

  • Banking operations experience is a bonus.

  • Experience as a business analyst, junior project manager or in a similar role connecting business requirements with technical delivery would be valuable.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Partner Sales Director
descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Responsible for owning and accelerating strategic relationships with Zip's Global System Integrator (GSI) partners, with a primary focus on building out meaningful Zip practices within these firms that drive transformational outcomes for customers. This role requires developing and executing comprehensive joint go-to-market strategies, enabling partners to successfully sell and deliver Zip implementations, and driving mutual revenue growth through deep collaboration. The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of building revenue-generating practices with GSI partners, a deep understanding of the enterprise SaaS ecosystem and partner dynamics, a strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, and the ability to operate at both a strategic and tactical level.

You Will

  • Strategic Partnership Leadership: Own the end-to-end relationship strategy and execution for a portfolio of strategic GSI partners; develop and maintain strong, executive-level relationships with partner leadership; define partnership goals, establish QBR cadence, and drive accountability to shared objectives.

  • Sales Organization Leadership: Operate as an embedded leader within the Enterprise sales organization on strategic partnership deals; work directly with AEs throughout sales cycles to position partners, facilitate stakeholder engagement, and drive joint wins; develop repeatable playbooks from deal execution and translate partner feedback into product and GTM insights.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Legal, and Customer Success teams to execute partnership initiatives and ensure seamless delivery of joint value propositions.

  • Practice Development: Build out meaningful Zip practices within GSI firms across advisory, implementation, and managed services offerings

  • Revenue Generation & Pipeline Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive joint GTM plans that drive mutual value, including partner-sourced opportunities for Zip and services revenue for partners; collaborate with Zip's Enterprise sales team to identify and attach partners to strategic opportunities; design co-selling playbooks and engagement models.

  • Performance Management & Reporting: Identify and track relevant metrics of success to measure partnership health and business impact; provide regular updates to senior leadership on partnership status, pipeline, closed business, and strategic initiatives; analyze the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and refine strategy.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in enterprise software sales, alliances, channel and/or partnerships, including 5+ years owning relationships with GSIs (Accenture, Deloitte etc.) and/or regional SIs.

  • A track record of building or scaling a GSI/RSI practice from within a SaaS platform, or growing a practice inside a GSI/RSI around an emerging technology provider. Success looks like trained and certified practitioners, repeat implementations, partner-sourced pipeline and partner services revenue.

  • Deep experience across Europe, including the UK and continental markets. This includes working across country and practice leaders and coordinating regional execution with global relationship owners.

  • Executive presence with client and partner leadership stakeholders, and the ability to move between strategy (practice investment, joint business plans) and tactics (deal-level support, QBRs, pipeline reviews).

  • Enterprise sales experience, direct or indirect, closing complex multi-stakeholder deals. You are comfortable working inside the sales cycle alongside AEs, not just managing partners from the side.

  • Proven pipeline build and referral: partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline with clear attribution, and the discipline to separate leading indicators like attachment from qualified closed-won revenue.

  • Hands-on co-sell and delivery experience: joint account plans, co-scoping, partner-led implementations, and enablement and certification programs that produce independent delivery capacity.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in procurement, source-to-pay, finance transformation or ERP ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba).

  • Experience enabling partners on AI and automation offerings.

  • Prior experience as the first or only partner hire in a region, and additional European languages.

title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
descriptionHtml:
Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux.

Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles.

Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe.

Nos valeurs

Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler.

1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

2. Chacun fait la différence

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

Le poste

Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team.

  • Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison.

  • Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX.

  • Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps.

  • Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques.

  • Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille.

  • Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres.

Ton profil

Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe.

Indispensable

  • Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web.

  • Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale.

  • Un français écrit impeccable.

  • La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général.

  • Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire.

  • Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique.

Un plus

  • Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent).

  • Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles.

  • CVE, articles, talks, outils open source.

Avantages

Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre.

Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités.

  • Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk.

  • Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail.

  • Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris.

  • Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant.

Le process

C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

The role

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defense for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to UK labor laws, employment standards, site-specific contracts, and safety protocols.

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office.

  • Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants.

  • Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use.

  • Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

 

Compliance

 

  • Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

Immigration and visas

  • Manage Skilled Worker and other visa applications from assessment to approval, partnering with our external immigration lawyers.

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand into Europe.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process.

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance through fair, well-documented processes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

title: Performance Marketing Manager - SEA (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

At Sunday Natural, we’re on a mission to bring premium wellness products to millions of customers across Europe. As we accelerate our growth, Performance Marketing becomes one of our most important levers for scaling our brand and unlocking new markets.

As our Performance Marketing Manager – SEA (all genders), you will play a key role in taking our paid search activities to the next level, combining deep SEA expertise with a strong focus on the entire customer journey.

  

Your role:

You will independently manage and optimise our Google Ads campaigns, from keyword strategies and bidding to continuous performance analysis and testing.

Going beyond traditional campaign management, you will work closely with our CRO team to identify and implement landing page improvements, run experiments and optimise the entire conversion journey – turning more clicks into customers.

Your mandate: Turn every click into an opportunity for growth – building a smarter, more efficient and scalable customer acquisition engine for Sunday Natural.

  

Your Responsibilities & Impact

Google Ads Management & Performance Optimisation

  • Campaign Ownership: Independently manage, monitor and optimise Google Ads campaigns, with a strong focus on Search Advertising, campaign structures, keywords, bidding strategies and ad copy.

  • Continuous Optimisation: Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on advertising spend through structured testing and ongoing performance analysis.

  • Keyword Strategy: Conduct in-depth keyword research, identify relevant search trends and continuously refine targeting and messaging to maximise campaign effectiveness.


Conversion Rate Optimisation & Customer Journey

  • Landing Page & Funnel Optimisation: Analyse landing page performance and customer journeys, working closely with our CRO team to identify conversion barriers and improve content, messaging and conversion elements.

  • Testing & Experimentation: Develop data-driven hypotheses, contribute to A/B tests and translate results into actionable improvements that increase conversion rates.


Analytics, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Performance Analytics: Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends and translate campaign data into clear recommendations for further optimisation.

  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain meaningful dashboards and reporting structures using tools such as Looker Studio and Excel.

  • Partner Collaboration: Coordinate with external marketing partners, align on campaign performance and ensure transparent reporting and continuous improvement.

 

What You Bring:

  • Education & Analytical Foundation: Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, developed through education and/or professional experience.

  • Industry and Channel Know-How: 3–4+ years of hands-on SEA / Performance Marketing experience, gained in an agency or in-house environment, ideally within B2C or D2C. Deep Google Ads expertise, with a proven ability to independently manage, optimise and scale campaigns end-to-end. Experience in nutrition, food or supplements is a strong plus.

  • Analytical Mindset & Reporting: You confidently analyse performance data, translate insights into actionable improvements and build meaningful reports and dashboards using Excel, Looker Studio or comparable tools.

  • Conversion Focus: You understand the relationship between advertising, landing pages and conversion rates. Experience with CRO, A/B testing or landing page optimisation is a strong plus.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You work independently, proactively identify opportunities and take ownership of measurable results.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, present insights clearly and manage external partners effectively.

  • Language Skills: Excellent German (C1 level) and strong English communication skills.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Photonics Layout Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can't get anywhere else. We're a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Photonic Layout Engineer to join our Photonics team and contribute to the physical design, verification and development of advanced integrated photonic devices.

You will work closely with engineers across photonic design, layout and testing, helping translate device and circuit requirements into robust, fabrication-ready layouts. The role will involve a combination of physical layout, design verification, programming and continuous improvement of our internal design workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of integrated photonics, semiconductor design and software. You should be comfortable working through complex layout challenges, interpreting design requirements and using programming to improve the speed, quality and repeatability of engineering work.

Depending on your experience, you may join at Mid or Senior level. We are particularly interested in people who have worked on integrated photonics or semiconductor IC layout, whether in industry, research or a strong academic environment.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop physical layouts for integrated photonic components, structures and larger photonic designs

  • Translate photonic device and circuit requirements into fabrication-ready layouts

  • Perform design verification, including DRC and LVS

  • Support designs through the full layout and verification process

  • Develop and improve software-based workflows for photonic layout and design automation

  • Use Python and relevant semiconductor or photonic design tools to create, manipulate and verify layouts

  • Maintain and contribute to internal component and design libraries

  • Support the development of appropriate test and characterisation structures

  • Review layouts for design integrity, fabrication constraints and potential sources of failure

  • Collaborate closely with photonic design, testing and wider engineering teams

  • Contribute to improvements in layout methodology, tooling and verification processes

  • Help make photonic design workflows increasingly repeatable, reliable and efficient

Over time, you will take ownership of increasingly complex layout work, progressing from individual components and structures through to larger integrated photonic designs and full design verification.

What we're looking for

  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or another closely related technical discipline

  • Relevant experience in integrated photonics, photonic IC layout, semiconductor IC layout or design verification

  • Hands-on experience creating physical IC or photonic layouts using Python or other layout and EDA software

  • Strong programming capability, ideally with experience in Python or another relevant programming language

  • The ability to explain and discuss software or coding projects you have worked on in detail

  • A good understanding of integrated photonics or the broader semiconductor IC industry

  • Working knowledge of photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • An understanding of how physical layout decisions interact with device design, fabrication and performance

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing layouts and resolving verification issues

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs

For more experienced candidates, we would typically expect around two or more years of relevant work in integrated photonics or IC layout and verification. Candidates with particularly strong academic, research or project experience may also be considered where they can demonstrate the required practical capability.

Even better if you

  • A Master's degree or PhD in integrated photonics, photonics, electrical engineering, physics or a related discipline

  • Hands-on experience with Python-based layout automation

  • Experience with photonic or semiconductor EDA tools

  • Familiarity with common integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and fabrication technologies

  • Experience developing or maintaining component or PDK libraries

  • Previous involvement in photonic or semiconductor design cycles

  • Experience working with DRC and LVS verification

  • Experience working within a commercial product development environment

  • A background in photonic device design or semiconductor process development

Relevant backgrounds could include integrated photonics design and layout teams, silicon photonics research groups, university or research institute environments, or semiconductor IC layout and verification teams.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across photonics, semiconductor engineering and software, with meaningful ownership over the quality and effectiveness of physical design.

You will join a highly collaborative engineering environment where you can influence not just individual designs, but also the methods, tools and processes used to develop advanced photonic hardware.

The role is based in the UK on a hybrid basis, with three days per week on site.

title: Platform Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Platform Engineering Teams

Our Platform Engineering team builds and operates the cloud infrastructure, automation, and deployment systems that power Wayve’s software development. Working primarily with Azure, the team creates reliable, scalable, and secure platforms that help engineers develop, test, and release software efficiently. You’ll collaborate with teams across Wayve that are advancing embodied AI and autonomous driving.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll build, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure across development, testing, and production environments. You’ll automate infrastructure provisioning, support CI/CD pipelines, monitor platform performance, and troubleshoot issues affecting reliability or delivery. You’ll also work closely with engineering teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Cloud infrastructure and services, primarily within Azure

  • Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform and Ansible

  • Cloud-based CI/CD pipelines and deployment systems

  • Containerised workloads and orchestration platforms

  • Monitoring, observability, security, and cost optimisation

  • Incident response, root-cause analysis, and operational automation

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have 2–5 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or a related role

  • You have hands-on experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP

  • You’ve worked with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible

  • You’re familiar with CI/CD systems and cloud-based deployment pipelines

  • You understand networking, cloud architecture, and system reliability fundamentals

  • You’re a collaborative problem-solver who enjoys troubleshooting complex systems and reducing manual work through automation

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

• Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes) — motivation, communication, relevant DevOps and CI/CD experience, Wayve fit, and logistics.

• Competency interview (45 minutes) — hiring manager discussion covering role fit, technical breadth, problem-solving, ownership, and collaboration.

• Deep-dive technical interviews (approximately 3 hours total) — programming, system design, and an SDO domain interview covering build systems, CI/CD infrastructure, automation, Linux, Git, scripting, distributed execution, caching, and artifact management.

• Final interview (60 minutes) — conversation with a director focused on Wayve’s mission and values, operating style, stakeholder communication, and long-term potential.We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

title: Platform Operations Lead

Platform Operations Lead

Company Description

Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-enabled platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs and GPs in the private markets secondaries ecosystem. Our Liquidity Hub enables leading wealth management platforms and their advisors to run secondary sales for their clients, from listing and bidding through to closing, and we are expanding transaction execution through our own US broker-dealer. By combining deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure, we unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets.

Role Overview

The Platform Operations Lead will own the operational lifecycle of transactions on Tangible's platform, from listing through to final execution. The role covers deal setup on the platform, preparation and launch of liquidity windows, support through bidding and award, and execution through closing, settlement and fee collection.

As transaction volumes and our partner network grow, the Platform Operations Lead will drive the continued development of our operating model, refining processes, standardising partner playbooks and shaping the platform tooling that supports scale.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role, combining day-to-day management of a live transaction pipeline with ongoing process improvement. The role works across European and US hours and requires strong overlap with both.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the operational lifecycle of transactions on the platform, from deal setup and listing through bidding, award, closing, settlement and fee collection.

  • Prepare and launch liquidity windows with Product and our partners, and onboard buyers across partner platforms.

  • Manage a pipeline of parallel transactions against partner timelines, coordinating documentation, KYC and fund administrator review through to settlement.

  • Act as an operational point of contact for partners, GPs, fund administrators, buyers, sellers and their advisors.

  • Ensure every transaction runs within our broker-dealer's compliance framework, with complete, audit-ready records.

  • Work with Finance to invoice and collect fees on completed transactions.

  • Develop and maintain SOPs, partner playbooks and operating metrics.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on requirements, testing and internal tooling, and apply AI tools to automate operational work.

Requirements

  • 4 to 7 years' experience in transaction operations, deal execution or fund operations in private markets.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and confidence working directly with clients and institutional counterparties.

  • A track record of managing multiple live transactions against fixed deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.

  • Experience designing and improving operational processes.

  • Familiarity with KYC/AML requirements.

  • Proficiency with workflow platforms, e-signature tools and structured trackers, and an interest in applying AI tools to operations.

  • Willingness to obtain FINRA qualifications (SIE, Series 63 and Series 82), with company support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of the secondary transaction lifecycle, including LP interest transfers: purchase and sale agreements, transfer and subscription agreements, capital account statements, GP consent and fund administrator workflows.

  • Experience at a secondaries platform or advisor, wealth platform, placement agent, fund administrator or transfer agent.

  • Experience in US broker-dealer operations or compliance, or existing FINRA registrations.

  • Experience with auction or window-based secondary processes, or with feeder and evergreen funds held by individual investors.

  • Reporting or data skills (SQL, Metabase or advanced spreadsheets).

title: PowerPlatform engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid, with one day a week in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office


About us


Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role


Power Platform gives people across Seccl a faster way to build the tools they need. We’re hiring a Power Platform engineer to make it work even harder, reporting to the AI-Automation Engineering Manager in our AI-Automation team. As more people build on the platform, we need someone to set the standards and make sure it’s secure, reliable and genuinely valuable.

You’ll look after our Power Platform Centre of Excellence. That means knowing who’s building what, where and with which connectors, keeping the platform tidy and secure, and making sure changes reach production safely. You’ll also build the bigger solutions that need proper engineering. Working with the product team, you’ll decide when Power Platform is the right tool, then take the work from requirements through to release.

What makes this role interesting is the mix. One week you might be running an ‘App in a Day’ session for colleagues, and the next you could be using AI to improve automation, insight and decision making. You’ll be the person the business turns to for Power Platform knowledge, so your work shapes how everyone builds.


What you’ll own


• Grow the Power Platform Centre of Excellence, so teams can build faster with governance built in

• Manage releases and environments through a proper application lifecycle, so changes reach production safely

• Keep the platform lean and secure, with only the apps and flows it needs, and spot security risks early

• Build the solutions that matter most, from requirements through to testing and release, with the product team

• Champion citizen development through office hours, mentoring and practical guidance colleagues will actually use

• Report on what the platform delivers and find new ways to extend what it can do

This role’s for you if...


• You’ve delivered high-quality solutions in fast-paced, agile teams, including iterative development and continuous delivery

• You know Power Apps (model-driven apps), Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows) and Dataverse well enough to design and build with them

• You’ve built and governed Power Platform solutions before, and you know how to keep them secure, reliable and well organised as they grow

• You enjoy helping people learn, whether that’s running sessions, mentoring colleagues or writing guidance people actually read

• You have a broad understanding of the Power Platform and can explain it clearly to colleagues who aren’t technical

Desirable: a good understanding of Power BI, Power Pages and Power Platform observability, plus experience of the Power Platform SDLC. Experience applying AI or intelligent automation to workflows, decisions or user experience is valued too.

Certifications such as AB-100 and AB-400 are a plus, but equivalent experience building and governing Power Platform solutions counts just as much. Experience with Azure Pipelines or AWS, JavaScript or TypeScript, automated testing or automated releasing would be a real bonus.


This role isn’t for you if...


• You’d rather work on your own. A big part of this job is helping others build well, which means running sessions, answering questions and mentoring people.

• You want to say yes to everything. Governance is part of the job, so you’ll sometimes steer people towards a better approach or push back on a quick fix to keep the platform secure.

• You need clear requirements before you start. Many requests arrive half formed, and part of your work is shaping them into something worth building with the product team.


What’s in it for you


We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 A salary between £55 000 and £75 000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture


We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.


Interview process


Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

• Talent screen: a first conversation with our talent team about your experience and what you’re looking for.

• Hiring manager interview: a competency-based conversation with the hiring manager about how you’ve worked and what you’ve delivered.

• Technical interview: a conversation with our technical team about how you’ve built and governed Power Platform solutions.

• Bar raiser interview: a conversation with someone from outside the team, who helps make sure we hire to a high standard.

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.


Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £55K – £75K

title: Principal AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React)

At Mitratech, we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team. HotDocs is Mitratech’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts.

You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role.

About the Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will:

  •       Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap.
  •       Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability.
  •       Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery.
  •       Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments.
  •       Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability.
  •       Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance.
  •       Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver.
  •       Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers.
  •       Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility.

 

About You

You are:

  •       A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers.
  •       An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype.
  •       Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition.
  •       Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model.
  •       Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded: You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

  •       12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role.
  •       Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineering role.
  •       Demonstrable experience designing and shipping production AI solutions - LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, and agentic or tool-calling systems.
  •       Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, or equivalent) and with orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel.
  •       Experience building and maintaining REST APIs.
  •       Proficiency with Entity Framework and Azure SQL (or SQL Server).
  •       Experience evaluating and improving AI system quality - test sets, benchmarking, human review loops, and handling non-deterministic behavior.
  •       Understanding of web applications and AI-specific security, including secure coding, prompt injection, and safe handling of sensitive customer data.
  •       Experience using Git and collaborating through modern workflows (e.g., pull requests, branching strategies).
  •       Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar).
  •       Comfortable working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  •       Practical experience using AI tooling within the SDLC (e.g. coding assistants, agentic developer tools) and a view on how to adopt it well across a team.
  •       A track record of technical leadership - mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing roadmap and architecture decisions.

Nice to Have

  •       Deeper AI specialism in areas such as SLMs and fine-tuning, CAG, vector databases, AI observability, multi-agent systems, or AI/ML pipelines.
  •       Experience with Microsoft Office Addins (office.js / VSTO)
  •       Familiarity of .NET Framework / WPF
  •       Experience with authentication standards such as OAuth and SSO.
  •       Exposure to distributed caching (e.g., Redis)
  •       Knowledge of Linux environments and containerization (Docker).
  •       Scripting in PowerShell.
  •       Familiarity with performance tuning and application diagnostics.
  •       Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation tooling.
  •       Previous experience in enterprise SaaS or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., legaltech, fintech), particularly applying AI to document, contract, or natural language workloads.

What We Offer

  •       A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work culture.
  •       The chance to shape an AI strategy end to end, from architecture through to production, at enterprise scale.
  •       Opportunities to grow your technical skills and career path.
  •       Remote-first flexibility with optional in-person collaboration sessions.
  •       Competitive benefits and a chance to impact how global organizations automate critical legal and compliance workflows.

Join Us

Ready to lead the application of AI to document automation at enterprise scale? Apply now to join Mitratech’s innovative, inclusive, and driven HotDocs engineering team.
