title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

title: Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

As Sales Manager at Artificial, you'll own new business growth across specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers in Germany and the broader DACH region. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll build pipeline, run the sales process end to end, and close deals with senior stakeholders who are rethinking how their underwriting and claims operations run.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and manage a pipeline of specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers across Germany/DACH (and, over time, wider Europe)

  • Build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders - Chief Underwriting Officers, Heads of Digital/IT, and other economic buyers

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to share market feedback and shape go-to-market strategy for the region and beyond

About you

  • A track record of success in B2B SaaS sales, ideally selling into insurance, financial services, or complex enterprise software

  • Existing relationships or experience within the European (re)insurance market are a strong plus

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Based in Germany, remote, with willingness to travel within Europe as the role requires

  • A consistent history of meeting or exceeding quota

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

descriptionHtml:

Täglich erreichen uns Menschen, die ihre Steuerberatung verändern wollen. Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen und Unternehmen, die sich digitale Abläufe, klare Preise und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit wünschen.

Deine Aufgabe: verstehen, was sie brauchen, unser Angebot verständlich machen und sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Entscheidung begleiten.

Über uns

b’steuern ist keine klassische Kanzlei.

Wir beraten Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen, Interim Manager:innen und Unternehmen bis 100 Mio. Euro Umsatz. Dabei arbeiten wir voll digital, entwickeln eigene Tech- und KI-Lösungen und hinterfragen konsequent, was Steuerberatung unnötig kompliziert macht.

Unser Ziel: So einfach wie möglich für alle Beteiligten – mit der Kraft von Tech und KI.

Was uns besonders macht:

  • Radikal digital: Wir setzen auf moderne Software, KI und eigene Tech-Lösungen, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren.

  • Radikal kundenfokussiert: Unsere Mandant:innen bekommen transparente Pakete, klare Preise und verständliche Kommunikation.

  • Radikal selbstorganisiert: Unsere Teams übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten ihre Zusammenarbeit aktiv mit.

  • Remote-first: Wir arbeiten verteilt und haben ein Office in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Ambitioniertes Wachstum: Wir wollen die Steuerberatung grundlegend weiterentwickeln – und suchen Menschen, die diese Reise mitgestalten.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die erste persönliche Stimme, die neue Mandant:innen bei b’steuern hören.

Unsere Interessent:innen haben sich bereits bewusst bei uns gemeldet. Du greifst ihr Interesse auf und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen heraus, ob unser Angebot zu ihrem Bedarf passt.

In einem 30-minütigen Video-Call lernst du sie und ihr Unternehmen kennen, erfasst ihre Ausgangslage und erstellst live ein passendes Angebot. Du erklärst unsere Leistungen, beantwortest Fragen und machst die nächsten Schritte klar.

Auch danach bleibst du dran: Du fasst freundlich nach, koordinierst offene Punkte und sorgst bei einer Zusage für eine gute Übergabe an unser Onboarding-Team. Fachliche Fragen klärst du gemeinsam mit unseren Steuerprofis.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kennenlerngespräche führen: Du sprichst in 30-minütigen Video-Calls mit Interessent:innen und verstehst ihre Situation, Erwartungen und Bedürfnisse.

  • Angebote live erstellen: Du stellst passende Leistungen zusammen und erklärst transparent, was enthalten ist und was sie kosten.

  • Entscheidungen begleiten: Du beantwortest Rückfragen, klärst Details und fasst verbindlich nach, wenn noch etwas offen ist.

  • Telefonisch unterstützen: Du bist auch außerhalb der Video-Calls ansprechbar und hilfst Interessent:innen beim nächsten Schritt.

  • CRM zuverlässig pflegen: Du dokumentierst Gespräche, hältst Informationen aktuell und behältst Angebote und Follow-ups im Blick.

  • Übergaben organisieren: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team und unseren Steuerberater:innen zusammen, damit neue Mandant:innen gut bei uns starten.

  • Abläufe verbessern: Du bringst Erfahrungen aus deinen Gesprächen ein und hilfst uns, Angebote, Kommunikation und Sales-Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, fragst gezielt nach und erklärst verständlich. Im Video-Call und am Telefon trittst du freundlich und sicher auf.

  • Verständnis für Unternehmertum: Du kannst dich in Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen und Unternehmer:innen hineinversetzen und interessierst dich für ihren Alltag.

  • Neugier auf steuerliche Themen: USt-Voranmeldung, EÜR oder Bilanz musst du zum Einstieg nicht im Detail beherrschen. Du willst aber verstehen, worum es geht und welche Fragen du an unsere Steuerprofis weitergibst.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du organisierst deine Arbeit, setzt Prioritäten und bringst offene Themen zum Abschluss.

  • Technologisches Interesse: Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools und hast Lust, KI sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag einzubauen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Erfahrung in Sales, Kundenberatung oder Customer Success ist willkommen. Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen verstehst, schnell lernst und zuverlässig dranbleibst.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Interessent:innen mit echtem Bedarf: Du sprichst mit Menschen, die sich bereits bei uns gemeldet haben und sich für unsere Leistungen interessieren.

  • Eine zentrale Rolle: Du prägst den ersten persönlichen Eindruck von b’steuern und trägst direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei.

  • Flexibilität: Du arbeitest remote oder in unserem Office in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Faire Vergütung und Entwicklung: Wir bieten dir ein faires Gehalt und Raum, mit deinen Stärken und unserem Unternehmen zu wachsen.

  • Eine sinnvolle Aufgabe: Du hilfst Menschen, eine passende Steuerberatung zu finden und ihren Steueralltag einfacher zu machen.

Warum bei uns einsteigen?

Weil gute Sales-Gespräche für uns mit Zuhören anfangen. Du verstehst, was Menschen brauchen, machst unser Angebot greifbar und begleitest sie zu einer fundierten Entscheidung.

Gleichzeitig wirst du Teil eines Unternehmens, das Steuerberatung mit KI, Technologie und Selbstorganisation weiterentwickelt. Deine Erfahrungen aus den Gesprächen helfen uns dabei, jeden Tag besser zu werden.

title: Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Analyst, Permanent Control
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.


Please make your application, including your CV, in English Language. We are a global compliance team headquartered out of London.

About the role

As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls, you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution.

 

Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, the global Permanent Controls team serves as an ongoing, trusted advisor and objective challenge to operational teams (1LoD), helping them design robust controls and ensure operational integrity across the organization.

Unlike periodic audit functions, Permanent Controls operates continuously to proactively identify vulnerabilities, standardize control frameworks, and foster a strong risk culture.

 

Note on Governance: This is a 2LoD function focused on ongoing control design, execution, and 1LoD enablement. It is distinct and independent from the Internal Audit (3LoD) function within Checkout.com.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Control Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to translate identified risks into comprehensive 2nd line control plans, standards, and templates.

  • 1LoD Enablement: Partner with the First Line of Defence teams to design, refine, and assess their control matrices, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulators' expectations (ACPR, FCA..).

  • Execution & Testing: Formalize and execute second line permanent controls across critical perimeters, including:

    • Financial regulatory reporting across global entities (France, UK, US, etc.).

    • Accuracy of financial data, accounting standards, and reconciliations.

    • Internal financial processes, procedures, and statutory compliance (including the Order of 3 December 2014).

    • Safeguarding mechanisms (flow of funds, compliance with safeguarding measures, timelines, and incident monitoring).

  • Reporting & Escalation: Present detailed control findings and anomaly reports to the Head of Permanent Controls; track the implementation of remediation recommendations.

  • Proactive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational control gaps, take the initiative to propose practical solutions, and drive improvements to the overall control framework.

  • Tooling & Automation: Contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated control tools, tracking dashboards, and recommendation monitoring systems whenever possible.

 

About You

  • Experience: 5 years of experience in Financial Audit, Internal Control, or Financial Reporting within the financial services (banking, Fintech..) or payments industry.

  • Regulatory Context: Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and ACPR expectations is strongly preferred.

  • Mindset & Working Style:

    • Proactive & Autonomous: A "go-getter" who takes ownership, anticipates control gaps, and brings actionable solutions to the table rather than waiting for direction.

    • Naturally Curious: A drive to understand end-to-end business operations, data flows, and complex payment mechanics.

    • Rigorous & Analytical: Meticulous attention to detail with an ability to leverage data analytics to evaluate controls, transactions and processes objectively.

  • Languages: Fluency in French and English is required.

  • Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clear findings and influence decision-making across lines of defence.

 

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

descriptionHtml:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team. This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking.

  • Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

  • Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.

  • Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers.

  • Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management.

  • Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling.

  • Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community.

     

You will collaborate cross-functionally with:

  • The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.

  • The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody.

  • The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs.

  • The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming.

  • The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability.

  • The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation.

  • The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems.

  • Strong production experience

  • Interest for Scala and functional programming practice

  • Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

  • Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).

  • Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production.

  • Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

  • Clear written communication in English, especially for design documents and incident reports.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Rust)
descriptionHtml:
About Intelic

In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense: software that enables autonomous platforms to operate together, faster, smarter, and more reliably, across complex, mission-critical environments.

Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, we offer a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics. They directly affect safety, resilience, and Europe's security.

Why the role exists

Our drones carry more and more hardware: cameras, gimbals, servos and more. The European market is fragmented, so we need to support many different types of hardware. Right now, adding a new piece of hardware usually means our own engineers have to integrate it. We want to change that. We're building a platform that lets partners and other teams connect their own hardware and write their own driver.

You'll work alongside robotics engineers and help set the team up from the start. The APIs and system design you create will be what everyone else builds on.

If you like hard backend problems where good design directly affects how fast other people can move, this role is worth a look.

What you will do

You'll spend most of your time in Rust, working out how to abstract the communication with the hardware from the rest of the system. That could mean designing how a new camera gets configured through the API, or writing a simulated camera so you can test an integration before the hardware is on your desk.

  • Design and build the platform in Rust

  • Define the APIs that other teams and partners use to integrate cameras, gimbals, servos and other hardware

  • Make it possible for others to write their own drivers and add hardware without needing support from your team

  • Think through how each new module fits into the wider system, and plan for the cases others will run into later

  • Write strong unit tests and add integration tests, including tests against simulated hardware

  • Work directly with other teams to understand what they need from the platform and agree on how systems talk to each other

  • Help set up the team, and hand it over well once the platform is in good shape

You will thrive here if

  • You have around five or more years of engineering experience in a heavy backend language. Rust is ideal, C++ or similar also works

  • You've built platforms or APIs that other teams depend on, and you think about how your part fits into the larger system

  • You work independently. You take a problem, work it out with the team, and see it through without someone managing every step

  • You talk to people. You reach out to other teams, ask questions, and don't wait for work to come to you

  • You take testing seriously, and you know how to test code that talks to hardware

  • You use AI coding tools like Claude in your day to day work

  • You enjoy technical problems more than product decisions. Here, what needs to be built is fairly clear. The job is to build it well

Bonus if you have:

  • Basic hardware knowledge: you know how to power a camera and get video out of it

  • Experience with drones, robotics or other connected hardware

How we work

We're a startup, so we plan about three months ahead and things can change after that. The team you join is small and may not stay in its current form forever. Once the platform is set up, you may move on to work on the wider vehicle platform.

  • Strong unit testing is the standard. Integration tests are added where they make sense, often using simulated hardware

  • Other teams build on your APIs and integrate their own hardware, so you don't have to do every integration yourself

  • Engineers work directly with other teams to agree on interfaces

What your first year will look like

At 6 months: You own this part of the system. The platform is set up, and the team is working at the level you helped set.

At 12 months: The platform runs without you in the middle of it, and you're helping on the wider vehicle platform, including the flight side.

Why Intelic

  • The mission is real. We're building technology that makes Europe safer.

  • Your work multiplies. Set the platform up well, and every team can integrate new hardware without waiting on anyone.

  • You build it from the start. You shape the APIs and the team instead of maintaining someone else's design.

  • You can focus on engineering. The problem is clear. Your job is to solve it well.

What we offer

  • Stock Appreciation Rights program

  • Travel allowance

  • Flexible pension plan

  • 25 vacation days

  • Urban Sports Club membership

  • Bike lease through 'Lease a Bike'

  • A modern office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord. We value working shoulder to shoulder, so we're in the office 4 days a week. You also get 10 days a year to work from wherever you want.

Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation throughout this process.

title: Senior Category Manager, Women's - Wovens UK/EU
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Category Manager, Women's Woven UK/EU

We are seeking a Senior Category Manager, Women's Woven UK/EU to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It supports the execution of merchandising strategy across selected womens’ activewear category, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince’s value proposition in the UK & EU by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end product strategy and assortment for women's Woven category in the UK & EU, including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking
  • Category-expert, sets long-term strategy with support; may build department from the ground up, with oversight
  • Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers
  • Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)
  • Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results
  • Own pricing and assortment decisions for the region
  • Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance
  • Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations
  • Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements
  • Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets
  • Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files
  • Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute

Qualifications required: 

  • Role is based in one of our UK/EU offices (London, Madrid, or Berlin), with 4 days per week in-office requirement
  • 8-10 years of retail merchandising or buying experience in womenswear category, (with specific women's woven experience) and demonstrated ownership of category performance
  • E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred
  • Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
  • Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail
  • Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results
  • Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative
  • Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
  • Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change
  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

Capco ist eine globale Technologie- und Unternehmensberatung, die sich auf den Finanzdienstleistungssektor konzentriert. Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, unseren Kunden dabei zu helfen, in einer sich ständig verändernden Branche erfolgreich zu sein.

title: Senior Corporate Development & IR Manager
descriptionHtml:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

At Thought Machine, we believe the next era of finance is predictive, personal, and powered by AI. Over the last decade, we engineered the cloud-native foundation making that vision a reality - bridging sophisticated architectural logic with the real-time data required for world-class customer experiences in finance. Our platform is globally recognised for its radical flexibility and resiliency, empowering the world’s most ambitious banks and fintechs to build, launch, and scale the products and experiences of tomorrow, faster than ever before.

The opportunity

We are seeking an exceptional, highly commercial Senior Corporate Development & Investor Relations Manager to lead our newly formed Corporate Development function. This is not simply an M&A role. It brings partnerships, M&A, funding rounds and investor relations together in one team, because the partners we build with, the investors who back us and the story we tell the market are closely linked. We want someone constantly asking: What could Thought Machine partner with, buy, or build that would make us stronger, faster, or more valuable to our clients?

Reporting directly to senior leadership and working closely with the CFO, CEO and with teams across Product, Commercial, Finance, and Legal, you will play a central role in our strategic transaction agenda, spanning commercial partnerships, strategic investments, buy-side M&A, and sell-side/exit readiness. Ultimately, we don't measure success by the number of deals completed; we measure it by whether those deals materially change Thought Machine's trajectory.

Duties

  • Partnership & Strategic Ecosystem Strategy:

    • Build and maintain the buyer, investor, and partner pipeline.

    • Drive commercial agreements and deepen integrations with key strategic partners, , with a high degree of independence.

    • Design innovative partnership and commercial structures in collaboration with Product, Sales and Legal, owning the deal economics, financial model and business case

  • M&A Origination & Execution:

    • Identify, research, and evaluate strategic fintech targets aligned with Thought Machine's product roadmap and geographic expansion.

    • Develop investment theses and maintain a global pipeline of opportunities, distinguishing between tuck-ins versus transformational opportunities.

    • Lead full-cycle M&A execution end-to-end—from valuation, financial modeling, and due diligence to negotiations.

  • Post-Merger Integration (PMI):

    • Partner across Engineering, Product, Finance, Legal, and Go-To-Market teams to design and monitor post-acquisition integration roadmaps, retention metrics, and synergy tracking.

  • Fundraising and investors

    • Ensure the company maintains continuous readiness for liquidity events.

    • Contribute to shaping Thought Machine’s equity story and investor communications. Be directly involved in leading funding rounds and other corporate transactions, from modelling and materials through to investor engagement and execution.

    • Oversee the data room, governance documentation, equity story, and competitive positioning across potential acquirers and financial sponsors.

  • Governance & Executive Reporting:

    • Lead monthly strategic reviews with the CEO and CFO, and prepare board and investor updates on partnership developments and transaction pipelines.

We're open-minded about your background. You might come from corporate development, private equity, investment banking, venture capital, strategy, or an operating role. You are intellectually curious but practical, and you like complexity without creating it.

Requirements:

Essential

  • Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience spanning investment banking (technology/fintech coverage), private equity, growth equity, venture capital, transaction advisory, or in-house corporate development/M&A at high-growth B2B SaaS / fintech companies.

  • Financial & Analytical Acumen: Exceptional financial modeling, valuation, and analytical skills; capability to evaluate complex transaction structures and build rigorous business cases.

  • Extremely strong verbal and written communication: With the ability to distill complex analysis into a crisp storyline delivered with credibility to senior audiences including C-suite executives, Board members and investors.

  • Cross-functional Leadership: Proven ability to manage multi-stakeholder workstreams under tight timelines across legal, product, engineering, finance, and external advisers.

  • Behavioural Traits:

    • Exceptional commercial judgement and strategic thinking.

    • Strong opinions, loosely held; comfortable challenging senior leaders and being challenged yourself.

    • Collaborative mindset focused on building trust across functions

    • Ability to move fluidly from analyzing a market to calling a founder, building a valuation, and negotiating a deal.

    • Confidence engaging directly with founders, investors, and Boards.

    • Comfort with ambiguity, speed, and personal accountability.

Desirable

  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with B2B SaaS unit economics and the modern banking/fintech landscape . Experience in technology, software, or banking is valuable

  • In-house experience: Time spent inside a high-growth technology company, not only advising them.

  • Capital markets: IPO, equity capital markets or other shareholder transaction exposure.

  • Board-level writing: Experience preparing Board or committee papers and presenting them.

  • Regulated environments: Experience working in or with highly regulated industries, especially financial services.

Benefits

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a German-speaking Customer Success professional with a passion for learning and technology? Do you thrive on building strong customer relationships, spotting opportunities for growth, and helping customers succeed? Then the Senior Customer Success Manager role at Kahoot! might be just the right fit for you. Come join us in making learning awesome!

The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in helping medium to large enterprise customers succeed and getting the most out of our products. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers achieve tangible business results with our products while identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships, drive retention, and grow accounts.

You will be part of our International Customer Success team, working with customers across one or more products in the Kahoot! Group's portfolio.

Fluency in German is essential for this role, as you will work closely with customers in DACH.

This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark; Oslo, Norway; or work remotely in Germany. You will report to the regional Manager, Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership and Customer Outcomes

  • Own a portfolio of mid-sized to large Enterprise customers and drive measurable progress towards their business objectives.
  • Manage the full customer lifecycle: handover from Sales, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) and renewals (in collaboration with Account Management, where applicable).
  • Build and maintain success plans and account plans with clear, customer-agreed success metrics and ROI.

Strategic and Commercial Impact

  • Use strong business acumen and our MEDDIC-based methodology to run discovery, uncover customer pain points and their business impact, and map stakeholders, champions and decision-making processes.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships, including at executive-sponsor level.
  • Own or support renewals and retention targets (GRR/NRR), forecast renewals accurately, and identify expansion opportunities in partnership with Account Managers and Account Executives.

Risk and Health Management

  • Monitor customer health and product usage data to spot risks early, and lead mitigation and retention plans.
  • Act as the customer’s escalation point, coordinating with Support, Product and leadership to resolve critical issues.
  • Analyse customer churn and losses, and share key learnings.

Scaling and Enablement

  • Partner with Customer Education to deliver one-to-many programmes, including webinars, live training and help center content.
  • Support Sales and Events as a product expert and trusted advisor during customer calls and events.

Voice of the Customer and Advocacy

  • Bring structured customer feedback to Product, Sales and Customer Experience to shape our products and services.
  • Develop customer advocates through references, case studies and community engagement.

Leadership and operational excellence

  • Mentor and coach less experienced colleagues alongside your manager.
  • Help develop CS playbooks, processes and best practices.
  • Keep CRM data, account plans and forecasts accurate and up to date.

Requirements

  • Fluency in German and English, written and spoken.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Sales, or from other similar roles.
  • Proven track record of managing a portfolio of medium to large enterprise customers, delivering measurable customer value, and driving retention and account growth.
  • Commercially minded, with a strong ability to build lasting customer relationships and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • A proactive, ambitious, and results-driven approach, with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing environment.
  • A collaborative team player who works well in an international, distributed environment.
  • Experience in SaaS and having industry domain knowledge are a plus.
  • Familiarity with the MEDDICC methodology is a plus.

Benefits

  • A competitive compensation package
  • Buddy program
  • Being part of a vibrant, diverse and passionate team
  • Social and company events

About Kahoot!
The Kahoot! Group is on a mission to make learning awesome! We want to empower everyone, including children, students, and employees to unlock their full learning potential. Our Kahoot! learning platform makes it easy for any individual or corporation to create, share, and host learning sessions that drive compelling engagement.

Since launching in 2013, Kahoot! has become a global leader, hosting hundreds of millions of sessions with over 12 billion cumulative participants across 200+ countries and regions. The Kahoot! Group includes Clever, the top US K-12 EdTech platform, and popular learning apps like DragonBox, Poio, Drops, Actimo and Motimate. Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, we also have offices in the US, UK, France, Finland, Australia, Singapore, Japan, Estonia, Denmark, Spain, and Poland. Let’s play!

Our K!rew

At the Kahoot! Group we champion a positive culture of collaborative learning and innovation. With a global team of more than 600 employees representing over 50 different nationalities, we’re a diverse and fun bunch of people! We work hard and celebrate our wins, tackle challenges with original ideas and learn something new every day.

We are driven by our mission and guided by our values: playful, curious and inclusive.

If you talk to anyone working in the Kahoot! Group, they will tell you that one of the greatest perks is being able to see how the work you do puts a smile on the face of kids, teachers and learners all around the world.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Data Analyst, ML & Experimentation (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

What you will do:

  • Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams.

  • Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact, working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes.

  • Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact.

  • Act as a strategic analytical partner to Product, Data Science, and Business leads. You proactively translate ambiguous business challenges into analytical roadmaps and turn complex ML insights into clear recommendations that shape product strategy.

  • Challenge product and technical decisions with data, bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy.

  • Drive analytical projects with end-to-end ownership: from initial scoping and hypothesis generation to stakeholder alignment and post-decision impact. Establish reusable frameworks and best practices that raise the bar for how we use data across teams.

  • Mentor and guide other analysts on the team, fostering a culture of high analytical standards, strong business intuition, and effective communication.

Who you are:

  • You have a degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, economics, analytics, or a similar quantitative field.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, or Data Science, with a proven track record of delivering measurable business impact and working closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders.. Experience in AdTech, mobile apps or ML-driven products is a strong plus.

  • You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large datasets.

  • You have strong Python skills and are comfortable using them for data analysis and statistical modelling.

  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance and A/B test analysis.

  • You have an understanding of machine learning concepts and model evaluation and are comfortable working with Data Scientists. You don't necessarily need to build ML models yourself, but you should understand how to assess their performance and limitations.

  • You have excellent data visualization skills and experience building dashboards using tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, Streamlit or similar.

  • You can articulate complex algorithmic and behavioral insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders, align differing viewpoints, and comfortably present recommendations to leadership.

  • You thrive with ambiguity and have a high degree of ownership. You proactively identify high-value opportunities instead of waiting for tasks to be assigned, and you take pride in seeing initiatives through to real-world outcomes.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on greenfield infrastructure using a cutting-edge stack — Kafka, Spark, Iceberg, and Databricks — collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help shape how we harness data to power our next generation of products.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.

*Onsite interviews may be required for this role.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS.  Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Lakehouse Architecture: Design and implement Medallion-layer data architectures (Bronze, Silver, Gold), building structured ingestion pipelines and curated data layers that serve downstream analytics and data science workloads.
  • Pipeline Development: Build and maintain scalable streaming and batch data pipelines using Kafka, Spark, and Airflow, supporting reliable and low-latency data movement across the platform.
  • Table Format Management: Own and manage open table formats including Iceberg, Delta, and Hudi — selecting the right format for the workload and maintaining performance and reliability at scale.
  • Query Engine Optimization: Work with Trino/Starburst and Databricks-based environments to optimize large-scale analytics queries and support platform consumers.
  • Platform Reliability: Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot data quality and performance issues, and continuously improve the reliability and efficiency of the data platform.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand data requirements and deliver platform solutions that enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Other duties as needed

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering with a strong focus on data platform and distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience building and managing lakehouse architectures, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) layering patterns.
  • Deep expertise in Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and Apache Airflow for both streaming and batch pipeline development.
  • Proficiency in open table formats — Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi — with the ability to evaluate trade-offs and select the right format for the workload.
  • Experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and analytics workloads.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Experience that will make you a standout candidate:
  • Hands-on experience with Trino or Starburst for distributed query execution
  • Familiarity with hybrid streaming/batch architectures and event-driven data systems.
  • Experience designing Gold-layer datasets optimized for business intelligence and self-serve analytics.

What You’ll Love 

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.
We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.
We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.
We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship. Due to federal government security requirements associated with our FedRAMP-authorized environment, candidates must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.

*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

Our Analytics community is highly active, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you’ll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Deliveroo, your goal is to maximise business impact within one of our product areas. A core part of the role is designing, running and interpreting experiments, and using causal inference to guide product decisions in complex, real-world settings.

You will go beyond simply answering “did this feature work?” and instead focus on understanding what the true impact is, why it worked or did not work, and how results generalise across users, markets and time.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Driving Strategy/insights through Experimentation: Leading the design of both simple and complex experiments and proactively translating findings into strategic direction.

  • Master Causal Inference: Apply advanced techniques to estimate long-term and heterogeneous treatment effects.

  • Drawing reliable conclusions in settings with selection bias or imperfect randomisation.

  • Drive Deep Product Insights: Uncover the fundamental drivers of experiment performance, determining why features succeed and how results generalise across different users, markets, and timeframes.

  • Using insights from past experiments to improve future decision-making.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • Strong experience designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments in production environments

  • Solid understanding of causal inference concepts

  • Ability to apply statistical thinking to messy, real-world product problems, not just ideal experimental setups

  • Great communication skills in person, in writing and in code, with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

  • Familiarity with SQL

  • Excellent people skills as you will be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: (Senior) DevOps mit Fokus Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Hard Facts zu uns: Als Unternehmensberatung liegt unser Schwerpunkt auf dem IT-Entwicklungs- und dazugehörigen Business Bereich. Wir decken die komplette Softwareentwicklung mit Fokus auf das moderne Java-Ökosystem ab (Backend, Frontend, Fullstack, DevOps, Architektur und QA). In den IT-nahen Business Rollen finden bei uns Product Owner, Scrum Master, technische Projektleiter, Business Analysten und auch PMO ihr berufliches Zuhause. Aufgaben

  • Als Consultant bringst Du Hands-on Deine Expertise direkt im Projekt ein und haust so alle aus den Socken. Niemand ist so wie DU!

  • Du brennst für Automatisierung und automatisierst Build- Test und Deploy-Prozesse vom Fleck weg.
  • Du beherrschst Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Tools meisterhaft, um die Verwaltung der Infrastruktur wie durch Zauberhand zu automatisieren.
  • Dabei hältst du stets ein wachsames Auge auf die On-Premise- oder Cloud-Infrastruktur unserer Kunden und optimierst sie kontinuierlich.
  • Du kümmerst dich mit Hingabe um Alerting, Monitoring und Tracing, um eine nahtlose Funktionsweise sicherzustellen.
  • Dein Teamwork ist besonders mit Entwicklern und Testern in agilen cross-funktionalen Teams gefragt, die nach Scrum oder Kanban arbeiten.
  • Deine engagierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise gewährleistet einen reibungslosen Betrieb der entwickelten Anwendungen.
  • Du vertrittst virtuos und souverän die Betriebsperspektive gegenüber dem Entwicklungsteam, den Product Ownern und anderen Projektbeteiligten und machst dabei den Unterschied.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im DevOps-Bereich und warst davor im Bereich Operations unterwegs.
  • Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung mit.
  • Dich zeichnet die Erfahrung mit folgenden Technologien und Bereichen aus: Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab, Linux, Docker, Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in der Programmierung und dem Scripting mit (Python, Bash, Java).
  • Du bringst ein starkes Know-how in der Implementierung von CI-/CD-Pipelines mit.
  • Du bist vertraut mit Microservice-Architekturen und mit dem Deployment auf Kubernetes.
  • Du hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Netzinfrastrukturen (Routing, Loadbalancing, DNS).
  • Deine Erfahrung in der Arbeit in agilen, cross-funktionalen Teams ist von großem Vorteil.
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und offen gegenüber Deinen Teamkollegen und unseren Kunden und hast Spaß am Beratungs-Business.
  • Du überzeugst durch dein verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Dein gutes Englisch.
  • Zielorientierung, Struktur, Eigenständigkeit und Lösungsorientierung sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: nicht nur ein Buzzword, sondern gelebt durch Remote-Work, 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Workation.
