title: Senior Director, AI Creative Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The Senior Director for AI Creative Operations (UK/EMEA) will lead the practical evolution of AI-powered creative operations across the region, working across Strategy, Creative, Production, Delivery, Product and Commercial teams to redesign workflows and operating models around the opportunities AI and agentic technology create.

This requires a deep understanding of how creative design and production work end to end, from briefing and creative development through to production, adaptation, localisation and delivery. The role will identify where processes can be simplified, automated, connected or reconfigured through Pencil and agentic workflows, while protecting creative quality and commercial effectiveness.

Crucially, this is not about imposing a single production model across every client. It is about understanding different client requirements, systems, processes and ways of working, then designing the right combination of people, technology and workflows to deliver effectively within each environment.

The role will turn these opportunities into practical, repeatable and commercially effective solutions, working with regional delivery teams and the wider Global Production Capability to validate approaches, embed new ways of working and scale proven models across clients and markets.

 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

 

AI Delivery Excellence

  • Lead the development of scalable AI creative workflows, operating models and delivery standards across Jellyfish.

  • Optimise end-to-end workflows, identifying friction, duplication and manual processes that limit speed, quality or scalability. Driving connection and coordination cross Pencil to ensure we are aligned on a connected product roadmap and creative excellence in our delivery.

  • Establish best practices for AI-powered creative origination, design, production, adaptation, versioning and localisation.

  • Validate workflows in real client environments, ensuring solutions perform as promised before wider rollout.

  • Embed appropriate AI governance, quality assurance, risk management and client compliance standards.

Commercial Optimisation

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce operational overhead and increase margin through AI.

  • Analyse workflows to understand where time, cost and resource are being spent, translating findings into actionable improvements.

  • Measure the impact of AI adoption on productivity, delivery performance, profitability and client value.

  • Build scalable delivery models that enable Jellyfish to increase output and capability without simply increasing resource.

  • Ensure AI-enabled efficiencies translate into tangible commercial benefits rather than additional operational complexity.

Product & Technology Enablement

  • Connect delivery teams with Pencil and wider Product and Technology teams, translating real-world challenges into actionable product feedback.

  • Establish structured feedback loops between client delivery, creative teams and product development to inform roadmaps and prioritise improvements.

  • Lead the testing and validation of new tools, features and beta programmes against real creative and operational requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve integration between platforms, tools and delivery environments.

  • Champion practical adoption of AI capabilities, ensuring technology solves real problems and delivers on its intended value.

Client & Growth Enablement

  • Equip client and creative leaders to confidently articulate the value of AI-powered creative solutions.

  • Support strategic pitches, executive consulting and client adoption programmes, demonstrating how AI can transform creative delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to expand client relationships through new AI-enabled services, operating models and commercial propositions.

  • Resolve delivery challenges that risk client confidence, ensuring the experience matches the promise.

  • Turn successful implementations into compelling case studies and repeatable solutions that support growth across Jellyfish.

Continuous Improvement & Global Standards

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, using delivery data, team feedback and client outcomes to drive meaningful change.

  • Codify successful workflows into practical playbooks, frameworks and global standards that teams can adopt and adapt.

  • Capture and share learnings, benchmarks and success stories across markets, clients and capabilities.

  • Establish clear methods for identifying, prioritising and resolving recurring operational issues.

  • Scale proven approaches globally while allowing flexibility for different clients, markets and creative requirements.

Creative Talent, Resource & Capability Development

  • Partner with Delivery Leads across Production and Social to evolve talent, skills and resource models in line with the changing demands of AI-powered delivery.

  • Optimise resource allocation across teams and disciplines, ensuring talent is deployed effectively against client demand, business priorities and emerging AI-enabled workflows.

  • Identify capability gaps, future skills requirements and opportunities to develop talent as agentic workflows reshape creative production and social delivery.

  • Inspire creative and delivery teams to explore how technology can amplify campaign ideas, unlock new creative possibilities and improve execution.

  • Develop practical enablement programmes that build confidence and capability in AI-powered creative workflows.

  • Identify where specialist support, training or new capabilities are needed to accelerate adoption and improve delivery.

  • Protect valuable creative and strategic time by reducing avoidable troubleshooting and ensuring teams can focus on high-value client work.

Leadership Qualities

  • Strategic and operational: Able to connect global business priorities with practical changes that improve day-to-day delivery.

  • Commercially minded: Understands how workflow design, resource utilisation, productivity and technology translate into business performance.

  • AI and technology fluent: Understands the evolving AI creative landscape and can translate technical capabilities into meaningful business solutions.

  • Creative by instinct: Recognises that technology should amplify creative ambition, not simply make existing processes faster.

  • Collaborative and influential: Builds strong relationships across Creative, Delivery, Product, Technology, Commercial and Client teams.

  • Analytical and solutions-focused: Uses evidence and insight to identify root causes, challenge existing approaches and drive measurable improvements.

  • Change-oriented: Can bring teams with them, turn experimentation into adoption and embed new ways of working across a global organisation.

     

Goals for Evolution

  • Establish AI Creative Operations as a global capability within Jellyfish Creative Delivery.

  • Move from fragmented AI adoption to consistent, scalable and commercially effective delivery models.

  • Create a robust feedback loop between client delivery and Pencil Product teams, ensuring product development reflects real-world needs.

  • Establish a measurable framework for AI delivery performance, productivity, quality and commercial impact.

  • Build a library of proven workflows, playbooks and case studies that accelerate adoption across clients and markets.

  • Position Brandtech as a leader in AI-powered creative delivery, connecting creative excellence, technology and measurable business value.

     

Qualifications:

  • Significant experience leading creative operations, creative production, delivery transformation, marketing technology or AI-enabled workflows within a global creative, marketing or technology-led organisation.

  • Demonstrable understanding of generative AI and its practical application across creative development, production, adaptation and delivery.

  • Experience translating complex workflows into scalable operating models, with a strong track record of driving adoption and continuous improvement.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with delivery economics, resource utilisation, productivity and margin improvement.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, creative and client-facing teams to improve technology-enabled delivery.

  • Ability to interpret operational data, identify opportunities and translate insights into measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and bring global teams together around change.

  • A genuine passion for creativity, innovation and the role technology can play in unlocking better work and better business outcomes.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International
descriptionHtml:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

The Sr Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International, leads quality for infigratinib, and will be the designated Responsible Person on the entity's wholesale distribution authorisation. The role reports to the Head of Quality, QED, with a dotted line to local managing director, and is based in the Netherlands. If the entity becomes the marketing authorisation holder for infigratinib, the role also covers the related MAH quality duties. The role holds an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board and is independent of commercial operations and of manufacturing/supply with EU-GDP guidelines, relevant EU directives (including the Falsified Medicines Directive), Dutch Medicines Act, and public service requirements. This role acts as a QA liaison of BridgeBio's contract service providers (CSPs), providing oversight of lot release activities. This role includes reviewing and approving batch records, certificates of analysis, and compliance documents, providing quality review of deviations, change controls, and CAPAs related to assigned CSPs, collaborating closely with CSPs and internal teams such as quality control, manufacturing, regulatory affairs, and supply chain. The role builds and leads a small quality team (deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, QA operations/GDP), owns the quality management system across the Skeletal Dysplasia assets, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and potentially subsequent MIA readiness, if needed in the future.

Responsibilities

Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities

  • Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity
  • Leads and develops the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP
  • Manages and improves the Quality Management System (QMS) across the entity's assets in alignment with the established QMS
  • Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness; prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import and batch-certification processes)
  • Own the quality agreement matrix: includes Quality oversight of contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces
  • Act as a Quality liaison and provide oversight and quality support of assigned contract service providers
  • Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications
  • Review master manufacturing batch records, including related documents such as specifications, analytical and microbiological methods, stability study protocols, and label proofs
  • Manage lot release activities and communication of lot release schedules to key stakeholders
  • Communicate manufacturing deficiencies/non-conformances to management and work with CSPs to ensure timely resolution
  • Review process and method validation protocols and reports
  • Review analytical test results to ensure compliance with approved specifications
  • Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents
  • Participate in internal and external project team meetings

Other QA/Responsible Person related responsibilities

  • Ensure accuracy of quality of records per GDP requirements including GDPs are implemented and maintained in the quality management system requirements for WDA license
  • Support and coordinate return, rejected, falsified products, recall operations of medicinal products

title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Embedded Linux Engineer to join the Core team within our Platform Team. You build and scale the embedded Linux platform our products run on and make it the common foundation for every new product, from bring-up to the field.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • One platform: Build a shared base distribution with clean per-product and per-board layers, so new hardware gets secure boot, identity, updates and observability by configuration, not by fork

  • Product onboarding: Bring new hardware onto the platform together with the product teams: BSP integration, device tree, drivers and validation

  • Platform contract: Define boot flow, partition layout, system services and versioned platform releases that product teams build on

  • Chain of trust: Secure boot from ROM to userspace, verified root filesystems, measured boot and encrypted storage

  • Device identity: Hardware-backed keys, provisioning in production and enrollment into a PKI

  • Field updates: A/B or atomic image updates, signed and delta artifacts, automatic rollback, robust over intermittent links

  • Node integration: Provide the platform hooks the node agent builds on: boot and update state, hardware identity, health sources and logs

  • Supply chain: Reproducible builds, SBOM, CVE triage and a patch path that reaches the whole fleet

  • Hardware CI: Automated flashing, boot and integration tests across all supported boards for every change


  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 6+ years of embedded Linux in production, including ownership of a BSP from bring-up to series production

  • Built and maintained a shared embedded Linux platform for several products or hardware families, consumed by other teams

  • Shipped a connected device fleet with field updates and device provisioning, and supported it after launch

  • Deep Yocto/OpenEmbedded including multi-machine and multi-product layer architectures (or equivalent depth in Buildroot or NixOS)

  • Embedded Linux on ARM and/or x86: device tree or ACPI, driver development and debugging across I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, Ethernet and CAN

  • Boot stacks: U-Boot, UEFI, Arm Trusted Firmware, OP-TEE

  • Secure boot on ARM SoCs or UEFI Secure Boot, dm-verity, LUKS or fscrypt, TPM 2.0 tooling

  • Update frameworks such as RAUC, SWUpdate, Mender or OSTree

  • Expert C, good C++, Python and shell; debugging with JTAG, ftrace and perf

  • Reads schematics and datasheets, comfortable with oscilloscope and logic analyser

  • Thinks in platforms: designs for reuse across products, names the trade-offs, makes build versus buy decisions and designs for the day a deployed unit fails in the field

  • Fluent in English & Willingness to undergo a German security clearance

Nice to haves

  • Real-time Linux (PREEMPT_RT, CPU isolation) or AMP setups with Zephyr or FreeRTOS on companion cores

  • Heterogeneous SoCs from vendors such as NXP, TI, Qualcomm or Intel

  • Rugged COTS compute platforms

  • Container runtimes on embedded devices

  • Mainline kernel or U-Boot contributions

  • Product security frameworks such as IEC 62443 or the EU Cyber Resilience Act

  • Defense or aerospace products

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you'll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, you'll:

  • Work with a cross-functional team. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features. 
  • Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
  • Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you'll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
  • Mentor. You'll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects. 

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have  the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
  • A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
  • User-focused. You're excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
  • Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

About us:

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. You work that way by default and keep expanding what the agents can do for us.

  • Fixing things for good: Working through a real backlog and removing root causes so the same problems stop coming back.

  • AI-native operations: Directing AI agents to do infrastructure work is already how you operate, and you want an environment that pushes it further.

  • Improving a live system: Making an existing platform cheaper, faster, and more reliable step by step, rather than rebuilding it from scratch.

  • Defining a function: Shaping what infrastructure at Rivia becomes as the company grows.

Responsibilities

  • Own our AWS platform end to end across staging and production: EKS, RDS, MemoryDB/Redis, S3, DynamoDB, IAM, networking.

  • Understand and reduce our infrastructure costs, from the Spark data pipeline to backups, and keep unit economics improving as customer volume grows.

  • Own CI/CD and developer productivity: faster pipelines, fewer flaky tests, better internal tooling.

  • Keep our Kubernetes workloads stable and scalable, including the services behind our AI features.

  • Run identity and secrets management: Keycloak, SSO, OIDC.

  • Build AI-agent workflows for infrastructure work, such as recurring audits of AWS for cost, security, and performance findings.

  • Support external penetration tests and provide infrastructure evidence for ISO 27001 and client audits.

  • Document core systems and runbooks so the platform does not depend on any single person.

 

What Excites us

  • Experience as the sole or first infrastructure owner at a startup.

  • 5+ years of hands-on infrastructure or DevOps experience with deep AWS expertise, including cost optimization work.

  • Production Kubernetes operations experience.

  • A proper software engineer: you write production-quality code and can diagnose and fix problems inside application codebases when needed (JVM experience a plus).

  • You have owned complex CI/CD end to end (GitHub Actions or equivalent).

  • An AI-native way of working: you use agents (Claude Code or similar) for real infrastructure work and can show concrete examples.

  • Comfortable being the only infrastructure specialist on the team: self-directed, you find and fix problems without being asked.

Bonus

  • Keycloak or similar identity provider operations (OIDC, SSO, secrets management).

  • Spark or large-scale data pipeline infrastructure experience.

  • Exposure to regulated environments (ISO 27001, audit support).

  • Datadog or a comparable observability stack.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

title: Senior Integrated Media Director
descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The Integrated Media Senior Director is a senior leadership role accountable for the effective delivery, performance, and integration of all paid media activities across an assigned account or portfolio of accounts. Acting as the operational and strategic lead for media investment, this role ensures that media budgets are planned, deployed, optimized, and measured effectively to drive client growth and business outcomes.

The Integrated Media Senior Director oversees the full spectrum of paid media activity, including Search, Social, Programmatic, Direct Buys, Retail Media, Retail Operations, Media Strategy, and Investment Analytics. The role is responsible for ensuring strategic alignment, investment effectiveness, operational excellence, and cross-channel collaboration across the client portfolio.

While channel specialists remain directly managed within their respective functions, they maintain a dotted-line relationship with the Integrated Media Senior Director to support client-centric accountability and integrated media delivery.

 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for paid media delivery and performance across assigned accounts.

  • Translate client business objectives into integrated, cross-channel media strategies.

  • Establish clear performance goals, KPIs, and measurement frameworks to evaluate media effectiveness.

  • Drive operational excellence through consistent implementation of processes, infrastructure, workflows, pacing disciplines, and optimization routines.

  • Ensure alignment and coordination across all paid media functions to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Investment & Planning

  • Partner with Strategy teams to define roles, responsibilities, and planning approaches based on client needs and organizational structure.

  • Lead cross-channel media planning and investment allocation to maximize business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Client Teams to identify optimization opportunities and innovative media solutions.

  • Oversee forecasting, budget pacing, and performance reporting across assigned accounts.

  • Partner with Investment Analytics to improve the adoption and effectiveness of reporting and pacing solutions.

  • Champion the use of data, automation, and platform capabilities to maximize return on investment and efficiency.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Foster collaboration and alignment across all relevant media and client-facing teams.

  • Partner with Channel Leads to ensure best practices, standards, and operational consistency are implemented across accounts.

  • Facilitate cross-channel planning, learning, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Promote continuous capability development and client education on media investment and performance.

Client & Partner Leadership

  • Act as a senior client contact for media investment, planning, and performance discussions.

  • Build trusted relationships with clients and key partners.

  • Translate complex media performance data into actionable business recommendations.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve media effectiveness and client outcomes.

 

Success Measures

The success of the Integrated Media Senior Director will be evaluated against the following key performance indicators:

Performance Efficiency

  • Achieve or exceed client spend and performance targets.

  • Ensure budget pacing and optimization activities align with client objectives and agreed benchmarks.

  • Measured through quarterly and annual business reviews.

Client Satisfaction & Retention

  • Achieve a client Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 9 or higher within the first year.

  • Drive proactive performance insights and continuous improvement in client communications.

  • Assessed through semi-annual client feedback and satisfaction surveys.

Operational Excellence

  • Deliver media plans, forecasts, and pacing reports accurately and on schedule.

  • Maintain greater than 95% accuracy in forecasting and less than 2% variance against agreed projections.

  • Evaluated through monthly performance and delivery reviews.

Team Alignment & Capability Development

  • Facilitate quarterly cross-channel planning and learning sessions.

  • Lead monthly performance review discussions with relevant stakeholders.

  • Measured through participation levels, stakeholder feedback, and business impact.

Innovation & Growth Contribution

  • Develop and implement innovation initiatives, automation solutions, or process improvements that enhance client results or team efficiency.

  • Demonstrate measurable business impact within 12 months.

  • Reviewed as part of annual performance and goal-setting processes.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Integrated Media VP

Direct-Line Relationships:

  • Search Directors

  • Social Directors

  • Programmatic Directors

  • Retail Media Directors

Key Stakeholders & Partnerships:

  • Client Leadership Teams

  • Strategy Teams

  • Project Management

  • Investment Analytics

  • Partnership Teams

  • Channel Leadership Teams

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

📈 Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

title: Senior International Accounting Manager
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB:

We are on the lookout for an exceptional Senior International Accounting Manager to lead Anduril’s accounting operations across Continental Europe and the Middle East from our Amsterdam office. This role owns the month-end close, statutory reporting, audit deliverables, and accounting operations for the Company’s legal entities throughout the region, and is the senior accounting leader on the ground as that footprint expands.

You will stand up and scale the accounting function while partnering with Legal, Tax, Treasury, Payroll, and Operations as each new jurisdiction comes online. This is a leadership seat: you will hire, develop, and lead the accounting team in Amsterdam, and manage the outsourced providers supporting the countries where we do not yet have our own people.

The ideal candidate has run a multi-country close, is fluent in the difference between a US GAAP reporting package and a local statutory filing, and would rather design the process than inherit it. Join us in our mission to disrupt the defense industry and elevate your career with a team dedicated to making a significant impact on a global scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for the Company’s legal entities across Continental Europe and the Middle East, delivering to internal deadlines while ensuring the accuracy of financial data.
  • Own statutory reporting across the region, including statutory financial statements, local reporting differences, and adherence to local filing deadlines in each jurisdiction.
  • Manage local statutory audits end to end, acting as the primary point of contact for local auditors while coordinating with the HQ team.
  • Review journal entries, account reconciliations, and fluctuation analyses; validate foreign currency remeasurement and translation impacts for the region’s entities.
  • Own accounts payable operations and the procure-to-pay cycle for the region, from invoice receipt through payment disbursement, including vendor relationship management and payment performance.
  • Hire, develop, and lead the regional accounting team in Amsterdam - including accounting managers and specialists - as the Company grows throughout the region, and manage outsourced accounting providers where local work is performed externally.
  • Serve as the primary accounting liaison between the US parent company and the
  • Own the accounting workstream on new entity and country launches, partnering with Legal on incorporation and registration and with Business Operations on site readiness.
  • Ensure adherence to internal controls and accounting policies, and design and document new controls as entities and requirements come online.
  • Partner with Tax, Treasury, and Payroll on VAT and local tax filings, transfer pricing support, intercompany settlement, cash forecasting, and payroll approvals across the region.
  • Support the configuration and ongoing maintenance of the region’s legal entities within the Company’s ERP, including any local statutory reporting basis.
  • Identify and execute opportunities for process improvement, including the adoption of automation and AI tools, so that the function scales faster than its headcount.
  • Partner with regional operational and program leaders to support business decision-making.
  • Work on ad-hoc projects with accounting and finance teams across the Company, from leases and fixed assets to inventory, intercompany, and tax provision support.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 5+ years in a supervisory or management role.
  • Experience owning the close and statutory deliverables for multiple legal entities in more than one country.
  • Experience leading an accounting team across more than one country, including the development of other managers.
  • Experience working within a global organization reporting to a US parent; public accounting experience a plus.
  • RA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Strong understanding of US GAAP and IFRS, with practical experience in local statutory reporting requirements across European jurisdictions; Middle East exposure a plus.
  • Experience managing local statutory audits and external accounting or audit providers.
  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with ERP systems (Oracle Fusion Cloud preferred).
  • Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills, with a track record of hiring and developing accountants.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to keep multiple jurisdictions and workstreams on schedule.
  • Comfortable building process where little exists today, with a proven ability to manage competing priorities in a high growth organization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a mindset for continuous improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with colleagues across time zones.
  • Fluency in English; additional European languages a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

About the job 

Build the Linux distribution foundation that turns upstream software into trusted Graphcore platform releases. 

You will help create the Linux distribution that powers Graphcore AI systems. The team produces production-ready system images from proven upstream distributions. 

Your work will shape how releases are built, validated and prepared for deployment. You will strengthen the engineering path from upstream Linux software to dependable platform releases. 

You will build and improve automated pipelines, run established Linux test suites, and diagnose issues across build and validation flows. As the platform evolves, you will introduce controlled configuration and tuning changes with evidence-led validation. 

This is hands-on systems engineering with visible impact. You will help define reliable processes for a new team building a critical part of Graphcore’s platform. 

The team and culture 

You will join one of Graphcore’s newest engineering teams, helping shape its culture from the start. It is a small, co-located team where ownership matters and progress is visible. 

Work happens through close technical discussion, practical problem-solving and evidence-led decisions. Ideas are challenged openly, and the best path wins regardless of hierarchy. 

You will report to a leader who values technical credibility and invests in people’s growth. The team moves with pace, takes responsibility and changes direction when the evidence demands it. 

What we're looking for 

  • Strong practical experience working in Linux environments 
  • Experience building or maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for reliable engineering workflows 
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash or similar scripting languages 
  • Experience with Linux image creation, provisioning or system installation 
  • Ability to diagnose failures in automated build or test environments

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Biologics
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on Biologics, you will own the engineering that turns our protein and antibody design models into fast, low-cost, hands-off pipelines. A near-term goal is to halve the cost of our current protein design pipeline and have it run with no human intervention on most enterprise-relevant targets.

You will work closely with the Biologics team's research scientists and computational biologists, our Post-training team, Research Engineering, our Product and Platform engineers, and our pharma and biotech partners.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys making complex ML pipelines robust and efficient, and wants to see the antibodies, nanobodies and peptides they help design tested in the lab.

What you'll do

  • Productionize our protein design pipeline: cut cost and runtime, and remove the manual steps between generation, structure prediction, scoring and candidate selection.

  • Build training, fine-tuning and evaluation pipelines for our next antibody, nanobody and peptide design models.

  • Make design runs scale to large campaigns, with reliable, reproducible outputs and clear failure handling.

  • Run and adapt pipelines for partner pilots and customer projects, and take them into Boltz Lab with Product and Platform engineers.

  • Feed what you learn about performance and failure modes back to research scientists and the product team.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Senior or Staff-level experience building and shipping machine learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch, and experience with distributed or high-throughput ML workloads on GPUs.

  • Working knowledge of protein ML or biologics design (e.g. structure prediction, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, BoltzGen), and comfort working with biologists.

  • A track record of taking models from research to production, with measurable gains in cost, speed or reliability.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean, tested, maintainable code and reproducible pipelines.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience on antibody, nanobody or peptide design programs, or with binding and developability data.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, Kubernetes or cloud GPU infrastructure; early-stage startup experience.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Build the pipelines that design biologics for leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

How we hire

  2. Technical interview

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. title: Senior Mechanical Design Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Mechanical Design Manager

 

Location – London

 

Role Summary

 

As Senior Manager, Mechanical Design, you will be a senior mechanical technical authority within STACK Infrastructure's EMEA Design & Engineering function, helping define, govern and continuously improve the mechanical engineering standards that shape our European data centre platform.

You will own key elements of STACK’s cooling strategy, mechanical plant standards, thermal performance and energy efficiency approach, ensuring the European Reference Design is applied consistently across regions while remaining scalable, commercially optimised and ready for future customer requirements.

Working closely with Engineering, Design, Development, Delivery, Commercial, Construction, Commissioning and regional project teams, you will bring senior technical oversight, practical challenge and clear guidance to complex mission-critical data centre projects across EMEA.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Act as the senior mechanical technical authority for STACK EMEA, defining and maintaining the mechanical components of the European Reference Design and future iterations.

  • Own the mechanical cooling strategy and plant standards, including air-cooled solutions, chilled water systems, liquid cooling integration and hybrid deployment approaches.

  • Define modular mechanical building block principles that support scalability, phasing flexibility, resilience and STACK’s platform design philosophy.

  • Provide senior technical review at key RIBA stage gates, challenging consultant designs for compliance with standards, energy efficiency, constructability and operability.

  • Review and approve structured deviations from mechanical standards, ensuring design decisions are clearly governed, documented and aligned with platform objectives.

  • Support regional design and delivery teams with complex mechanical issues during design, PCSA, construction and commissioning phases.

  • Provide technical input into client specification reviews and support structured responses to changes in rack density, inlet temperatures, flow rates and other hyperscale requirements.

  • Monitor emerging cooling technologies, higher-density deployments and AI-driven load growth, helping define a future-ready roadmap for liquid cooling and next-generation mechanical systems.

  • Support sustainability and energy optimisation initiatives, including plant sizing, PUE performance, capacity planning and improvements that enhance MW yield and platform competitiveness.

  • Partner with commercial, development and investment teams to explain mechanical CapEx drivers, quantify the impact of specification changes and support informed decision-making.

  • Develop and maintain mechanical design standards, technical guidance notes, Basis of Design alignment, QA checklists, peer review frameworks and BIM-related mechanical requirements.

  • Translate complex mechanical engineering topics into clear, practical insight for senior stakeholders, regional teams and cross-functional partners.

 

What You'll Bring

 

  • Significant experience in mechanical engineering within mission-critical, hyperscale data centre or similarly complex technical environments.

  • Deep technical expertise across chilled water systems, plant optimisation, air-cooled and hybrid cooling solutions, liquid cooling integration, thermal modelling and capacity planning.

  • Strong understanding of data centre cooling strategy, resilience, scalability, partial-load and full-build-out assumptions, energy efficiency and PUE optimisation.

  • Experience reviewing and challenging consultant designs, leading technical governance and reducing design changes during construction.

  • Commercial awareness, with the ability to balance energy performance, CapEx efficiency, expandability, MW yield and long-term platform value.

  • Confidence working across regional and cross-functional teams, including Design, Engineering, Development, Delivery, Commercial, Construction and Commissioning.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn technical complexity into clear recommendations for technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering. Chartered status, or progress towards chartership, would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a developer, hyperscale, investor-backed or large-scale infrastructure platform would be beneficial.

  • A structured, collaborative and improvement-focused approach, with the judgement to make clear decisions under pressure.

 

What We Offer

 

  • Work on critical digital infrastructure, supporting the development and operation of some of the world's most advanced data centre environments.

  • Build your future with STACK, gaining exposure to large-scale projects and clear opportunities for professional growth across a fast-growing European platform.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

  

About STACK Infrastructure

 

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world's most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
descriptionHtml:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

The Role

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.

  • Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product.

  • Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible.

  • Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records.

  • Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development.

  • Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability.

  • Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness.

  • Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements.

  • Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities.

  • Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications.

  • Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges.

  • Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture.

What we offer

  • Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

  • A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.


Requirements

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments.

  • Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards.

  • Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

  • Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems.

  • Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.

  • Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.

  • Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred

  • Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.

  • Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.

  • Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – Product Development
descriptionHtml:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Engineer – Product Development (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
descriptionHtml:

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Low Latency Trading
descriptionHtml:
The Networks team designs, builds and maintains all the communications infrastructure that allows our high-capacity, low-latency trading and data research environments to run 24/7.  This network spans over 25 countries and 100 locations. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with experience designing and managing large environments to fulfill the high-performance and availability requirements of a premiere algorithmic trading firm operating in global financial markets. 

This position requires both project management and deep technical skills. Working together with some of the brightest minds in our industry, you’ll be responsible for everything from product selection and design to routing configuration and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Systems and Trading Operations teams as well as others at HRT to build, manage, and monitor our low-latency trading network. You’ll have broad responsibilities with freedom to analyze and solve problems, and your solutions will have an immediate impact on our worldwide operations. 

We’re looking for someone with a love for technology and an excitement for tackling big picture problems. You will work on a wide variety of projects to enhance the performance and capacity of the global trading and research platforms and contribute to both high-level strategy and the technical nitty-gritty of our global network architecture.

Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related IT field
  • 5-10 years of relevant experience, preferably in low-latency and high-frequency trading environments.
  • In depth understanding of common layer 2 and layer 3 network protocols and best practices; working knowledge of OSPF, BGP, PIM, IGMP
  • Experience managing Arista, Cisco, and other common networking devices on a day-to-day basis
  • Familiarity with low-latency microwave networks and/or optical transmission systems, such as Adva, Ciena is desirable
  • Experience in designing enterprise networks, capacity planning, and full lifecycle project management
  • Experience with packet decoding and analysis tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills: able to distill complicated issues into clear and concise terms and to create and maintain effective technical documentation
  • Experience with Unix/Linux command line utilities and networking stack
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills on a wide range of networking issues, including common ethernet LAN problems, multicast market data distribution, and global WAN
  • Understanding of basic power consumption and cooling issues in a datacenter environment
  • Knowledge of fiber optics technology and cabling standards. Ability to sort through specs and make recommendations on appropriate purchases
  • Willingness and ability to solve small technical problems in the field yourself.
  • You have excellent collaboration skills and a willingness to admit mistakes.
  • Familiarity with firewalls (including Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet), VPNs and NAT
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools, such as Ansible or Salt is desirable
  • Familiarity with Python, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, GitHub is desirable
  • Familiarity with public cloud networks, such as AWS, GCP, Azure, is desirable

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

title: Senior Optical Packaging & Assembly Engineer
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us. 

Job Summary:

The Senior Optical Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing & implementing high-performance, robust & scalable opto-electronic packaging workflows for a variety of chip-based photonic integrated circuits. This work will be carried out in PsiQuantum’s UK R&D facility located in Daresbury Lab.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop an optical package and fibre-to-chip alignment scheme that allows for high alignment accuracy and scalable assembly.
  • Help develop packaging prototypes & scalable fibre-to-chip packaging flows and processes.
  • Review packaging design BOMs, work with supply chain on procuring parts needed for assembly.
  • Work with our internal packaging team and external vendors on transferring & scaling packaging designs and processes based on successful prototypes.
  • Work with external vendors and suppliers to source required materials and provide feedback on evolving requirements. 
  • Working with external partners to develop advanced opto-electronic packaging solutions.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree or above in Optical Engineering, Physics or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience working on PIC packaging design & qualification.
  • 5+ years of experience working with optical fibers, optical measurements.
  • 3+ years of experience working on FAU / optical connector to chip attachment.
  • Experience with optical data analysis.

What will I be doing?

  • Be the main point of contact for new joiners between offer and day one, partnering with Talent Acquisition to make pre-boarding seamless and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Awareness of compliance and employment law basics, and the judgment to flag rather than guess when something feels off.

  • Clear, warm communication - equally comfortable writing to a nervous new joiner as flagging something to a manager.


What will set you apart:

  • You hold yourself to a high bar, and you'll say so if you think something could be better - even if you're not yet the one leading the fix.

Where you'll work
