title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Platform Engineer

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

Our Mission For You

European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it.

Now we are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to build the foundation every trawa engineer relies on.

 

About trawa

trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you.

 

The Team

Our Platform team owns our infrastructure, shared tooling and developer experience, so your work shapes how fast and how safely the whole company ships. You'll work with engineers across the company and see the impact of your work across every team.

 

Who We Are Looking For

  • Impact focus: You focus on impact, not just technical outcomes, and you care about what your work makes possible for others.

  • Natural collaborator: People enjoy working with you, and you build strong relationships across teams.

  • Platform experience: You have at least 8 years of experience in a platform, DevOps or SRE role.

  • Hands-on AWS and IaC: You have deep hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

  • Distributed systems: You have built or run distributed services in production, with a strong grasp of security, reliability, observability and cost efficiency.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build and run scalable, secure, highly available AWS infrastructure that powers our mission-critical services.

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling and internal platforms so teams ship faster and with confidence.

  • Embed security into our infrastructure and pipelines, covering access management, secrets and compliance needs.

  • Partner with engineers, share best practices and make the right way the easy way.

 

Our Tech Stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Spacelift, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Python, TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, Incident.io

 

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • Current setup: You have a comprehensive understanding of trawa's current tech stack, infrastructure and security posture.

  • Team relationships: You have met the engineering teams, learned how they build, ship and run their services, and developed relationships with your key stakeholders.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • Infrastructure ownership: You own parts of our AWS infrastructure and Terraform codebase.

  • Workflow friction: You have found the biggest friction points in our developer workflow and proposed ways to fix them.

  • Platform improvement: You have led a meaningful platform improvement from design to rollout.

 

Why Us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Unit Economics
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Unit Economics at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

 

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

  • Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

title: Senior Product Manager (CRM & Growth)
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Zable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.

Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation

  • Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do

  • Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

  • Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

  • Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

  • Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

  • Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

  • Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

  • Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

  • Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders

  • A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just shipping features

  • Strong SQL and analytical skills, and experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the habit of measuring impact rigorously rather than relying on vanity metrics

  • Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on messaging infrastructure, deliverability and platform integrations, and clear communication across technical and commercial audiences

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services or another regulated industry

  • Experience launching a new channel or capability end to end, such as push notifications across mobile and web

  • Experience building experimentation or measurement tooling, including getting CRM and messaging data into a BI environment for analysis

  • Experience mentoring other product managers or CRM specialists


Interview process

  1. A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match

  2. A 15-minute cognitive assessment.

  3. A practical exercise or case study interview with the Hiring Manager

  4. A culture-add interview to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation

  5. Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):

    • VP Product & Design

    • Engineering team members

    • CPO interview

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

descriptionHtml:
About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.

FUNCTION: Product

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Fiat product team and own the operational backbone of our fiat payment flows.

Every day, BVNK moves money for enterprise customers across SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, RTGS and instant payment schemes. Getting a payment out of the door is only half the job. What happens next (a return, a recall, a rejected payment, a compliance hold, an investigation or a customer query) is where trust is won or lost. Your mission is to make those processes fast, reliable, automated and compliant, at scale.

You'll own the product strategy for the post-initiation and exception lifecycle of fiat payments: returns, recalls, rejections, repairs, investigations, compliance-driven holds and releases, and the tooling our operations teams use to manage them. You'll work hand in hand with payment operations, compliance, financial crime, treasury, finance and our banking partners to turn manual processes into well-designed product capabilities.

You'll partner with senior product managers, engineers and architects and with small, autonomous engineering squads, and you'll take products from discovery and design all the way through to launch. We see AI as a key lever in how we build and operate, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for FIAT payment operations, covering the full exception lifecycle of payment flows across all schemes we support: SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst), SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments.
  • Design and deliver scheme-compliant handling of returns, recalls, rejections, cancellations, payment repairs and investigations, including the related ISO 20022 messages (e.g. pacs.004, camt.056, camt.029) and their equivalents on non-ISO rails.
  • Build compliance processes into payment flows from the start: sanctions and transaction screening outcomes, holds and releases, Requests for Information (RFIs), Verification of Payee / Confirmation of Payee, Travel Rule and fraud-related recalls, working closely with Operation, compliance and financial crime teams.
  • Drive straight-through processing and automation. Reduce manual intervention, define clear exception queues and SLAs, and give operations teams the internal tools, workflows and visibility they need.
  • Ensure the ledger, reconciliation, treasury and reporting stay correct when a payment changes state, so funds are reversed, returned or re-credited accurately and customers are informed through clear API events, webhooks and statuses.
  • Run the full product lifecycle from discovery to launch: problem definition, user research with internal and external users, solution design, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, delivery with engineering, launch readiness, go-to-market, pricing input, documentation and enablement for sales and support.
  • Work with banking partners and scheme providers to understand rulebooks, cut-offs and scheme changes, and translate them into product requirements. Keep BVNK ahead of regulatory and scheme updates.
  • Define and track the measures that matter, such as exception rates, time to resolve returns and recalls, recall success rates, STP rates, operational cost per transaction, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction. Use data to decide what to build next.
  • Make sure capabilities are built once, on one shared BVNK platform, so every scheme, entity and partner benefits.

What we need from you:

  • Several years of product management experience, including owning complex B2B products in payments or fintech end-to-end, from discovery and design through to launch and commercialisation.
  • Solid knowledge of a product framework you've applied in practice: discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, go-to-market and post-launch iteration.
  • Hands-on experience with fiat payment schemes such as SEPA, SEPA Instant, SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments, and a deep understanding of how payments behave after initiation.
  • Experience with payment operations processes: returns, recalls, rejections, investigations, exceptions and reconciliation. You know the scheme rules, reason codes and timelines, and you know where things break in practice.
  • A track record of building compliance- and operations-heavy products in regulated environments, working closely with compliance, financial crime and operations teams on topics such as sanctions screening, payment holds, RFIs and fraud.
  • Strong technical skills. You're comfortable working with engineers on APIs, ledgers, event-driven systems, payment messaging (ISO 20022, JSON), data models and integrations, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code.
  • Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders, explain complex topics simply, and keep operations, compliance, engineering and commercial teams aligned.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You bring structure to complex, cross-functional problems and keep things moving.
  • An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, including spotting where AI can automate operational work.
  • Bonus: experience building internal operations tooling, case management or workflow products.
  • Bonus: experience working directly with sponsor banks, payment service providers or scheme operators.
  • Bonus: experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions (e.g. UK, EU, US).

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets.

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
descriptionHtml:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware
descriptionHtml:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide. Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. 

We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors.  

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy. 

What's Exciting About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager – Hardware. In this role you will be pivotal in translating Verifone’s global hardware strategy into strong regional commercial performance. Sitting at the intersection of Global Hardware Product, Regional Product, Sales, and Customer Success, this role ensures that EMEA markets receive the right solutions, at the right time, with the right positioning 

Key Responsibilities:

Regional Hardware Strategy & Catalogue Ownership

Global ↔ Regional Hardware Liaison

Hardware Lifecycle & EOL Management

Sales Enablement & Customer Engagement

Partner Enablement 

  • Support the enablement of ISV & Acquirer channels and serve as the point of contact for strategic partner reviews and roadmap briefings. 

Competitive  Positioning 

  • Maintain current competitive hardware positioning for Sales and Product teams, and monitor market signals to identify portfolio enhancements. 

Field Quality & Reliability 

  • Escalation Support 

KPIs & Reporting 

  • Define and maintain the regional hardware scorecard — catalogue accuracy, certification cycle time, NPI readiness, time-to-market on new SKUs, and field reliability KPIs. 
  • Deliver a regular hardware operating review to EMEA Product, Sales, and CS leadership; surface risks, dependencies, and decisions needed from the global team. 
  • Define and maintain the EMEA hardware scorecard (certification NPI readiness,), and deliver regular operating reviews to Product & Sales leadership.  

Required Skills and Experience we desire

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or a related technical role within the payments or fintech industry; Senior PM level or equivalent. 
  • Hands-on expertise in card-present payment environments — POS hardware, payment terminals, EMV certification, processes. 
  • Direct familiarity with payment terminal hardware ecosystems; experience with Verifone or a competing hardware vendor strongly preferred. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a product catalogue or portfolio across SKU lifecycle, pricing coordination, and regional availability. 
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to drive outcomes across Product, Sales, Operations, Engineering, and CS without direct authority. 
  • Customer-facing credibility: comfortable presenting hardware roadmaps and product positions to enterprise customers, partners, and senior internal stakeholders.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit in the Product Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Product Marketing. You’ll work closely with our international commercial teams alongside Product, Design, Research, and Engineering to champion our international customers, identify what drives their booking choices, and uncover where loveholidays can win. Together, the team will turn customer empathy and market intelligence into high-impact proposition improvements and rapid experimentation that accelerate growth across key international markets, starting with a strong focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

The Product Marketing team acts as the critical bridge between local market dynamics and core platform execution. Collectively, the team combines qualitative customer research with deep commercial analytics to evaluate competitor models, diagnose performance gaps across the end-to-end booking journey, and define high-value opportunities that scale effectively across borders.

Product Marketing sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers.

Your day-to-day:

International customer and competitor expertise

  • Build a deep understanding of customers in each international market: their needs, motivations, booking habits, expectations and barriers to choosing loveholidays. With a specific focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

  • Get hands-on with customer research, feedback and the end-to-end holiday journey, building real empathy and bringing the international customer’s voice into decisions across the business.

  • Understand competitor propositions and business models in detail. Experience their products, assess how well they meet local customer needs and identify where we need to close gaps or offer something more compelling.

  • Share customer and competitor insight broadly, helping teams distinguish between needs shared across markets and differences that require a local approach.

Market performance and opportunities

  • Understand performance by market, customer segment and stage of the journey, working with commercial and analytics teams to connect customer behaviour with conversion, repeat booking, customer satisfaction and commercial outcomes.

  • Identify where our proposition and experience are strong or weak, combining performance data with customer and competitor evidence to understand why.

  • Prioritise opportunities with clear recommendations on the customer problem, expected impact and how we will measure success.

Hands-on experimentation and improvement

  • Propose and run tests with international commercial and platform teams, taking opportunities from an initial hypothesis through to execution, measurement and a decision on what happens next.

  • Test changes to our proposition, messaging and customer experience, from how we explain our value to how customers search, book and manage their holiday.

  • Use results to refine our approach, stop ideas that do not work and build evidence for wider investment in those that do.

A platform that scales internationally

  • Translate international customer needs and market opportunities into clear proposition and experience requirements for product, design and engineering teams.

  • Work with platform teams to influence priorities and shape solutions that address local needs while building capabilities we can reuse across markets.

  • Identify where our platform limits international growth, including gaps in localisation, content, payment options, trust and the post-booking experience, and work with teams to test and address them.

  • Bring evidence from current markets into future market planning, helping teams understand what can scale, what needs to adapt and what we should validate before launch.

Your skillset:

  • You have significant experience in product marketing, proposition development, growth or a closely related discipline within a consumer-facing digital business, including work across international markets.

  • You are a customer expert. You go beyond research decks, spend time understanding real behaviour and can explain how needs differ between markets and customer segments.

  • You understand competition at the proposition level: why customers choose one provider over another, how different businesses deliver value and what that means for our own choices.

  • You are confident working with data. You can interpret market and customer performance, ask the right questions and combine quantitative and qualitative evidence into a clear point of view.

  • You have a track record of hands-on experimentation. You can turn an opportunity into a testable hypothesis, work with others to deliver it and use the results to decide what to do next.

  • You know how to work with product, design and engineering teams, translating customer needs into clear problems and requirements and balancing local relevance with platform scalability.

  • You communicate clearly and lead through influence. You build momentum across commercial and platform teams and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • You are comfortable moving between setting direction and doing the work. You bring curiosity, sound judgement and personal ownership of results.

  • Experience in B2C eCommerce is critical, travel experience is desirable

  • Fluency in one or more European languages, especially German highly desirable

The interview journey:

  • Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

  • Virtual 1st stage with Hiring Manager - 45 mins

  • Final stage with key stakeholder/s including a task to present, in office - 2 hours

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d) - Digitale Startup-Plattform
descriptionHtml:
Über EVEREST

EVEREST ist Ideengeber und Projektentwickler für digitale Tools, die Gründer*innen und Kleinunternehmer*innen Zugang zu wirtschaftlichem Know-how, Kapital und Ressourcen ermöglichen. Wir entwickeln Empowerment-Plattformen von der Konzeption bis zum Betrieb – z.B. die kostenlose bundesweite Gründerplattform oder das digitale Beratungsprogramm InStart für Soloselbstständige und Kleinunternehmen in der Krise in Hamburg. Deren Nutzer*innen haben Zugang zu ständig aktualisiertem Wissen, können ihre eigenen unternehmerischen Pläne umsetzen, wichtige Kontakte knüpfen und als Community voneinander profitieren.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Hamburg-Altstadt suchen wir dich in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit für eine befristete Position als:

Senior Product Owner (m/w/d) – Digitale Startup-Plattform

Das erwartet dich

Eine gute digitale Anwendung macht komplizierte Dinge einfach. Genau daran arbeitest du bei uns.

Wir entwickeln ein neues digitales Plattformprojekt rund um die Themen Gründung und Startups. Dahinter stehen verschiedene Teilprojekte, komplexe fachliche Anforderungen und viele Ideen, die sinnvoll miteinander verbunden werden müssen.

Als Senior Product Owner sorgst du dafür, dass aus diesen Ideen ein durchdachtes, technisch realisierbares und vor allem nutzerfreundliches Produkt entsteht.

Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, Projektleitung und unserem Entwicklungsteam zusammen. Dabei erwarten wir, dass du Entscheidungen fachlich hinterfragst, Abhängigkeiten erkennst und eigene Lösungsvorschläge einbringst.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktentwicklung steuern: Du behältst die verschiedenen Teilprojekte im Blick, erkennst Abhängigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass Funktionen in einer sinnvollen Reihenfolge entwickelt werden.

  • Entscheidungen fundiert vorbereiten: Du prüfst Ideen und Anforderungen auf Nutzen, Logik und technische Machbarkeit. Wenn ein geplanter Entwicklungsschritt noch nicht sinnvoll ist, erklärst du, warum das so ist, und zeigst Alternativen auf.

  • Komplexität für Nutzer*innen reduzieren: Du übersetzt komplexes Expertenwissen rund um Gründungsprozesse in einfache, intuitive digitale Anwendungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen von Gründerinnen – von der ersten Geschäftsidee über die Gründung bis hin zum Wachstum. Dein Anspruch: Nutzerinnen finden in jeder Phase die passende Unterstützung, ohne selbst Expert*innen sein zu müssen.

  • Nutzererlebnisse konzipieren: Du entwickelst mit Figma eigenständig User Flows, Wireframes und interaktive Prototypen, überprüfst Konzepte anhand von Nutzerfeedback und optimierst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Entwicklung konkret voranbringen: Du übersetzt Anforderungen in verständliche User Stories und Entwicklungstickets, priorisierst das Product Backlog und klärst fachliche Fragen direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam.

  • Roadmap und Qualität im Blick behalten: Gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung planst du realistische Entwicklungsschritte, begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Go-live und nutzt Feedback und KPIs für die weitere Optimierung.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits digitale Produkte entwickelt und weißt aus Erfahrung, dass eine gute Idee allein noch kein gutes Produkt ergibt.

  • Erfahrung im Produktmanagement: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit und hast digitale Produkte bereits eigenverantwortlich von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung begleitet.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst Anforderungen mit Entwickler*innen auf Augenhöhe besprechen, technische Abhängigkeiten nachvollziehen und daraus praktikable Lösungen ableiten. Erfahrung mit Low-Code-Plattformen ist ein Plus.

  • Sehr gute Figma-Kenntnisse: Du kannst selbstständig interaktive Prototypen entwickeln und hast ein fundiertes Verständnis von UX/UI und nutzerzentrierter Produktentwicklung.

  • Analytisches und strukturiertes Denken: Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Anforderungen nicht zusammenpassen, technische Voraussetzungen fehlen oder Prioritäten angepasst werden müssen.

  • Eigenständigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke: Du vertrittst deine fachliche Einschätzung klar und nachvollziehbar und behältst bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick.

  • Agile Produktentwicklung: Du bist vertraut mit Scrum, Backlog-Management und Tools wie Asana. Du kennst außerdem Möglichkeiten, KI sinnvoll in digitalen Produkten und Prozessen einzusetzen.

  • Fundiertes Startup-Verständnis: Du verstehst den Lebenszyklus eines Startups – von der ersten Idee über die Gründung und den Markteintritt bis hin zu Wachstum und Skalierung. Du weißt, dass jede Phase unterschiedliche Herausforderungen mit sich bringt, und kannst dich schnell in die jeweiligen Bedürfnisse und Fragestellungen von Gründer*innen hineindenken. Eigene Gründungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein Produkt mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bist früh in die Entwicklung eines neuen Plattformprojekts eingebunden und kannst Konzepte, Funktionen und Nutzererlebnisse aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Einfluss auf die Umsetzung: Deine fachliche Einschätzung ist ausdrücklich gefragt. Du arbeitest direkt mit Geschäftsführung, Projektleitung und Entwicklungsteam zusammen.

  • Einen Arbeitsplatz direkt in einer der schönsten Straßen der Hamburger Altstadt (Deichstraße).

  • Grandiose Kollege*innen mit einem wertschätzenden, hilfsbereiten Spirit und einem zugänglichen Management, das immer ein offenes Ohr für dich hat.

  • Eine intensive und strukturierte Einarbeitung, die dich optimal auf deinen Job bei uns vorbereitet.

  • Ein faires Gehalt zwischen 55.000 € und 65.000 € brutto jährlich bei einer Vollzeitstelle – je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Bei Teilzeit wird das Gehalt anteilig entsprechend der vereinbarten Wochenstunden berechnet.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do

  • Stand up and run a lean, effective Quality Management System suitable for a fast-iterating hypersonic hardware programme, aligned to an AS9100 pathway without adding bureaucracy.

  • Own the nonconformance process end to end: containment, root cause, corrective actions, and prevention (NCR, MRB, concessions) with tight turnaround times.

  • Build the quality backbone for prototype to flight hardware, including inspection planning, traceability, and documentation discipline that supports test and readiness reviews.

  • Drive supplier quality for critical components: onboarding criteria, audits (as needed), incoming inspection standards, supplier performance tracking, and rapid resolution of escapes.

  • Partner with engineering and manufacturing to embed DFM/DFA + quality by design early, so we don’t “inspect quality in” later.

  • Define and maintain pragmatic measurement and calibration controls (as appropriate) and ensure controlled processes for special processes where relevant.

  • Create simple quality dashboards that leadership actually uses: escape rate, NCR cycle time, top defect drivers, supplier OTD/quality trends.

  • Be hands-on in the build. When something is off, you are on the floor with the team finding the truth and driving the fix.


Who you are

  • Quality engineer with 4+ years experience in aerospace, defence, advanced manufacturing, motorsport, or other high-consequence hardware environments.

  • Deeply practical: you can run a QMS, but you care more about real outcomes than paperwork.

  • Experienced in NCR/MRB/concessions and closing corrective actions fast with strong root cause discipline.

  • Comfortable operating around flight-critical / safety-critical hardware with traceability and evidence requirements.

  • Supplier-quality capable: you can hold suppliers to a high bar without slowing the programme.

  • Strong judgement: you know when to apply rigor and when to keep it minimal so the team stays fast.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity and pace: you will build systems from scratch and improve them as we learn.


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport)

DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?

Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

In Motorsport, Catapult's SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR.

We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport) to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.

Based in London, you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, particularly for Endurance racing strategy, but also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite across different racing series.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward, as well as acting as a mentor and providing technical leadership to other team members. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
  • Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
  • Lead others to anticipate and meet customer needs.
  • Be one of the technical leaders within the team.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A passion for Motorsport.
  • 5+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++.
  • Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
  • An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Degree in computer science or other scientific or technical subject.
  • Prior experience working in motorsport is a strong advantage.
  • An understanding of the challenges faced by motorsport officials and teams in managing and participating in events.
  • Experience using Catapult's RaceWatch software.
  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
  • We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.

Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. title: Senior/Staff Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Senior / Staff Data Scientist, you will help shape how PlayStation measures the impact of products, features and commercial initiatives through world-class experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will develop innovative measurement methodologies, define best practices, and provide technical leadership that enables teams across PlayStation to make faster, more confident business decisions.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will solve complex measurement problems where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, applying modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to generate robust business insights. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to raise the standard of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across the organisation.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions impacting millions of PlayStation players while helping establish best-in-class measurement practices across one of the world's leading entertainment companies.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop innovative measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics that improve the quality, reliability and scalability of business decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Design robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Research, evaluate and prototype statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex real-world measurement challenges.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Define and promote best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement across multiple product and business teams, helping scale experimentation across PlayStation.
  • Partner closely with senior business leaders, product managers, engineers and analysts to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.
  • Partner with engineering teams to influence the evolution of PlayStation's experimentation platform and measurement capabilities, ensuring statistical best practices are embedded into future platform development.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple product and commercial domains, influencing measurement strategy, analytical standards and long-term technical direction through expertise and collaboration.
  • Mentor and develop analysts and data scientists, helping raise technical capability and analytical excellence across the team.
  • Champion a culture of evidence-based decision-making by educating stakeholders, sharing best practices, and communicating advances in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows.
  • Represent the team across PlayStation, building strong partnerships, engaging senior stakeholders, and promoting technical excellence in data science and experimentation.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred.
  • Strong industry experience (5+ years) applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling and measurement science to solve complex business problems.
  • Deep expertise in experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches.
  • Experience applying advanced data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL for large-scale analytical workflows.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical methodologies, frameworks or libraries that improve measurement quality and consistency across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, promote best practices and drive adoption through collaboration, technical leadership and senior stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong stakeholder management, executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into clear business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous, high-impact business problems.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow.
  • Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI.
  • Experience applying AI tools, including large language models (LLMs), to improve data science workflows and analytical productivity.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions or internal communities of practice.

What You'll Influence:

  • Measurement strategy for PlayStation's largest product and commercial initiatives.
  • Experimentation best practices adopted across multiple business functions.
  • Strategic product and commercial decisions through rigorous causal evidence.
  • The evolution of PlayStation's measurement and experimentation capabilities.
  • Technical excellence in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science across the organisation.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Shape how PlayStation measures product and commercial success across a global business.
  • Influence strategic decisions affecting millions of players worldwide.
  • Solve challenging real-world problems using cutting-edge experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques.
  • Collaborate with talented scientists, engineers and product leaders on high-impact initiatives.
