title: Senior / Staff Engineer (Routing & Optimisation)
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. Most of the work is backend engineering on distributed, production-grade systems, built in close partnership with data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. If your depth is in operations research or machine learning and you want to see your models plan a real delivery network every day, we'd love to hear from you too.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how the pieces of the pipeline fit together and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time.

The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities?

 

What You'll be Doing 🚀

  • Build the planning pipeline. Design, build and run the distributed systems behind routing, capacity planning, sortation and our collections network.

  • Turn ambiguity into designs. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production.

  • Shape the architecture. Shape how the planning pipeline fits together, and coordinate with other squads where our systems meet theirs.

  • Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes.

  • Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data.

  • Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for testing and reliability.

  

What We're Looking For 🔎

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and operating production systems.

  • A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the architecture or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams.

  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact.

  • Proficiency in Python or Go, or another language with the ability to ramp up quickly on HIVED's stack.

  • An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations.

title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.
We expect you to have:
  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexibility and ownership

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Software Engineer (Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers want to spend their time with clients, not digging through the books to find out what's changed. We're building the thing that does the digging for them.

It's called the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. Ask it anything about a client and it answers from that client's actual books. Don't ask, and it tells you anyway when something important changes.

Every one of those answers sits on data. Someone has to get that data in, shape it, define it and serve it, so the number the assistant quotes is the right one. That's you. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it.

This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems.

What You'll Work On

  • The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices.

  • The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer.

  • The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable.

  • The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does.

  • Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't.

You'll Probably Have

  • Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config.

  • Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now.

  • Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear.

  • An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it.

  • Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner.

  • Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one.

  • A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so.

  • AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build.

  • Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for.

  • Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark, Databricks or dbt; anything that puts data in front of an LLM.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how fast you're growing than in a perfect match.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £75K – £95K • Offers Equity

title: Software Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to our team!

WHO WE ARE :

eCential Robotics develops and markets a unique platform that combines robotic 2D/3D imaging, real-time navigation, and surgical robotics.

With over 100 patents and 7 registered trademarks, our company provides orthopedic surgeons and neurosurgeons with cutting-edge, user-friendly technology that enables them to visualize and optimize their procedures, particularly in minimally invasive surgery.

As a leader in the rapidly growing field of surgical robotics, eCential Robotics is committed to shaping the future of healthcare innovation and aims to become the global leader in open robotic platforms.

JOB SUMMARY :

The Software Quality Engineer is responsible for independently executing software quality assurance activities in support of medical device software and healthcare solutions. This role ensures compliance with applicable regulatory standards, internal quality system requirements, and industry best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

This position requires strong technical competency, regulatory knowledge, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Software Development, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Operations teams. The Software Quality Engineer contributes to risk management activities, verification and validation efforts, process improvement initiatives, and audit readiness.

MISSIONS :

  • Independently plan, develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive software verification and validation (V&V) strategies aligned with regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Review and approve software requirements, design documentation, risk management files, and test protocols to ensure completeness, traceability, and compliance.
  • Review and approve detailed test protocols and document objective evidence of test execution consistent with internal procedures and regulatory standards.
  • Perform complex testing activities involving multi-system integrations, data interfaces, interoperability, and performance evaluation.
  • Participate in risk management activities, including hazard analysis, FMEA, and verification of risk control measures.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards such as FDA Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and other relevant global regulatory requirements.
  • Support design reviews, change control assessments, and software release activities.
  • Lead or support root cause investigations, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities related to software quality issues.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to ensure efficient and accurate release of documents and programs.
  • Support internal audits, supplier audits, and regulatory inspections as required.


PROFILE :

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in software quality engineering, software testing, or validation within a regulated industry (medical device or healthcare preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing software test plans, verification protocols, and validation documentation.
  • Working knowledge of regulated SDLC processes and design control requirements.
  • Experience with automation testing tools and methodologies is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of application performance evaluation and software defect analysis.
  • Experience with requirements of traceability tools and defect tracking systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills – in French and English - with the ability to work in cross-functional environments.

title: Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Studytube, we're not just another EdTech company from Amsterdam. We've taken on a big challenge: helping organisations close the skills gap and giving employees the room to grow. Our platform shows companies which skills really matter, where the biggest gaps are, and how to tackle them. But real impact takes more than a strong product — it comes from creating relevant experiences, sharp storytelling, and engagement that actually means something.

That’s why we’re looking for a Solutions Engineer who bridges commercial ambition and technical-legal reality. You secure the ‘Technical Win’ in complex sales trajectories and enterprise tenders, acting as trusted advisor so every proposal is commercially winning, technically defensible and fully aligned with client needs and regulatory standards.


What you will do

As Solutions Engineer you own the engineering and advisory layer that turns complex customer requirements into robust, secure solutions across the full sales cycle. You are building the so-called “technical/product champion” alongside the AE in the sales process. Activities that come along with winning customers from the solution engineering perspective are:

  • You design and configure platform solutions for complex enterprise scenarios, including deep integrations, custom roles, automations and external content sources, so every demo and proposal is tailored and technically sound.

  • You analyse RFPs/RFIs and PvE documents, identify gaps, manage the Memorandum of Information (NVI/Q&A) process and craft high-quality qualitative narratives on topics such as security, architecture, accessibility and continuity.

  • You lead technical deep-dives, workshops and on-site UAT sessions, remove blockers in real time and build consensus with IT stakeholders, CISOs and C-level decision makers.

  • You map client IT landscapes, design complex integrations (SSO, AFAS, SAP, Learning Hub/DMS and others) and visualise data flows in professional architecture diagrams.

  • You navigate and translate security & privacy frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, BIO, DORA, Archives Act) into concrete product proof-points and commercial advantages.

  • You act as the bridge between Sales, Engineering, Product and Compliance — harvesting tribal knowledge, feeding market insights back into the roadmap and turning technical complexity into reusable commercial assets.

  • You use AI tools as your daily operating system: analysing lengthy RFPs, generating first-draft responses, accelerating narrative writing and building custom assistants while keeping human-in-the-loop quality and security standards.

  • You measure success by technical wins secured, sales cycles de-risked, time saved for the commercial team and long-term institutional trust built with enterprise clients — not just documents delivered.


Who you are

  • You have 3 to 7 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting or a similar role at a scaling B2B SaaS company, preferably EdTech or tech. You’ve moved beyond standard demos into complex enterprise solution design and tender support.

  • You have hands-on experience configuring platforms, scoping integrations, working with APIs and data models, and shipping working technical answers under tender deadlines.

  • You’re fluent in both the commercial conversation (with Account Executives and SDRs) and the technical conversation (with architects, CISOs and engineers).

  • You’re AI-native and product-minded: you diagnose requirements, design solutions, ship documentation and iterate with commercial outcomes in mind. AI is your building material.

  • You’re structured, detail-oriented, proactive and able to keep overview across multiple parallel tenders and stakeholder groups.

  • You think commercially — about which technical choices increase win probability, reduce risk and create long-term trust, not just technical elegance.

  • You’re a strong team player with excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex topics accessible and exciting.

  • You speak and write excellent Dutch (English is a plus).


What we offer

  • €60K - €80K a year including holiday allowence + 10K variabel.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Hybrid working (3 days at the office / 2 days at home).

  • 25 holidays + an extra day off on your birthday.

  • A 3% pension contribution paid by Studytube via A.S.R.

  • A fully equipped gym at the office — work out before or after work and skip the trip to Basic-Fit.

  • €1,000 L&D budget per year, of which 50% can go towards wellbeing or your home-office setup.

  • In-company training via our own Studytube Academy: LevelUp.

  • A beautiful office in the Houthavens with a view over the IJ.

  • A company laptop (MacBook Air) + €10 allowance for using your own phone.

  • For a small contribution: a fully catered lunch with a choice of a hot meal, sandwiches or salad bar when you’re at the office.

  • The nicest colleagues, with a team outing every quarter and an annual company party.

About Studytube
Studytube makes professional development as accessible, easy, fun, and successful as possible. We believe it’s essential for companies to invest in employee development, now more than ever. That’s why we offer an all-in-one learning platform that inspires employees to grow—and we do so successfully. Our customer portfolio includes over 300 clients across various industries, ranging from 200 to 30,000 employees. Companies like Bol.com, ASR, CZ, Manpower, VolkerWessels, and Eneco are already inspiring their employees with our platform. Together with 200+ diverse and passionate colleagues, we focus on creating the best learning experience for our clients. Our goal? To become Europe’s #1 platform for professional development.

title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers allemand courant (Télétravail depuis Mulhouse) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

  

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

Au quotidien, tu :

  • échanges avec les clients dirigeants et leurs équipes ;

  • comprends et qualifies leurs demandes ;

  • les accompagnes sur les sujets liés au compte professionnel, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement ;

  • interagis avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les demandes et opérations liées aux services financiers ;

  • coordonnes les échanges entre les clients, les équipes internes et les partenaires concernés ;

  • analyses les situations et identifies les prochaines étapes ;

  • apportes une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée ;

  • formalises les informations utiles au traitement des dossiers ;

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Au démarrage :

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur Pennylane et ses services financiers.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu’avec les différents départements.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends progressivement en charge ton portefeuille de demandes.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu analyses les demandes, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches la solution la plus adaptée.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

 

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo, Senior Recruiter : 30 minutes

  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert, Responsable de l’équipe : 1 heure

  • Test pratique en allemand : lecture d’un message client et rédaction d’une réponse

  • Dernier échange en visio avec Nathan Robinet, Senior Team Lead Customer Support, Financial Services : 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. title: Sr Agent Architect (Germany)
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).

  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.

  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.

  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.

  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.

  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.

  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.

  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.

  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.

  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.

  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).

  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).

  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.

  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.

  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 

  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.

  • Fluency in German and English is required 

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

This Staff Security Design Manager is the technical authority on security design, setting and continuously improving CoreWeave’s design standards and Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, directing the work of external design consultants, and leading cross-functional coordination with Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and ICT disciplines. The role requires a seasoned physical security design professional who can resolve complex, multi-team design risks independently, identify value engineering opportunities that protect CAPEX, and mentor other security design managers in a fast-growing, high-performance environment.

  • Security Design Ownership: Own the end-to-end security design process including construction drawings, specifications, and standards for physical security systems (access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, perimeter fencing, gates, and more) across multiple simultaneous data center projects in the Americas Region.

  • Cross-Functional Design Leadership: Participate in cross-functional design reviews and page turns, coordinating with Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and ICT disciplines to deliver integrated, compliant security designs.

  • Construction Reviews: Conduct construction reviews and design coordination meetings with applicable Security Technical Project Managers responsible for commissioning the security systems..

title: Staff Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.
  • Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.
  • Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.
  • Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.

title: Staff Electrical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

This position focuses on design, prototyping, integration, and testing, and is based in Olten, Switzerland.

What You'll Do

This role has the potential to support a number of aircraft electric systems and equipment, including avionics, power distribution (low voltage and high voltage), power electronics, electrical energy storage, and electric machines.

Bonus Points

title: Staff Product Analyst, Driver Supply
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Product Analyst, Driver Supply at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
What we're building

Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster.

The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). Think "npm install for mechanical engineers" - get the parts you need without the admin nightmare.

We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple.

The role

We're looking for an execution-focused, zero-fluff Staff Product Manager. Someone who can take ownership and drive product initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. You'll be making calls on what we build and why, translating messy customer and operational problems into simple solutions, and making sure they're executed well, monitored, and improved over time.

How we actually work

We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe, with product and engineering talent across Europe, Israel, and the US. You’ll also work with teammates in Asia. Most of our work happens async, which is the secret sauce of our success.

High trust, low bullshit: We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong. You'll have real ownership over what you build, no process theater, no busy-work meetings.

Question everything: See something that doesn't make sense? Say it. Have a better way to do something? Just do it. We actually mean it when we say we want people to challenge the status quo and improve things. Our internal motto is “Don’t drink the kool-aid.”

No busy work, no fluff: We keep processes lightweight and practical. If something helps us work better or solve a real problem, we do it. If it creates work without adding value, we question it.

Actually friendly, not corporate friendly: We play games online every week (current favorite: Make it Meme). Once a year we fly everyone somewhere beautiful for our offsite. We genuinely like hanging out together, which turns out to be way better than forced "team building exercises."

What we value in product and engineering:

Simple > Complicated. Simple code, simple architecture. Simple solutions are better than complex ones.

Ship it, then improve it. Perfection is the enemy of done. Launch now, iterate forever.

Product > Engineering. Every line of code should make our users' lives better. We're not here to show off our algorithmic prowess - we're here to solve real business problems.

Financials

Jiga is fully funded, cashflow positive, with growing revenue MoM. We're completely transparent about our runway and finances - ask us anything.

What you'll actually do

  • Talk to customers and suppliers, and work closely with internal users to understand their workflows and pain points (not just read reports about them).

  • Go deep into a complex problem and come back with a simple solution.

  • Analyze and monitor product usage data yourself to inform decisions and measure results.

  • Define what we build next and why, then write specs engineers can actually execute on.

  • Work closely with engineering and design to take solutions through delivery, follow up after launch, and improve what isn’t working.

  • Collaborate with sales, CS, and operations to understand business needs and improve internal processes.

  • Take ownership and move things forward independently without exhausting approval loops.

  • Clearly communicate what we’re not focusing on and why.

  • Use AI throughout all of the above to move faster, go deeper, and get more done.

What we're looking for

Must have:

  • You've built meaningful products that people use and that drive business results.

  • 5+ years in product, including experience owning complex initiatives independently.

  • Startup experience (<50 people). You know what “do everything” means.

  • Actually hands-on: you've done user research, written specs, built prototypes, and prioritized backlogs yourself. Recently. Not five years ago before you “moved to strategy.”

  • Comfortable with data, dashboards, and product analytics. You ask the right questions, find the answers yourself, and question what the numbers are telling you.

  • You know what moves the needle, focus on that, and separate real problems from noise.

  • You go deep with engineers, communicate clearly in writing, keep stakeholders aligned, and ask users questions that uncover real needs.

  • You're willing and able to get into operational details, work with internal teams, and improve how things get done.

  • You use AI hands-on in your daily work and have experience building AI-powered features that deliver real value within users’ workflows.

  • Strong UI/UX instincts. You have opinions about the details.

  • At least 4 hours of overlap with GMT+3 working hours.

Nice to have:

  • A background in industrial design, mechanical engineering, or supply chain.

  • Hands-on experience as a software engineer, data analyst, or UI/UX designer.

  • B2B experience in collaboration tools, quoting, supply chain, manufacturing, CAD, logistics, or marketplaces.

You'll love it here if

  • You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. "Figure it out" sounds like freedom, not abandonment.

  • You have strong opinions loosely held. You're decisive but update quickly when you're wrong.

  • You're low-ego, high-output. You do the grunt work, not just the strategy decks.

  • You see gaps and fill them without being asked.

  • You say what you think. No corporate speak, no hedging, no "let's circle back."

  • "If I can solve this without pulling in a dev, I'll just do it" is how you operate.

  • You're obsessively curious about manufacturing and how things get made.

This might not be for you if

  • You need meetings to get things moving.

  • You prefer clear requirements handed to you.

  • You like building consensus before making any decision.

  • "Move fast and break things" gives you anxiety.

  • You want to focus on "strategy" and have someone else handle the details.

  • You can’t operate without a clear process and hierarchy.

What we offer

  • A small team where you matter: We never compromise on people. That means you are part of the best team in the world.

  • Zero bureaucracy: We hate process theatre as much as you do.

  • Real ownership and responsibility: Make decisions, ship solutions, own the outcomes.

  • Complete flexibility: Work from anywhere, set your own hours, take time off when you need it (parents especially welcome).

  • Genuinely high trust: We trust you to do great work and be honest when things go sideways.

  • A team that actually likes each other: International, diverse, genuinely friendly people who enjoy working together.

  • Generous stock options: Meaningful equity in the company you’re helping build.

  • Self-development budget for books, courses, conferences, whatever helps you grow.

  • Annual offsites in beautiful places.

  • Fast-paced environment with tons of creative freedom.

  • Hard, interesting problems with a team that's positioned to win big.

How to apply

Tell us about a product decision you made that was controversial at the time but turned out right. And one that turned out wrong.

title: Staff System Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.

As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.

You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.

This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.

The team and culture

You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.

Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.

What we’re looking for

· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.
· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.
· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.
· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.
· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.
· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.

· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension

· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Ready to build the tests, tools and release gates that help Graphcore deliver trusted system software? Apply now to join the team.

La technologie développée repose sur des batteries aqueuses utilisant des complexes métalliques. Celles-ci ont la particularité de découpler la puissance délivrée de la quantité d’énergie stockée, grâce notamment à la taille modulable des réservoirs d’électrolyte.

Les missions pourront inclure des travaux de conception assistée par ordinateur (CAO), de prototypage, d’assemblage et de tests en conditions laboratoires ou réelles (réseau électrique), selon les priorités du moment. Le profil recherché est celui d’une personne curieuse, adaptable, passionnée par le secteur de l’énergie et attirée par un environnement startup. Des compétences en programmation (Python ou autre) et en conception CAO (Solidworks ou autre) seront un atout apprécié.

Notre équipe CDM accompagne nos clients dans le déploiement, la personnalisation et l'évolution de notre plateforme de trading, de la connectivité API à la configuration des workflows de trading.

Profil recherché

Ce que nous vous offrons

title: Summer Intern 2027
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

This is a 10 week internship program starting from 29th June 2027

Salary - £50,000 (per annum)

We’re looking for a super smart student who is great with numbers and loves problem solving to come and apply your skills in a start up environment and have a big impact on our business and how we do things.

What you'll be doing

  • Use your analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data, and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

  • Using data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model, such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

title: System Engineer - System Architecture - Contra
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As a Systems Engineer for C-UAS System-of-Systems, you own the high-level architecture of a distributed air defence capability.

You define the top-level architecture (L0 and L1), partitioning the capability into network, sensor, and effector subsystems and the interfaces between them. The architecture is open and hardware agnostic: any qualified node can join the network. It is controlled centrally but is designed to keep operating when nodes are lost or contested, so that no single point of failure breaks the chain. This is the layer that enables engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote, where the effector need not sit with the sensor that cued it.

This is a role for someone who thinks at the level of the whole system. Your decisions on architecture, networking, and interfaces determine whether a distributed capability performs as one coherent whole under real operational conditions.

The day-to-day

  • Own the top-level (L0/L1) architecture of the C-UAS system-of-systems, partitioning the mission into network, sensor, and effector subsystems

  • Specify the network capabilities that let distributed nodes share a common air picture and coordinate engagements, including decentralised operation when the central command node is degraded or absent

  • Derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from the operational concept, and own the trade-offs between coverage, resilience, latency, and cost

  • Translate operational concepts into a coherent system architecture and clear engagement concepts, then hold that architecture consistent as the design matures

  • Keep the architecture open and hardware agnostic, establishing the interfaces that let any qualified node join the network

  • Enable engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote by defining how cueing, track handover, and fire control flow across nodes

  • Produce a structured architecture that can be exposed externally to partners and customers at the right level of abstraction, without disclosing sensitive detail

  • Collaborate daily with the situational awareness and interceptor integration teams, and with AI, software, and hardware engineers, to keep the system-of-systems coherent

You should apply if you

  • Have hands-on experience architecting distributed systems or systems-of-systems, ideally for defence, air defence, C-UAS, or comparable networked mission systems

  • Can define top-level architectures and derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from an operational concept

  • Understand distributed and decentralised system design: how nodes share state, degrade gracefully, and coordinate without a single point of failure

  • Have a strong foundation in requirements management and interface definition

  • Can communicate an architecture clearly to both internal engineering teams and external partners and customers

  • Hold a university degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Are business fluent in German and English

  • Are willing to travel

  • Your personal values match ours: ownership, initiative, dedication to mission, speed and inclusiveness

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of tactical networking, mesh communications, or resilient data links in contested environments

  • Familiarity with air defence engagement concepts, kill-chain design, or NATO C-UAS framework

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

  • A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
