title: Tax Director
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

Volta builds and operates large-scale AI compute infrastructure, working with institutional investors, lenders and customers across multiple jurisdictions. We are seeking a commercially minded Tax Director to lead cross-border structuring and the delivery of the UK and global tax team.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, you will turn agreed tax strategy into practical structures and oversee technical quality across transactions, international tax and non-US tax operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for a broad corporate tax specialist who can resolve complex questions and help a growing team deliver.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead the design and implementation of cross-border investment, holding, operating and financing structures, including joint ventures, capital raises, acquisitions, re-financings and exits.

  • Review project underwriting and tax models, challenging assumptions on cash taxes, tax depreciation, financing, losses, withholding taxes and repatriation before commitments are made.

  • Oversee group structuring for development and management fees, intercompany funding and profit allocation, working with the Corporate and International Tax team on transfer pricing and operating substance.

  • Manage and develop the three UK and global Senior Managers, set priorities and review significant technical conclusions across their workstreams.

  • Work with the US Tax Director on cross-border projects and group policies, agreeing a clear tax lead and deliverables for each transaction.

  • Oversee the non-US compliance and reporting framework through the Compliance and Operations Senior Manager, reviewing significant tax accounting and indirect tax judgements.

  • Review transaction documents, commercial agreements and implementation steps with Legal, Finance, Treasury, Capital Markets and Corporate Development.

  • Direct external advisers on agreed workstreams, challenge recommendations and fees, and maintain clear records of decisions and implementation requirements.

  • Present recommendations to the VP of Tax, escalating material structural changes, uncertain positions and commercial risks for approval under the group's decision framework.

What You Bring

  • Extensive corporate and international tax experience at Director level in a major advisory firm, an international business or a combination of both.

  • A recognised tax, accountancy or legal qualification, such as CTA, ACA, CA or an equivalent qualification.

  • A broad structuring background across jurisdictions, with practical experience implementing transactions and financing arrangements.

  • Strong technical judgement across transfer pricing, withholding taxes, treaty access, permanent establishments and international anti-avoidance regimes, supported by specialists where needed.

  • Ability to review tax models and explain the implications for cash flow, investment returns and risk to non-tax colleagues.

  • Experience managing senior tax professionals and external advisers while delivering several live projects.

  • Infrastructure, private capital, technology or other capital-intensive sector experience is valuable.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Tech Lead - New Customers Team
descriptionHtml:
Tech Lead - New Customers Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead

You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan.

The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending.

The role

As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into a new service. It's the biggest change in a decade to the system behind iwoca's lending decisions. The next phase is yours to lead.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order.

  • Technical complexity. You'll design the team's part of the new service, which turns models and rules into a lending decision and optimises each offer across amount, duration, fee, and interest rate. You'll keep it reliable in production, easy to change as the models evolve, and able to show how it reached each decision.

  • Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions.

  • Influence. You'll get colleagues across iwoca behind technical work that competes with new features for time.

  • Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk.

  • Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones.

  • Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working.

  • Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it.

  • Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

  • Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Language

title: Technical Product Manager - Consumer Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

The Role 

Joining the Consumer Platforms team, you’ll help make Rightmove fast, consistent and easy to build on, so that our consumer product teams can ship great experiences with confidence. The team owns the shared foundations behind our website and apps: SEO and AI discoverability, site performance and accessibility, the design system, cross-team technical standards, client storage and analytics and tracking, and the third-party tooling that powers experimentation and CRM. 

Your customers are mostly internal: Product Managers, Engineers, Security, and Data and Analytics colleagues. You’ll learn where they struggle, turn that into a clear roadmap, and prove the impact in terms of both team productivity and outcomes. 

You’ll work day to day with the team’s Engineering Manager, Principal Engineers and Technical Architects. You’ll need to be as comfortable debating implementation detail with them as you are shaping priorities with product leaders. 

What you’ll own 

Our platform covers a lot of ground. Your main focus will be: 

  • Search and AI discoverability: establishing the framework that gives product teams clear visibility of how SEO and AI search (GEO) are performing, so they can act on it earlier. You’ll be the central point of contact for our dedicated SEO agency, and you’ll know enough about SEO and GEO to represent them well and help teams make good decisions 
  • Shared foundations: the design system, accessibility, and technical standards that product teams build to 
  • Data and tooling: analytics and tracking, client storage, and third-party tools such as our experimentation and CRM platforms, including how well they perform, what they cost and how they’re used 

How you'll spend your time 

You’ll monitor platform health and act on regressions with engineering, triage requests from internal teams against planned work, and run discovery with the teams who rely on us. You’ll write business cases, manage vendor relationships, and keep a backlog that shows how each piece of work supports our business goals. You’ll work closely with the Engineering Manager and Principal Engineers brainstorming, prioritising, roadmapping and setting the scope of individual projects. 

What we’re looking for 

Essential 

  • A track record of owning platform or internal-facing products for a technical audience, such as engineers and other product teams

title: Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Rematiq helps healthcare and life sciences companies move faster through complex regulatory and quality workflows with AI. Our mission is to reduce the complexity that slows medical innovation down and help more products reach patients faster.

We already work with leading healthcare and life sciences companies, including Novartis, solving real regulatory and operational problems in a highly complex industry.

As a Technical Program Manager, Regulatory Monitoring, you’ll own our Regulatory Monitoring product area end-to-end, combining hands-on technical ownership with product, team, and customer leadership. You’ll help build and lead a small team of engineers, set priorities and technical direction, and remain deeply involved yourself — reviewing code, debugging production issues, and shipping fixes when needed.

Regulatory Monitoring tells our customers what regulators published overnight. It monitors more than 70 regulatory sources across the EU, the US, China, and other markets, captures new and changed guidance, legislation, decrees, and consultations, and delivers them into the customer’s Regulatory Inbox. You’ll work directly with regulatory affairs teams at pharma and MedTech customers to turn their needs into a clear roadmap and make sure coverage, data quality, and reliability stay high. Coding agents build many of the sources, while engineers review and improve them.

 

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

What you'll do

  • Own monitoring end to end: Turn customer needs and coverage gaps into priorities, specs and shipped sources, and answer for the coverage, reliability and relevance of what reaches the inbox.

  • Lead customer alignment: Join customer calls, maintain the source list per customer, clarify scope, and separate what is included from what is an upsell.

  • Lead the scraping team: Set priorities for two engineers, one on architecture and infrastructure and one on sources and features, and write the tickets and specs they build from.

  • Stay hands-on: Review pull requests, debug failed production runs, and ship a fix yourself when that is the fastest way.

  • Shape the roadmap: Decide what gets built next, including news feeds, ontology-based filtering and classification, and alerts when a regulator changes its site and a scraper breaks.

  • Scale source building with AI agents: Improve the agent workflow that builds sources so the team adds more sources per week and more of them pass review the first time.

  • Build the team: Help grow the Regulatory Monitoring engineering team and set a high bar for technical quality, ownership, and delivery.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a technical owner with product judgment, customer presence and the ability to read and write code.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 2+ years in product leadership (Founder, Head of Product/Engineering or similar) and at least 3 years of hands-on coding as a software engineer, ideally on a data product.

  • Hands-on technical depth: You read a TypeScript pull request and judge whether it is correct, understand a Node.js and PostgreSQL service well enough to debug a failed production run, and can ship a fix yourself.

  • End-to-end product ownership: You have owned a product with paying customers from scoping through prioritization and requirements to operations, and were measured on outcomes rather than on tickets closed.

  • Strong customer presence: You run calls with enterprise customer teams independently, manage scope and expectations, and say no when a request is out of scope.

  • Team leadership: You have set priorities for engineers, defined the requirements they built from and reviewed their work. Hiring experience is a plus.

  • AI-native working style: You work with coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and have a view on how to make agent-built code reliable.

  • Operational discipline: You notice a failed nightly run before the customer does, and you put monitoring and alerts in place so that this does not depend on you.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have built or operated web scraping, crawling or data ingestion pipelines at scale.

  • Know regulatory affairs or quality management, ideally in Pharma or MedTech.

  • Have been a founder or a very early employee and can show founder-like ownership.

Why Join Rematiq?

  • Real Ownership: You will own a strategic product area end-to-end

  • Agent-First Engineering: You’ll work at the frontier of how software gets built when agents become part of the core loop

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work will shape product direction and drive real revenue

  • Meaningful Mission: You’ll help leading healthcare companies move faster — and support more medical innovation in the process

  • Strong Customers: We already work with leading healthcare companies, including Novartis

  • Small Team, High Agency: You’ll work closely with founders in an ambitious, execution-focused environment

  • Tools That Match the Ambition: Large token budget, real freedom to experiment, and the chance to push modern coding agents to their limits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and meaningful equity

title: Technical Project Manager - UK
descriptionHtml:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our London office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in the UK and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

     

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level english speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our London office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in London.

 

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our London office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & company stock options

  • 30 days/year of paid vacation

  • £800 wellness budget per year

  • Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

  • Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

  • Mental health support through our partner Mindler

  • Pension program

  • Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

  • An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

  • Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

 

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

descriptionHtml:
Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

Dans le cadre de nos missions, nous axons notre développement sur une approche mixte IT et financière, du diagnostic jusqu’à la mise en place des recommandations et nous intervenons en collaboration étroite avec les membres de la Direction Générale.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.

  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines informatiques et / ou digitaux.

  • Une bonne connaissances des outils présents sur le marché.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux, dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère sera un plus). Vous êtes motivé par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à fort enjeux stratégiques marqués par des opérations de haut de bilan et/ou de retournement et d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions IT, financières et opérationnelles.

title: The Flex Algeria: Chief of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Run the founder's office. French salary, Algerian life.

Meet the founder: watch this 60-second video

 

About The Flex

 

Our mission: make renting an apartment as easy as buying something on Amazon.

Renting a place to stay is still slow, stressful and full of surprises. We're fixing that. With The Flex you pick your apartment, book in a few clicks and move in. Everything is handled for you: hotel-level service with the comfort of a real home.

  • Started with one apartment in London. Today we run around 1,000 rooms.

  • 7 cities, 5 countries: London, Paris, Berlin, Lisbon, Algiers, Oran and Constantine.

  • First mover in Algeria. We were the first short-term rental company in the country, and we're now the market leader.

  • Bootstrapped. No outside funding. On average, revenue grows 30% month on month.

  • Powered by AI. Everything runs on Base360.ai, the AI operating system we built in-house. It handles pricing, guest messaging, operations and bookings on autopilot.

  • Built for the diaspora. In Algeria, The Flex is becoming the go-to platform for Algerians abroad coming home.

 

The role

 

You make sure the founder's time goes to what matters most. You run priorities, follow up on every project and keep the team moving. Perform well and you can grow into running The Flex in Algeria.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Set weekly priorities with the founder and track them.

  • Run team meetings and make sure decisions turn into action.

  • Manage finance, reporting and paperwork.

  • Prepare key meetings with partners, investors and officials.

  • Lead special projects from start to finish.

 

What you get

 

  • A French-level salary, paid while you live in Algeria.

  • Accommodation provided by The Flex.

  • A clear path to lead the country.

  • Real responsibility from week one.

 

Who you are

 

  • A French-Algerian living in France who wants to build something back home.

  • Very organised. Nothing falls through the cracks with you.

  • Fluent in English. English is our working language across London, Berlin, Lisbon and beyond.

  • Open-minded. You've travelled, studied or worked abroad, or you love working with people from different cultures.

  • Fluent in French. Arabic or Darja is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, pressure and speed.

  • Some experience in consulting, a startup or operations is a plus, but not required.

 

Requirements (non-negotiable)

 

  • Fluent English, spoken and written.

  • You hold an Algerian passport.

  • You have the right to live and work in Algeria.

  • You're ready to be based in Algiers (El Biar).

 

Why you should NOT join us

 

  • You want a 9 to 6 job with a clear job description. This isn't one.

  • You aren't comfortable working in English every day.

  • You need a big team and processes around you. We're lean and mostly remote.

  • You care more about a corporate title on LinkedIn than real ownership.

  • You aren't ready to live in Algeria full time.

  • You expect benefits like health insurance. We don't offer them.

  • You get frustrated when plans change every week. They will.

 

Who you'll work with

 

Raouf Yousfi, founder of The Flex and Base360.ai. He's from Algeria, studied at Imperial College, went through Y Combinator and was on Forbes 30 Under 30. He co-founded Terra API, which raised more than $3M and sells to 400+ companies worldwide.

 

How to apply

 

Send a short video in English (max 2 min). Tell us:

  • Why you want to build in Algeria.

  • One thing you made happen on your own.

title: UX Manager, Growth
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Our Growth UX team serves as the strategic bridge between brand and product, where campaign intent meets the product experience and the GetYourGuide brand takes first form. We design experiences that turn traveler interest into booked trips across owned and competitive surfaces (SEO, AEO, paid social, paid search, and integrated campaigns). By combining data fluency with storytelling and emotion, we partner closely with Marketing, Brand, Data, and Product to ensure every post-click touchpoint delivers early signals of value, matches customer intent, and earns lasting trust.

Leading user experience for the Channel Landing Pages group, this role shapes the strategic direction for how travelers explore, decide, and book. title: UX Research - Mandatory Internship
descriptionHtml:
About baesh

baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests.

We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX, an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn.

This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement.

  • Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin.

  • Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements.

  • Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months.

What you’ll help with

Usability testing and idea validation

  • Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI.

  • Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles.

  • Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically.

  • Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further.

  • Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference.

Exploratory research and interviews

  • Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet.

  • Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities.

  • Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers.

  • Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights.

  • Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build.

AI-supported research

  • Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

  • Explore how AI can support research synthesis by organising notes, summarising sessions, and suggesting patterns.

  • Check AI-generated summaries and interpretations against what participants actually said and did.

  • Learn where AI saves time, where it misses nuance, and where your judgement matters most.

  • Help us develop practical ways to combine faster research workflows with thoughtful, reliable findings.

Recruitment and ongoing feedback

  • Help recruit participants and coordinate research sessions.

  • Support Friends of BAESH, our community of early adopters who contribute through interviews, user testing, feedback, and feature suggestions.

  • Help create short in-app surveys about specific parts of the experience.

Making sense of what we learn

  • Analyse feedback and identify patterns across sessions.

  • Turn findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.

  • Share research with the product and development team to shape what happens next.

  • Help organise our research so we can build on previous learning.

You won’t be expected to do all of this independently from day one. We’ll guide you, give you feedback, and gradually help you take ownership of research activities.

What you’ll bring

  • You’re enrolled in a degree programme that requires a mandatory internship.

  • An interest in UX research, psychology, human–computer interaction, design, sociology, or a related field.

  • Curiosity about people and a willingness to question assumptions.

  • Good listening skills and an empathetic, respectful approach.

  • Strong communication skills in English.

  • An organised approach and willingness to take initiative.

  • An interest in using AI thoughtfully, including questioning its output.

Preferred, but not required:

  • German-speaking, so you can support research with German-speaking participants.

  • Some familiarity with interviews, usability testing, surveys, or qualitative analysis—university projects count.

  • Experience experimenting with AI tools for research, writing, analysis, or prototyping.

  • An interest in social products, communities, and how digital experiences support real-life connections.

You don’t need previous professional UX research experience. We’re looking for curiosity, care, and a willingness to learn.

What you’ll gain

  • Research mentorship: Learn directly from an experienced UX and behavioural researcher.

  • Practical experience: Contribute to exploratory interviews, usability testing, surveys, and idea validation.

  • Experience with AI-enabled product development: Learn how to assess and improve products when building is fast and informed judgement matters more than ever.

  • Visible impact: See your findings shape the experiences we build and release.

  • Portfolio experience: Develop research case studies, with guidance on what can be shared.

  • Flexible working: Agree a schedule that fits your university’s placement requirements.

  • A small, collaborative team: Work closely with the people designing and building the product.

Interested?

If you have relevant university work or a portfolio, we’d love to see it—but it’s optional.

title: Value Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with near zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Value Consulting team

The Pricing & Innovation team helps customers get the most from hx Renew, our market-leading SaaS pricing platform, and helps prospects and customers understand the value hx can create across pricing, underwriting and AI. Within it, Value Consulting turns complex customer problems into clear business cases, analysis and value stories that support better commercial decisions.

The team sits at the heart of our go-to-market motion, building the business cases and ROI stories that unlock strategic enterprise opportunities and drive adoption, expansion and long-term growth. You will work as a bridge between Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior customer stakeholders, turning ambiguous problems into quantified value stories that strengthen commercial conversations.

We are a small, high-ownership team. The culture is analytical, commercially minded and highly collaborative, with a strong expectation of independence, learning agility and comfort operating without a fully established playbook.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build clear, data-driven business cases and ROI models that quantify the financial impact of hx for prospects and customers, helping them make confident buying decisions.

  • Partner with Sales on strategic enterprise opportunities, getting involved early to shape tailored value narratives that accelerate deal cycles and increase win rates.

  • Run value workshops with stakeholders from junior underwriters to actuarial, pricing, transformation and executive leaders.

  • Develop benchmarking, ROI analysis and customer insight that give Sales and senior leaders compelling proof points for executive-level conversations.

  • Translate complex customer problems, workflows and data into simple, credible value stories.

  • Build the reusable models, benchmarks and templates that let Account Executives run a first-pass value case themselves on standard deals, so your time goes to the deals that need your judgement.

  • Continuously refine how we work, using AI and other tools to improve efficiency and impact.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Built robust business cases or ROI models for a technical or data-driven product, using clear assumptions and logic to demonstrate measurable commercial impact, that a buyer used to make a decision.

  • Presented numbers to a sceptical commercial or technical audience and held your ground when challenged.

  • Taken messy data and ambiguous customer problems through to clear, actionable recommendations, without close direction.

  • Translated complex quantitative analysis into simple, executive-ready stories or presentations that have influenced decision makers.

  • Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Customer Success (or similar teams) to align on value drivers, messaging and success criteria.

  • Pushed back when a number was being stretched, because the case needed to be right.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer highly defined, static playbooks and feel uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or helping to build the motion as you go.

  • You are not motivated by digging into the details of financial models, customer data and assumptions to create credible, defensible analysis.

  • You find it difficult to challenge or influence senior stakeholders, or you avoid direct collaboration with Sales on commercial outcomes.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager interview (1 hour)

  3. Skills assessment (1 hour)

  4. Values interview (1 hour)

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Bristol
descriptionHtml:
Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Bristol (BS5)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (30 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Bristol team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

title: Web Designer Intern (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Most of the internet looks the same now. Help us make sure our corner of it doesn't.

Cloud Studios is a product studio in Berlin. We build our own products and grow the strongest into companies. Our whole idea fits in one line: build what should exist.

We're looking for a Web Designer Intern to own how our websites look, feel and work. Ours, and our clients'.

What you'll work on

A wide range of work, across several brands at once:

  • Our own sites. The Cloud Studios and GetMOW websites are live, and they're never finished. You'll redesign pages, sharpen what's there and add what's missing.

  • Launches. We have new products in the pipeline. When one is ready to meet the world, you'll design the site it meets the world on, often starting from a blank page.

  • Client websites. We also design and build websites for clients. You'll take projects from first idea to live site, and help present them.

  • The details nobody asked for. Motion, interactions, the 404 page, what happens when you hover. That's where a website stops looking like everyone else's.

By the end of your internship, you'll have several live websites with your name on them.

Ownership, for real

You won't be pushing pixels on someone else's mockup. You'll get a brief, sometimes just a problem, and the freedom to answer it your way. You'll work directly with Eli, our founder, from the first idea to launch day, and see your work go live in weeks, not quarters.

That freedom comes with responsibility. If you think a page is wrong, say so and redesign it. Nobody here will ask you to stay in your lane.

About AI

Anyone can generate a website now. That's the problem. The internet is filling up with sites that look like they all came from the same prompt, and we're not hiring someone to make more of them.

We use AI every day, and we'd love it if you do too: to explore faster, prototype faster and build things you couldn't build alone. But the idea has to be yours. Your taste, your references, your weirdness. We want work that nobody could copy by typing the same prompt.

If something in your portfolio has made someone ask "how did you do that?", we want to see it.

Who you are

You've designed websites before, and you can show us. Client work, a side project, your own portfolio, a site for your friend's band: live sites count for more than concepts.

You have opinions about type, layout and motion. You notice when something is a few pixels off, and it bothers you. You'd rather make something strange that works than something safe that nobody remembers.

You'll need:

  • Experience designing websites, and a portfolio that proves it.

  • Strong skills in Figma or a similar design tool.

  • A real eye for typography, layout and motion.

  • Good English, written and spoken.

  • To work independently. You'll manage your own time and projects, whether you're at home or in the office.

Bonus points:

  • You can turn a design into a simple live page with a no-code tool like Framer or Webflow, or with a little HTML and CSS. Nice to have, not a must: you won't be writing production code here.

  • You've designed or built with AI before, and you have an opinion on where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • There's something in your portfolio you made purely because you wanted it to exist.

  • German.

A design role, not a development role

To be clear about what this is: this internship is about visual and interaction design. You'll spend your time on concepts, layouts, typography, motion and design systems, mostly in Figma. Development is handled separately.

If you're mainly a frontend developer who designs a bit on the side, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're a designer who can't stop thinking about how a site looks, feels and moves, it is.

What you get

  • Ownership early. Real websites, real clients and real launches, from your first week.

  • Creative freedom. We give you problems, not pixel specs.

  • A portfolio that's actually live. Websites real people use, not concepts in a Figma file.

  • Founder-level access. You work directly with Eli, and you see how a studio launches products.

  • Work from anywhere in Germany. Remote is fine. If you're in Berlin, or want to be, there's a desk for you at our office.

  • A way in. If it's a great fit, the conversation towards the end of your internship is about staying on.

How we work

  • Execution beats perfection. We ship, learn and improve. We don't wait for perfect.

  • Be a sponge. Learn from everyone, every project and every mistake.

  • Agency is a skill. Nobody hands you the next step. You find it.

  • Say it directly. We tell you what we think, and we expect the same back.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with Eli Cloud Läufer, who founded Cloud Studios in Berlin in autumn 2025, and alongside Öykü, our product designer, and Jenna in marketing and design.

Who can apply

You must live in Germany and be currently enrolled at a German university or in vocational training in Germany, and one of these must apply to you:

  1. Mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum): your study or training regulations require you to complete an internship. You'll need to confirm this with your enrollment certificate and your program's internship requirement.

  2. Voluntary internship alongside your studies: up to three months, and only if you have never interned at Cloud Studios before.

If neither applies to you, we unfortunately can't consider your application.

Details

  • Duration: Three to six months (mandatory internship) or up to three months (voluntary internship).

  • Working hours: 20 to 40 hours per week.

  • Location: Remote from anywhere in Germany, or from our Berlin office. You don't need to be in Berlin.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Apply through our application form. It takes about ten minutes. The most important part is your portfolio, and the one project in it you'd fight for.

Show us something nobody else would have made.

We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Managing Assistant for our Head of Web: someone who can genuinely take work off her plate, not just coordinate it, and who is confident working directly in our web tool stack (WordPress, CMS, web tech).

This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing.

You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards.

At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction.

The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase.


What you'll do

Project Management

  • Independently manage smaller website projects from kick-off through design, development, testing and launch.

  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects.

  • Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery.

  • Translate client requirements into clear tasks, priorities and deliverables.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early.

  • Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches.

  • Keep clients informed about progress, next steps and upcoming milestones.

Support the Head of Web

  • Support the Head of Web in coordinating larger and more complex website projects.

  • Prepare client meetings, agendas, presentations and project documentation.

  • Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines, proactively following up with clients and internal teams.

  • Help prepare project estimates, proposals and statements of work.

  • Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting.

  • Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships.

  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and make project delivery more efficient.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Handle day-to-day client requests and coordinate their implementation with the team.

  • Ensure requests are properly documented, prioritised and assigned.

  • Follow up on outstanding client feedback, approvals and deliverables.

  • Maintain clear, friendly and professional communication with clients.

  • Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time.

Key & Essential Skills

Project Management Experience

  • Some experience running or closely supporting website projects (agency or consultancy a plus); full PM seniority is not required.

descriptionHtml:

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

title: wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen
descriptionHtml:
wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?
Krijg je energie van onderzoek doen, werken met data en programmeren in R?
Wil je jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden inzetten voor een actueel maatschappelijk vraagstuk?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Verhuisketens geven inzicht in de doorstroom op de woningmarkt en zijn daardoor actueel en relevant. Het CBS heeft een methode ontwikkeld om deze ketens in beeld te brengen. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping.

Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?

  • Wat is de invloed van vergrijzing en overlijden van ouderen op de doorstroom en het woningaanbod?

Heb je zelf een goede onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij dit thema, dan is daar ook ruimte voor.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

De afdeling Beleidsstatistiek bestaat uit 70 collega’s verdeeld over Den Haag en Heerlen. Er werken onderzoekers en projectleiders met veel verschillende studieachtergronden binnen onze afdeling. Wij stellen cijfers samen die gebruikt worden voor het ontwikkelen, monitoren en verbeteren van beleid, vaak met een thema-overstijgend karakter. We zijn samenwerkingspartner op het gebied van data-gedreven werken bij overheden.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent bijna klaar met jouw wo master-opleiding in de sociale wetenschappen, demografie, ruimtelijke ordening of een aanverwante opleiding en zoekt een afstudeerstage om je opleiding succesvol af te ronden.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je (enige) ervaring met programmeren in R;

  • kun je zelfstandig onderzoek uitvoeren en uitkomsten analyseren;

  • weet je hoe je met verschillende methoden en technieken onderzoek doet.

Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn enthousiast, proactief en analytisch.

Omdat alle communicatie tijdens de stage – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw vakkennis vergroot en werkervaring opdoet;

  • programmeervaardigheden toepast in de praktijk;

  • leert werken met CBS-data.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

descriptionHtml:
Corporate Operations is looking for a Software Integration Engineer.

Within the Corporate Operations division of the Decathlon Group and the IT United network, the Corporate Operations team (100 teammates) designs, deploys, and ensures the performance of our digital solutions for Finance and Human Resources.

Our day-to-day mission:

  • Optimize the daily operations of our Finance & HR teams (accounting close, procurement management, financial performance management, employee data flows, etc.).

  • Accelerate digital transformation by pioneering tomorrow's technologies (automation, APIs, data-centric approaches, AI, etc.).

Your Role & Responsibilities

As part of the major transformation of our HR and Finance ecosystems, we are looking for a Software Integration Engineer.

Your main mission will be to analyze, design, develop, and maintain complex interfaces and data flows between our existing systems (Legacy IT / ERP) and the Workday platform, while ensuring technical quality, security, and overall operability. As such, you will be the Owner of the integration layer across our HR and Finance ecosystem.

This role strikes a balance between operational maintenance (RUN) and development projects (BUILD), driven by a mindset of continuous improvement and user satisfaction.

As a technical subject matter expert, you will be the Owner of the technology exporting data from Workday to our internal IT landscape. You will design the architecture supplying all third-party systems consuming HR data, core reference data (Jobs, Organizations), payroll, as well as Workday Finance data via specialized integrations (PECI, WICI, and WQL orchestration).

Your key responsibilities:

  • Technical Assessment & Strategy: Analyze the technical environment, identify custom development needs, and define the optimal integration strategy (high-level design, data flow mapping, IT architecture).

  • Design & Specifications: Draft technical requirements, micro-detailed specifications, and design integration test suites.

  • Development, Configuration & Quality: Oversee and execute integration developments or configurations, enforce core security principles (authorizations, encryption), conduct unit/integration testing, and validate compliance with functional requirements.

  • Deployment & Expert Support: Lead data migrations, manage post-go-live Hypercare phases, structure technical documentation/runbooks, and provide Tier-3 expert support for recurring incidents.

  • Collaboration & Enablement: Actively partner with the Digital Product Manager, Workday (vendor), service centers, and cross-functional technical teams (Data Flows, Authorizations, Job Scheduling). You will be responsible for building complex reports (WQL) and owning a specific Workday functional domain (e.g., Compensation, Absence, Time Tracking) alongside dedicated functional teams. You will also play a pivotal role in knowledge sharing and creating integration playbooks to upskill the broader team on integration standards.

  • AI Watch & Automation: Explore artificial intelligence capabilities (Workday AI Agents, Workday Extend, and our internal AI platforms) to automate processes.

Your Profile
